scripts.text: All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms here before entering.
scripts.translation: 首次到訪埃克拉珠的訪客，都必須在這裡填寫相關表格才能入城。

scripts.text: Please understand because of a recent increase in the influx of people from Midgard through Bifrost, we had to create this process.
scripts.translation: 最近經由彩虹橋從米德加爾特前來的人越來越多，我們才不得不設立這套手續，還請諒解。

scripts.text: Of course, the documents will be secured away after their use in access regulations, so you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation: 當然，表格用於入城管理後會妥善收存，請不必擔心。

scripts.text: Please note that you would not be able to enter the city without filling out the forms.
scripts.translation: 請注意，不填寫表格就無法進入城市。

scripts.text: Please fill out your name, occupation, and level here.
scripts.translation: 請在這裡填寫您的姓名、職業和等級。

scripts.text: If you completed your forms, please submit them to the administrator over there.
scripts.translation: 如果表格已經填好，請交給那邊的管

scripts.text: There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
Please submit your forms to the administrator over there after writing in your name, occupation, and level.
scripts.translation: 請填寫姓名、職業和等級，然後把表格交給那邊的管理員。可能需要等一會兒，請耐心等待。

scripts.text: There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠受到彩虹橋的影響，各個種族之間可以順暢交流。

scripts.text: There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation: 因此不需要另外安排翻譯，而且這裡也有足夠的橋梁供步行的種族通行。祝您在此訪問愉快。

scripts.text: Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.

scripts.text: As you can see, I'm really busy here, so unless you need something, please don't bother me.
scripts.translation: 您也看到了，我忙得不可開交。沒什麼事的話，請別來打擾我。

scripts.text: There's still a lot of people before you. Could you please wait until your turn?
scripts.translation: 您前面還有不少人，請等輪到您再過來。不

scripts.text: Whew! I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
There are just too many visitors.
So if you will place your forms here...
scripts.translation: 那麼，請把表格放在這裡...

scripts.text: Here!! These are my completed forms!!
scripts.translation: 在這裡！！這是我填好的表格

scripts.text: This time it's all good, right?
I'm taking care of visitors in the order they arrived, so please wait for your turn.
scripts.translation: 我會按來訪者抵達的先後順序辦理，請耐心等候。

scripts.text: I was waaaay before all of these guys!
scripts.translation: 可比他們早到老半天了！

scripts.text: Well, your turn was delayed because you had to fill out your forms, so you have to wait until later.
scripts.translation: 可是您得先填寫表格，所以輪到您的時間往後延了，只能再等等。

scripts.text: What?! You just said you take care of visitors in the order they arrived!!!
scripts.translation: 什麼？！你剛才明明說按抵達順序辦理的！！！

scripts.text: Yes, I did say that but...
OW!! Why did you hit me?
My stupid friend here is causing trouble.
scripts.translation: 我這個笨蛋朋友又在給您添麻煩了。

scripts.text: If you hadn't filled out my name incorrectly in the first place, we wouldn't be waiting like this!
scripts.translation: 要不是你一開始把我的名字填錯，我們哪用在這兒等這麼久！

scripts.text: Mark Esha or Madrid, they're all the same!
scripts.translation: 馬克·艾沙也好，馬德里也好，不都差不多嘛！

scripts.text: They're not at all the same!
And what's more, how can you not know the name of your friend of 15 years?
scripts.translation: ，你怎麼會連認識了十五年的朋友叫什麼都不知道？

scripts.text: It's not that I didn't know- I did it on purpose!!
scripts.translation: 我不是不知道——我就是故意的！！馬

scripts.text: Hu... I am so sorry that my friend is this stupid.
scripts.translation: 嗚...真抱歉，我這朋友實在太蠢

scripts.text: Please don't mind us and do what you need to do.
scripts.translation: 了。請別介意我們，您忙您的吧。

scripts.text: How long do I have to wait out here!!!
scripts.translation: 去！！！！我還要在外面等多久啊！！！

scripts.text: Would you stay put just for a second?!!!
scripts.translation: 你就不能安分一會兒嗎？！！！抱

scripts.text: Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
And Mr. Deu Lean, please take your group and enter. It's just way too noisy.
scripts.translation: 杜連先生，也請帶上您的同伴進城吧。這裡吵得實在受不了了。

scripts.text: Thanks to me, we got through faster!
scripts.translation: 吧？！多虧了我，我們才能這麼快通過！

scripts.text: A real man does not get bogged down by the past!!
scripts.translation: 真正的男子漢才不會糾結過去！！

scripts.text: I may have been slow with the documentation but I will be the one to enter Eclage first!
scripts.translation: 辦手續時我雖然慢了點，但我可是第一個進埃克拉珠的人！哇哈

scripts.text: Mr. Mark, Mr. Du is already gone.
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
Alright, next person in line please!
scripts.translation: 好了，下一位請上前！下一位

scripts.text: I don't think it's all for the best to have so many visitors.
scripts.translation: ..訪客這麼多，看來也不全是好事。

scripts.text: I can't believe I have to wait this long......
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信要等這麼久...到

scripts.text: When is it going to be my turn?
I'm actually done with my documentation, but I'm just sticking around to appreciate all of these flowers.
scripts.translation: 我的手續其實已經辦好了，只是想留下來欣賞這些花。

scripts.text: I'm just getting through the night with my sleeping bag!
scripts.translation: 我帶了睡袋，乾脆就在這裡過

scripts.text: It's alright as long as you can withstand the security guard's annoyance with you.
scripts.translation: 夜！只要受得了保安的白眼，倒也沒什麼。

scripts.text: I wonder how beautiful of a city Eclage would be.
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠到底是座多麼美麗的城市

scripts.text: It just makes my heart beat thinking about it.
scripts.translation: 呢？光是想想就讓我心跳加速。

scripts.text: No, I'm not a visitor. I'm an Eclage citizen!
scripts.translation: 不，我不是遊客。我是埃克拉珠的居民！

scripts.text: I can't believe I can't even enter because of all these tourists!
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信遊客這麼多，害得我連家都進不去！

scripts.text: I hear their acorns are delicious without a hint of bitterness.
scripts.translation: 聽說那裡的橡果很好吃，一點苦味都沒有。

scripts.text: You could probably make the world's best acorn jello.
scripts.translation: 說不定能做出全世界最好吃的橡果涼粉。

scripts.text: It's important to keep your belongings light when traveling.
scripts.translation: 旅行時，行李還是輕便些好。

scripts.text: It's going to increase as you go along anyways.
scripts.translation: 反正走得越遠，行李只會越變越多。

scripts.text: Perhaps you could consider it as the weight of life?
scripts.translation: 或許可以把它當成人生的重量吧？

scripts.text: Oh! Are you also from Midgard?
scripts.translation: 哦！你也是從米德加爾特來的嗎？

scripts.text: It's encouraging to see so many Midgard people nowadays.
scripts.translation: 最近能看到這麼多米德加爾特人，真讓人振奮。

scripts.text: You're saying I have to wait after all this traveling through Bifrost?!
scripts.translation: 的腿...一路穿過彩虹橋來到這裡，居然還得繼續等？！

scripts.text: Why are there so many people...?

scripts.translation: 我只想一個人待著...（抽泣）

scripts.text: - The bridge is broken. There should be some kind of a solution. -
scripts.translation: - 橋斷了，應該有辦法可以修好。 -

scripts.text: Did you talk to the security guard before coming into the city?
scripts.translation: 進城前你有和保安談過嗎？

scripts.text: The bridge is kind of broken so please be careful.
This area is kind of broken, so be careful.
scripts.translation: 這附近有些地方壞了，小心

scripts.text: Otherwise, you'll fall aaaaaall the way down.
scripts.translation: 點。不然會一路摔到底的。

scripts.text: The work being done right now
The reason for the bridge being broken
As you can see, I'm doing some carpentry work.
scripts.translation: 如你所見，我正在做木工。最

scripts.text: There are more visitors to Eclage nowadays, so I'm primarily working on building bridges.
scripts.translation: 近來埃克拉珠的訪客多了起來，所以我主要負責修建橋梁。

scripts.text: In fact, Laphines can fly around so bridges are technically not necessary, but we are building them since there are many visitors who have been getting hurt by falling while climbing trees.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族會飛，所以嚴格來說並不需要橋。不過，許多訪客爬樹時會摔傷，我們才修建這些橋。

scripts.text: Oh, just a minute ago, there was a human being who took a misstep and broke a tree branch while falling.
scripts.translation: 哦，就在剛才，有個人類一腳踩空，摔下來時撞斷了一根樹枝。

scripts.text: Being close to the entrance and all, this really needs to be fixed soon.
scripts.translation: 這裡離入口很近，得儘快修好。

scripts.text: I'm trying to decide whether I should put up a warning sign, gather the necessary materials for repair, or call a friend to help.
scripts.translation: 我正琢磨著該立警告牌、收集維修材料，還是叫朋友來幫忙。

scripts.text: You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation: 修好之前你沒法從這裡

scripts.text: You are going to help me?!
I can't believe there's still this kind of kindness left in the world... Hmm, sweaty eyes...
scripts.translation: 真沒想到，這世上還有這麼善良的人...嗚，我都感動得眼眶溼了...

scripts.text: Would you then bring me a new bridge to use for repair?
scripts.translation: 那能麻煩你帶一段新的橋材來嗎

scripts.text: Since other people can get hurt, I'll use my magic to maintain this bridge in the meantime.
scripts.translation: ？為了不讓其他人受傷，我會先用魔法穩住這座橋。

scripts.text: You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
What if you use magic to repair it?
Hmm, it's not impossible, but magic that deals with creation of life requires much magic power and shouldn't be used so freely.
scripts.translation: 嗯，也不是辦不到。不過，創造生命的魔法需要消耗大量魔力，不能隨便使用。

scripts.text: If I were to describe how stupid that would be... Well, it's like turning a deliciously baked chocolate cake back into flour.
scripts.translation: 要說這有多蠢...就像把烤好的巧克力蛋糕重新變回麵粉。

scripts.text: Since the broken part is about 19 meters from here...
scripts.translation: 斷掉的地方離這裡大約有19米...

scripts.text: Ahh! Now that I remember, before we used to be able to order the exact necessary length, but because they are mass-producing them nowadays, they only provide preset lengths.
scripts.translation: 啊！我想起來了，以前可以按需要訂做特定長度的橋材。不過現在都改成批次生產，只能買到固定長度的了。

scripts.text: To maximize the stability, it's better to avoid connecting multiple bridge pieces together,
scripts.translation: 為了讓橋儘可能穩固，最好不要把多段橋材拼接起來。

scripts.text: and this broken bridge... from here to there it's about 19 meters and the prepieces come in 3 meters = 5 meters, and 10 meters......
scripts.translation: 這座斷橋從這裡到那邊大約有19米，而預製橋材有3米、5米和10米三種長度...

scripts.text: - It's probably just my imagination that smoke is coming out of his head, right? -
scripts.translation: - 他頭上好像在冒煙？大概是我看錯了吧。 -

scripts.text: To make a bridge of 19 meters in length with the fewest number of pieces possible, how many of each 3, 5, or 10 meter length pieces would I need?
scripts.translation: 要用最少的橋材搭出一座19米長的橋，3米、5米和10米的橋材各要幾段？

scripts.text: Please write the number of pieces necessary for each length. If no pieces for that length are necessary, please write 0.
scripts.translation: 請填寫每種長度所需的橋材段數。不需要的長度請填0。

scripts.text: Would there be a better way?
Especially since there wouldn't be a need to make them so straight.
scripts.translation: ？這樣也不用把橋材削得那麼筆直了。

scripts.text: Okay, if you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation: 好，去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利。他會給你新的橋材。

scripts.text: If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation: 去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利，他會給你新的橋材。

scripts.text: If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation: 去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利，他會給你新的橋材。

scripts.text: Oh man, he's still worried about that kind of thing.
scripts.translation: 哎，他居然還在操心那種事。

scripts.text: He's too serious for no reason.
Whoa! This isn't the time to be doing this. I should repair the bridge quickly and help out all the people who fell through.
scripts.translation: 糟了！現在可不是做這個的時候。我得趕快把橋修好，去幫那些掉下去的人。

scripts.text: I would have been toast if it weren't for that tree branch.
scripts.translation: 要不是那根樹枝接住了我，我可就完蛋了。

scripts.text: I told you to be careful!
Exactly how much trouble do you want to cause?
I thought I got rid of them, but it looks like they aren't going to be that easy.
scripts.translation: 喂！我還以為已經甩掉他們了，看來沒那麼容易啊。

scripts.text: We just have not been our best ever since we met.
scripts.translation: 自從遇見我們以後，你就一直沒遇上什麼好事。

scripts.text: Well, I'm going to let it pass this time around, but if you break the bridge again, I'm going to put you in jail!
scripts.translation: 這次就算了。要是你們再把橋弄斷，我就把你們關起來！我

scripts.text: You should know that I am pretty busy myself.
I'll take special caution, so please don't worry.
But for a bridge to break so easily after running a bit, isn't it just too weak?
scripts.translation: 不過，跑了幾步橋就斷了，也太不結實了吧？這樣一來，巨人

scripts.text: Giants couldn't even visit Eclage in this wa...
scripts.translation: 豈不是根本沒法來埃克拉珠了...

scripts.text: Wait! No, it's really a mistake this time!
Even this warning sign tells you that you have to grab onto the hand rails since the bridge is so dangerous.
scripts.translation: 意的！你看！警告牌上都寫著橋很危險，要抓緊扶手。

scripts.text: All I did was just place my hand on it!
scripts.translation: 我只是把手搭上去而已！

scripts.text: Get out of here you troublemaker!!!!
I will come by to help out later even if it's by tying this guy up to a pole.
scripts.translation: 。我晚些會來幫忙，哪怕得先把這傢伙綁在柱子上。

scripts.text: I thought today I might be able to see my friends after finishing up my work.....
scripts.translation: .我還以為今天忙完就能去見朋友...看來

scripts.text: Looks like a long night again.
Since it's not a big fix, I'm sure I can take care of this somehow.
scripts.translation: 這不是什麼大工程，我想辦法應該能修好。唉.

scripts.text: {0} Well, you should get going to Eclage.
You just need to follow this path to the northern part of the city.
scripts.translation: 拉珠了。沿著這條路往前走，就能到城北。

scripts.text: You'll find the main plaza as soon as you enter Eclage, and I'm sure you'll have easy time getting information from all the people there.
scripts.translation: 進城後就是中央廣場，那裡的人應該能告訴你不少訊息。

scripts.text: And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation: 順路幫我轉告朋友格拉西斯一聲，就說我今天去不了了，可以嗎？

scripts.text: I need to start repairing soon...
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation: 我本來約好和朋友們見面，商量即將到來的生日，可眼下實在走不開。真要拜託你幫忙了，不能讓他們一直等。

scripts.text: And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?

scripts.text: I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation: 我本來約好和朋友們見面，商量即將到來的生日，可眼下實在走不開。真要拜託你幫忙了，不能讓他們一直等。

scripts.text: I wanna see my friends real soon.
scripts.translation: 真想早點見到朋友們啊。

scripts.text: - There are just too many types that -
They say that life is nature's greatest invention and death is just a scheme to obtain more life.
scripts.translation: 常有人說，生命是大自然最偉大的發明，而死亡不過是孕育更多生命的一種安排。

scripts.text: However, how about these sprouts that were born by magic- do they have life or not?
scripts.translation: 不過，這些由魔法催生的嫩芽究竟算不算有生命？魔

scripts.text: Would a bridge born by magic be considered dead or not?
scripts.translation: 法造出的橋，究竟算死物還是活物？

scripts.text: Because I spend so much time nurturing a bridge from a seed, it hurts me to see so many getting broken and replaced.
scripts.translation: 我花了那麼多心血，從種子開始培育這些橋。看到它們一再損壞、被替換，實在令人心痛。

scripts.text: Would this be how the times are changing...? That must be why I am creating these objects of tragic destinies.
scripts.translation: 這就是時代變遷嗎...？也許我創造的這些東西，註定要承受這樣的命運。

scripts.text: This seed is named [Goliath] after my name, and it's a plant used as a bridge for its strange ability to grow into two stems and one leaf.
scripts.translation: 這顆種子以我的名字命名為“戈利亞斯”。它會長出兩根莖和一片葉子，形狀奇特，因此被用作橋梁。

scripts.text: Thanks to Goliath, the dire need for bridges has been resolved, but I cannot shake the concern that one day, there are going to be fearsome consequences for utilizing magic to ignore the rules of nature.
scripts.translation: 多虧了戈利亞斯，橋梁短缺的問題總算解決了。但我仍擔心，有一天，濫用魔法、違背自然法則會釀成可怕後果。

scripts.text: I am recently finding encouragement bit by bit as I work with the great Fili who stands next to me here, but one day, I assure you that all of this will be fixed.
scripts.translation: 最近我和身旁這位了不起的菲利一起工作，漸漸又有了幹勁。不過我向你保證，總有一天這一切都會得到解決。

scripts.text: Whenever you are disheartened and discouraged, try approaching Fili with your concerns. You will probably find new insights.
scripts.translation: 若你感到灰心沮喪，不妨找菲利談談，也許會有新的收穫。還有...

scripts.text: And... Mm... the bridge was done while we were just jibber-jabbering.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我們聊著聊著，橋已經修好了。

scripts.text: Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation: 好了，現在可以把這個交給豐了。還有，雖然知道最近

scripts.text: Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation: 最近我一直忙著幫菲利做事，不過橋梁似乎也壞得太頻繁了。

scripts.text: Could it be that the palace noticed how a risky research was being done and sent a person to take care of things?
scripts.translation: 會不會是宮裡發現有人在進行危險研究，派人去處理了？

scripts.text: But why of all people did they entrust my brother with that research?
scripts.translation: 可是為什麼偏偏把這項研究交給我哥哥？

scripts.text: It might be that they took advantage of his inferiority complex toward his physique and his superb intellect.
scripts.translation: 他們或許是利用了他對體格的自卑，以及他過人的才智。

scripts.text: If he succeeded, they might have involved lower-level Laphines into the matter for less than desirable purposes.
scripts.translation: 如果研究成功，他們可能會把低階拉菲尼也捲進來，拿去做不好的用途。

scripts.text: It could have been better off for your brother to have failed.
scripts.translation: 對你哥哥來說，實驗失敗或許反倒是件好事。

scripts.text: Even though it's unfortunate for him.
scripts.translation: 雖然這對他本人來說很不幸。

scripts.text: Could it mean that my brother is...
No, I'm sure there is some way.
I'll recover his body no matter what even if I were to do it by myself.
scripts.translation: 無論如何，就算只能靠我自己，我也要讓他恢復原狀。

scripts.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
You already helped me so much... If so, I'll ask you for even another favor. It's probably going to be the last one.
scripts.translation: 你已經幫我很多了...既然如此，我還想再拜託你一件事。這大概是最後一次了。

scripts.text: All of the ^0000CDingredients^000000 in this research report are very difficult for me to gather myself. {0} I would like to ask for your help.
scripts.translation: 這份研究報告裡列出的材料，光靠我自己很難收集齊。能請你幫忙嗎？ ^0000CD^000000{0}

scripts.text: Ingredients I need are ^0000CDone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要以下材料各一份：拉菲尼翅膀碎片、薩法毛髮、卡勒波迪藥水、純化魔力之石、黑暗盧恩、鮮血盧恩。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: All I can trust is you {0}. Thank you.
Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation: 你把所有材料都帶齊了嗎？

scripts.text: Ingredients I need are ^0000cdone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood ^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要以下材料各一份：拉菲尼翅膀碎片、薩法毛髮、卡勒波迪藥水、純化魔力之石、黑暗盧恩、鮮血盧恩。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Um... Where did you say the items were {0}?
scripts.translation: 那個...，你說的材料放哪兒了？ {0}
沒有材料我就沒法繼續研究。

scripts.text: It must have been really difficult! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation: 你一定費了不少功夫！太感謝你了！

scripts.text: I'll try to continue the research with these.
scripts.translation: 我會試著用這些材料繼續研究。

scripts.text: Thank you for helping me through all of this.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你一路幫我解決這些事。

scripts.text: This is nothing, but it's just a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation: 這點東西不成敬意，就當作我的謝禮吧。

scripts.text: I wish you best of luck in the coming future {0}.
The research is still ongoing. If I had a thread of hope, I would hang on it, but I can't seem to find it just yet.
scripts.translation: 研究還在繼續。哪怕只有一線希望，我也會抓住不放，可目前還沒找到...

scripts.text: Excuse me. You can hear me, right?
scripts.translation: 不好意思，你聽得到我說話吧？

scripts.text: I'm not a bad person. I'm just looking for someone in this prison.
scripts.translation: 我不是壞人，只是來這座監獄找個人。

scripts.text: - The suspicious man doesn't seem to want to talk at all -
scripts.translation: - 那個可疑男子似乎完全不想搭理人。 -

scripts.text: Hey, if you are asked something, would you at least respond?!
scripts.translation: 喂，別人問你話，至少回一句吧？！

scripts.text: All I am trying to do is just deliver this to him!
scripts.translation: 我只是想把東西交給他！

scripts.text: Right? Can you see this? This thing!!!
scripts.translation: 對，你看得見嗎？就是這個！！！

scripts.text: What did you say you have?
- The letter was nowhere to be found -
Yes! A letter! I'm trying to deliver this to him!
scripts.translation: 對！一封信！我正要把它交給他！

scripts.text: Would you know who Wuhuru is?
It looks like ^0000cdyou are Wuhuru^000000. Your little brother wanted me to deliver this ^0000cdletter^000000 to you.
scripts.translation: 看來你就是烏胡魯。你弟弟托我把這封信 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Although I didn't expect the delivery to be this way.
scripts.translation: 0交給你。沒想到送信的過程會這麼曲折。

scripts.text: - You leave Wuhuru alone to read through the letter -
I, I can't believe I did this to my little bro... Is Wuhari alright?
scripts.translation: 我、我竟然對弟弟做了這種事...烏哈里還好嗎？啊...

scripts.text: If you have met Wuhari, as you can see, I didn't look like this originally. My brother and I had ^0000cdparticular small physiques.^000000 even among the lower-level Laphines.
scripts.translation: 既然你見過烏哈里，也看到了，我原本並不是這副模樣。我和弟弟在低階拉菲尼族中都算特別瘦小。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: So among Laphines, who value aesthetics so much, we couldn't help but always feel inferior.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族如此重視外表，我們因此總覺得自己低人一等。

scripts.text: Being physically disadvantaged relative to others, we always studied at home. Thanks to that, we were able to become much smarter than others.
scripts.translation: 因為體格不如別人，我們一直待在家裡讀書。也因此，我們比其他人聰明得多。

scripts.text: One day, a high-level Laphine named ^0000cdMwaridica^000000 came to visit me.
scripts.translation: 有一天，一位名叫姆瓦迪裡卡 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He said that he is a member of a research facility, and that he wanted my help in a secret research project they were working on.
scripts.translation: 0的高階拉菲尼族人來找我。他說自己是研究設施的成員，希望我協助他們進行一項秘密研究。

scripts.text: And that's when he gave me a research report that had some instructions and necessary ingredients.
scripts.translation: 他給了我一份研究報告，裡面寫著實驗步驟和所需材料。那是一項

scripts.text: It was a research project to ^0000cdstrengthen one's physique to make the Laphines stronger and more beautiful^000000.
scripts.translation: 強化拉菲尼族體格、讓他們更強壯也更美麗的研究。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I immediately said yes. For me, it was clearly a way of being recognized. There was no reason for hesitation.
scripts.translation: 我立刻答應了。那顯然是個讓我獲得認可的機會，根本沒有理由猶豫。而

scripts.text: And also, if I were to find the means to make myself bigger...
scripts.translation: 且，要是能找到讓自己長高的方法...

scripts.text: He requested that I wouldn't share any of this information. So I complied with all of his requests.
scripts.translation: 他要求我對這件事保密，我便照他說的做了。連最

scripts.text: I didn't even share it with my brother who I trust so much.
scripts.translation: 信任的弟弟，我都沒有告訴。

scripts.text: I don't know if that was good or bad...
scripts.translation: 我也不知道這樣做究竟是對是錯...

scripts.text: In any case, through much research, I finally had the results right before me.
scripts.translation: 總之，經過大量研究，我終於得到了結果。可

scripts.text: But we had no experimental subjects at hand.
scripts.translation: 當時沒有合適的實驗物件。

scripts.text: So I let myself become one.
And as you can see, the consequence was...
As soon as the experiment failed, that Laphine just withdrew himself right away.
scripts.translation: 實驗一失敗，那位拉菲尼族人就立刻抽身離開了。

scripts.text: I tried to take care of things on my own, but I ultimately ended up here.
scripts.translation: 我試著獨自收拾殘局，最後卻落得被關在這裡。

scripts.text: After obtaining this body, I realize that I'd rather have my small body back.
scripts.translation: 變成這副模樣後，我才發現自己寧願要回原來瘦小的身體。現

scripts.text: As it is now, I am a monster.
scripts.translation: 在的我簡直就是個魔物。

scripts.text: I didn't want this for myself... My greed was excessive.
scripts.translation: 我並不想變成這樣...是我太貪心了。

scripts.text: Only if I had known earlier...
scripts.translation: 要是我早點明白就好了...

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I talked too much.
Regardless, I think it's over for me to get out of here.
scripts.translation: 不管怎樣，我想自己這輩子都出不去了。

scripts.text: If you can make it out of here, could you please let my brother know to figure out a way for me to return to my original self.
scripts.translation: 如果你能離開這裡，能不能告訴我弟弟，請他想辦法讓我恢復原來的樣子？

scripts.text: My brother, he is smaller than I, but has always been the smarter one.
scripts.translation: 弟弟比我還瘦小，卻一直比我聰明。

scripts.text: Have you met Wuhari? What a relief.
scripts.translation: 你見過烏哈里了？那就好。

scripts.text: I can finally relax a little bit even in this prison.
scripts.translation: 在這座監獄裡，我總算能稍微安心一點。

scripts.text: This jail cell feels particularly warm today.
scripts.translation: 今天這間牢房格外暖和。

scripts.text: I saw a dead corpse of a Laphine in the field.
scripts.translation: 我在野外發現了一具拉菲尼族人的屍體

scripts.text: ^0000cdIt was a dead corpse of a high-level Laphine.^000000 The way he seemed was suggestive of the Laphine who requested the research from you.
scripts.translation: 那是一具高階拉菲尼族人的屍體。從他的情況來看，他似乎就是那個找你做研究的人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And I also met someone who witnessed another bigger Laphine chasing after that Laphine before you were imprisoned here.
scripts.translation: 我還遇到一個目擊者。他說，在你被關進這裡之前，曾有另一位體型更大的拉菲尼族人追趕那位高階拉菲尼。
後來，那位高階拉菲尼被殺了。

scripts.text: What are you trying to say?
Are you telling me that I am a murderer?
Did you murder him out of anger?
scripts.translation: 你是因為氣憤才殺了他嗎？

scripts.text: What does it matter even if I were to... Reveal that I am a murderer...?
scripts.translation: 就算我承認...承認自己是殺人犯，又能怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I am trapped in this body no matter what...
scripts.translation: 反正我都被困在這副身體裡了...

scripts.text: He convinced me that the goal of the research was to beautify and strengthen the Laphines and even set me up as the experimental subject!
scripts.translation: 他騙我說，這項研究是為了讓拉菲尼族變得更美、更強，還讓我親自當實驗物件！

scripts.text: And as soon as the experiment failed, he ran away!
scripts.translation: 實驗一失敗，他就逃走了！

scripts.text: He told me the truth only right before his death.
scripts.translation: 直到臨死前，他才把真相告訴我。

scripts.text: His true goal was to prove to his authorities that ^0000cdhis skills as a researcher was for real^000000.
scripts.translation: 他的真正目的，是向上級證明自己確實有研究員的本事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He said that he didn't even examine the content of the experment or the ingredients themselves.
scripts.translation: 他說自己連實驗內容和所用材料都沒仔細看過。

scripts.text: And he also used dirty means to obtain the hair of a Sapha!
scripts.translation: 他還用卑劣的手段弄到了薩法的毛髮！

scripts.text: The palace then discovered the means of this research, chased us down, and captured me for participating in the project.
scripts.translation: 後來宮裡發現了這項研究的內幕，便派人追捕我們。我因為參與研究，也被抓了起來。

scripts.text: What exactly did I do wrong?
I was only a pawn in his ambitious schemes.
scripts.translation: 我不過是他野心計劃中的一枚棋子。

scripts.text: It looks like his goals to engage in the study were similar to your own goals to participate.
scripts.translation: 看來你參與研究的目的，和他找你合作的目的差不多。

scripts.text: While you are a victim of his schemes, it is hard to justify what you have done... But
scripts.translation: 你確實是他陰謀的受害者，但你做過的事也很難讓人原諒...

scripts.text: the way you are imprisoned here seems like you are paying for your actions.
scripts.translation: 不過，你被關在這裡，也算是在為自己的行為付出代價。

scripts.text: Please... don't share this story with Wuhari.
scripts.translation: 求你...別把這些事告訴烏哈里。

scripts.text: Alright, I will act as though I have never made it here.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我會當作從沒來過這裡。

scripts.text: Thank you... I am indebted to you...
scripts.translation: 謝謝你...我欠你一個人情...

scripts.text: Would you please stop appearing out of nowhere?

scripts.translation: 我可是很脆弱、很敏感的！

scripts.text: What's going on! You shocked me!
What are you trying to do to me?
Oh, I was shocked for no reason.
About Wuhuru... Well, I don't really know the messy details...
scripts.translation: 到烏胡魯...具體情況我也不太清楚...

scripts.text: I don't know how a guy who lived so peacefully all his life became like that.
scripts.translation: 他一向過得平靜，真想不通怎麼會變成那樣。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, on the day that it happened, I heard a ^0000cdreally loud scream^000000...
scripts.translation: 說起來，事發那天我聽見一聲特別響的尖叫 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Many in the village were too scared to go out for awhile after hearing that.
scripts.translation: 000...村裡好多人嚇得有一陣子都不敢出門。

scripts.text: And not too long after, many people from the palace came over and took Wuhuru away.
scripts.translation: 沒過多久，宮裡就來了很多人，把烏胡魯帶走了。

scripts.text: For me, it was the first time I got out of the house in a while so all I saw was Wuhuru being captured.
scripts.translation: 那陣子我難得出一次門，所以只看見烏胡魯被抓走。

scripts.text: But Wuhuru's appearance at the time... his appearance...
scripts.translation: 不過烏胡魯當時的樣子...他的樣子...

scripts.text: Anyways, ^0000cdGoatie^000000 was also there with me, so ask him too.
scripts.translation: 總之，山羊仔當時也和我在一起，你去問問他吧。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He's really sharp with these kind of things so he might remember more.
scripts.translation: 0cd他對這類事很敏銳，應該還記得更多。

scripts.text: I came after talking with Masione...
Masione sent you? What's the problem?
scripts.translation: 馬西奧內叫你來的？怎麼了？

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you about Wuhuru.
Oh, you came for Wuhuru. But I don't know much either...
scripts.translation: 哦，你是來打聽烏胡魯的。不過我也不太清楚...

scripts.text: Ah! I just remembered seeing Wuhuru right before that happened!
scripts.translation: 啊！我想起來了，出事前我見過烏胡魯！他和一個

scripts.text: At any rate, in all my days knowing Wuhuru, it's the first time I've seen him so happy.
scripts.translation: 我認識烏胡魯這麼久，還是頭一回見他那麼開心。

scripts.text: When I asked him why he was so happy, he showed me some ^0000cdpieces of paper^000000 and told me that he was going to look great soon...
scripts.translation: 我問他為什麼這麼高興，他給我看了幾張紙，說自己很快就會變得很帥... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And the guy next to him would hint at him to keep quiet...
scripts.translation: 他身旁那人還示意他別聲張...

scripts.text: Well, I was a bit concerned, but seeing him so happy, I couldn't say anything.
scripts.translation: 我當時有些擔心，可看他那麼高興，也就沒多說什麼。

scripts.text: And it was after that when the big accident occurred.
scripts.translation: 那之後不久，就出了那場大事故。

scripts.text: What was the piece of paper?
That thing? Hmm, I don't know. I was too far to tell...
scripts.translation: 那東西嗎？我也不知道，離得太遠，看不清...

scripts.text: That's right, why don't you go see my ^0000cdhusband^000000. He was pretty close to Wuhuru so he might know more.
scripts.translation: 對了，你去問問我丈夫吧。他和烏胡魯走得很近，可能知道得更多。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Did you want to know about something else?
I want to hear about the high-level Laphine who Wuhuru was working with.
scripts.translation: 我想了解烏胡魯合作的那位高階拉菲尼

scripts.text: Oh the high-level Laphine...? Yes~ I remember!
scripts.translation: 哦，那位高階拉菲尼？對~我想起來了！

scripts.text: The stranger who came by with Wuhuru was a high-level Laphine. Are you talking about him?
scripts.translation: 和烏胡魯一起來的陌生人就是高階拉菲尼。你說的是他吧？

scripts.text: If you are talking about him, he quietly left the place after staying with Wuhuru for a bit.
scripts.translation: 要是說那個人，他和烏胡魯待了一陣子後，就悄悄離開了。

scripts.text: After that, Wuhuru would just spend his days in his Yai.
scripts.translation: 從那以後，烏胡魯就一直待在自己的雅伊裡。

scripts.text: But that Laphine, ^0000cdhe did have impressive, beautiful wings that made him seem very elegant, but his gaze and something about him made him very suspicious^000000.
scripts.translation: 不過，那位拉菲尼確實有一雙漂亮又惹眼的翅膀，顯得十分優雅；可他的眼神和舉止都透著可疑。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hmm, come to think of it, ^0000cdPompe told me one day that he saw a terrible thing happening to a high-level Laphine in the land of blooming flowers^000000.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我想起來了，有一天蓬佩告訴我，他在花海之地看見一位高階拉菲尼遭遇了可怕的事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He did say that the Laphine that he saw at the time also had ^0000cdparticularly large and beautiful wings...^000000.
scripts.translation: 他說，當時那位拉菲尼也有特別巨大又漂亮的翅膀... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Go see Pompe and check with him.
Have you ever been to the palace?
They say that it is so much more beautiful than our Yai's could ever be.
scripts.translation: 聽說那裡比我們的雅伊漂亮得多。

scripts.text: I guess people who have nothing can only dream.
scripts.translation: 一無所有的人，大概只能靠做夢了。

scripts.text: Do you need something from me?
I was wondering about the paper that Wuhuru was holding.
scripts.translation: 我想問問烏胡魯手裡那張紙的事

scripts.text: Yeah, that's right. My wife told me that he was holding something like that, but I have no idea what that was.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。我妻子說他當時拿著類似的東西，但我也不知道那到底是什麼。

scripts.text: But who would you be to look for such a thing?
scripts.translation: 不過，你為什麼要找那種東西？

scripts.text: Oh really? Come to think of it, I forgot to tell this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation: 哦，是嗎？說起來，我忘了告訴烏哈里。烏胡魯

scripts.text: Before Wuhuru was caputured away, Wuhuru's ^0000cdletter^000000 was placed on our window.
scripts.translation: 被抓走前，把一封信放在我家窗臺上。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He must have written it in preparation for his fate.
scripts.translation: 他大概是預感到自己的處境，才提前寫了這封信。

scripts.text: He asked me to deliver a sealed ^0000cddocument^000000 to his brother.
scripts.translation: 他托我把一份密封的檔案交給弟弟。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We were so busy that we couldn't meet up with Wuhari even when we heard that he came back around here.
scripts.translation: ！我們實在太忙了。即使聽說烏哈里回到附近，也沒能見到他。

scripts.text: Hmm, I wonder if that sealed document is the paper that my wife was talking about?
scripts.translation: 嗯...妻子說的那張紙，會不會就是這份密封檔案？不管怎

scripts.text: Whatever is it, give this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation: 樣，你把這個交給烏哈里吧。

scripts.text: Let me see... Where did I put it...
I told myself that I'll keep it really safe, and that's why it's like this.
scripts.translation: 我一直提醒自己要把它收好，結果反倒弄成這

scripts.text: It's a bit wrinkled and stained, but it should be just fine to read.
scripts.translation: 樣。雖然又皺又髒，應該還是看得清。
請幫幫那兩個可憐的孩子。

scripts.text: I don't know how nice kids like them became like that...
scripts.translation: 真不明白，那麼好的孩子怎麼會變成那樣...

scripts.text: It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
scripts.translation: 我也想幫她實現心願，可這怎麼可能呢？尤其是我

scripts.text: I know why you are here!
Tsk tsk. How could a young one like you be so forgetful.
scripts.translation: 嘖嘖，年紀輕輕怎麼就這麼健忘？

scripts.text: Do you need something else from me?
A high-level laphine? Hmm? I'm not sure who that was.
scripts.translation: 高階拉菲尼？嗯...我不太清楚是誰。

scripts.text: I never saw him before. And that was also the last time I saw him.
scripts.translation: 我以前從沒見過他，那也是我最後一次見到他。

scripts.text: Why don't you go see my wife? She was with me.
scripts.translation: 你去問我妻子吧，她當時也在場。

scripts.text: My wife is much sharper than me with these kind of things, so she'll probably be more helpful.
scripts.translation: 我妻子比我機靈多了，這種事問她應該更有幫助。

scripts.text: It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
scripts.translation: 我想幫她實現那個願望，但怎麼可能呢？尤其是考慮

scripts.text: Ouch! Whoa! Who is this? Is it a ghost?
Goatie sent you? What's the problem?
Is it because of what they gave me last time? Tell them they have to wait a bit longer.
scripts.translation: 了？是上次給我的東西嗎？告訴他們再等一會兒。

scripts.text: That's not it. I was just curious about the Laphine you saw in the field.
scripts.translation: 不是，我只是想問問你在野外看到的那位拉菲尼。

scripts.text: Whoa! Don't even start with me!
I was doing my business in the field in the middle of a night, but there suddenly appeared two dark shadows!
scripts.translation: 有天半夜我在野外幹活，突然出現了兩道黑影！

scripts.text: At first, a ^0000cdhigh-level Laphine^000000 disappeared into distance so fast, and it was such a beautiful sight that I looked on for a while.
scripts.translation: 先是一位高階拉菲尼飛快地消失在遠方。那景象實在太美，我忍不住看了好一會兒。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: ^0000cdThe wings were really big and pretty.^000000
And then! Not too long after, suddenly!
^0000cdA huge Laphine^000000 was chasing after that high-level Laphine!
scripts.translation: ！！！一隻巨大的拉菲尼追了上去！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I'm not sure if it was because it was so dark at the time, but ^0000cdhis body was so dark^000000 that I couldn't tell who it was.
scripts.translation: 也許是當時太黑了，那傢伙全身漆黑，根本看不清是什麼。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I didn't think much into it and returned home. But some time later a scream, so loud that could shake the entire field, ripped through the air.
scripts.translation: 我沒多想，就回了家。過了一會兒，突然傳來一聲震徹整片野地的尖叫。那

scripts.text: It was such a scary scream.
And I was too afraid to go out for a while after that.
scripts.translation: 從那以後，我嚇得好一陣子都不敢出門。

scripts.text: And a few days ago, when I went out to the field, I saw in the corner ^0000cda big corpse^000000!
scripts.translation: 幾天前我又去野外，在角落裡發現了一具巨大的屍體 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I also saw many ^0000cdsuspicious tree branches^000000 scattered in the area.
scripts.translation: ！附近還散落著許多可疑的樹枝。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It was so disquieting that I didn't get near it...
scripts.translation: 那景象太嚇人了，我沒敢靠近...

scripts.text: Yeah! I don't know what kind of terrible thing happened, but ^0000cda big wing was ripped, and the more I think about it, it looks like the corpse of the Laphine that I saw^000000.
scripts.translation: 是啊！我不知道發生了什麼可怕的事，但有一隻巨大的翅膀被撕裂了。仔細一想，那應該就是我見過的那位拉菲尼。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh dear~~ I don't know why this kind of thing happened so suddenly.
scripts.translation: 天哪~~真不知道怎麼會突然發生這種事。

scripts.text: A high-level Laphine should have great magic powers, but to see him dead so easily, the other huge Laphine must be something else.
scripts.translation: 高階拉菲尼應該有強大的魔力，卻這麼輕易就死了。那隻巨型拉菲尼一定非常可怕。

scripts.text: That's why I'm afraid to go out to the field.
What if that huge Laphine attacks me when I'm out and about in the field?
scripts.translation: 萬一我在野外時，那隻巨型拉菲尼襲擊我怎麼辦？

scripts.text: My kids are too young, and I need to take care of them! I need to stay safe, you see!
scripts.translation: 我的孩子還小，我得照顧他們！我可得保護好自己！

scripts.text: You should stay away, too, if you can.
I wonder where he went. It should be around here...
scripts.translation: 不知道他去哪兒了...應該就在這附近。

scripts.text: Excuse me, if it's not too much trouble, could I talk to you for a second?
scripts.translation: 打擾一下，方便的話能佔用您一點時間嗎？

scripts.text: You really seem like you have an impressive aura.
scripts.translation: 您身上有種不凡的氣質。

scripts.text: I'm sorry? Do I know the way...?
No, no, I'm not someone like that.
I noticed from earlier that you are looking for something. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 我剛才注意到您在找東西。沒錯吧？

scripts.text: Would you like to hear it?
It won't be a waste of your time. To be honest, I'm actually ^0000cdlooking for someone^000000 here too.
scripts.translation: 不會耽誤您太久。說實話，我也在這裡找一個人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: My father hasn't returned home for some time now, and when I visited his work, they said that he hasn't shown up there for a while either.
scripts.translation: 我父親已經有一陣子沒回家了。我去他的工作地點找過，他們說他也好久沒去上班。

scripts.text: He's not one to vanish like that, so I asked around.
scripts.translation: 他不是會這樣不告而別的人，所以我到處打聽。

scripts.text: I heard that people saw him around here, but I can't find a trace of him anywhere.
scripts.translation: 聽說有人在這附近見過他，可我怎麼也找不到他。

scripts.text: Did you try asking the authorities?
I already did. In fact, they were already searching for him.
scripts.translation: 問過了。他們其實也在找我父親。

scripts.text: I'm guessing they didn't make much progress.
scripts.translation: 我猜他們還沒什麼進展。

scripts.text: I'm worried something might have happened to him, so I came out searching for him myself.
scripts.translation: 我擔心他出了什麼事，所以親自出來找他。

scripts.text: So, my suggestion is why don't we help each other find what each other needs throughout this search?
scripts.translation: 不如我們結伴尋找，途中也互相幫忙找各自要找的東西？

scripts.text: What do you think? I'm sure doing this together would be better than doing it alone.
scripts.translation: 你覺得怎麼樣？一起行動總比各自尋找強。

scripts.text: Oh great, that means you'll take my suggestion, right?
scripts.translation: 太好了，那你是願意和我合作了，對吧？

scripts.text: My father is similar to me. ^0000cdHe has particularly large wings and has a generally red aura around him.^000000
scripts.translation: 我父親和我很像。他的翅膀特別大，周身常泛著紅色光暈。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh, really? Why are you looking for my father?
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？你為什麼要找我父親？

scripts.text: Actually, let's talk about this later and search for my father now.
scripts.translation: 這件事我們之後再談，現在先去找我父親吧。

scripts.text: If we find something, let's meet back here.
scripts.translation: 有線索的話，我們就在這裡碰頭。

scripts.text: Oh... I see you haven't yet...
scripts.translation: 您找到什麼了嗎？哦...看來還沒有...

scripts.text: What... Did you say you found something?
Hmm? Where did it go? Did I drop it on the way?
scripts.translation: 咦？東西去哪兒了？我是在路上弄丟了嗎？

scripts.text: - You describe the corpse that you found in the field and show the piece of wing -
scripts.translation: - 你描述了在野外發現屍體的情形，並拿出那片翅膀。 -

scripts.text: Oh, oh....! This is.... Definitely my father's...
scripts.translation: 哦...！這是...肯定是我父親的...嗚..

scripts.text: He's in the eastern part of the field among the tall grasses. Should I accompany you?
scripts.translation: 他在野地東邊的高草叢裡。要我陪你去嗎？

scripts.text: Before that, I would like to hear about why you were looking for my father.
scripts.translation: 在那之前，我想先聽你說說為什麼在找我父親。
- 你講述了烏胡魯的研究經過。 -

scripts.text: My father? He was certainly working on something very hard recently...
scripts.translation: 我父親？他最近確實一直在埋頭研究什麼...

scripts.text: Ah, who in the world... did such a thing...
scripts.translation: 啊...到底是誰做了這種事...

scripts.text: In any case, thanks a lot. You found my father...

scripts.text: This couldn't possibly be enough compensation, but please take it.
scripts.translation: 這點報酬遠不足以表達謝意，請收下吧。

scripts.text: And please tell Wuhuru about my father.

scripts.text: They worked together, so he should hear about my father.
scripts.translation: 胡魯。他們曾一起工作，他有權知道。

scripts.text: Did you need something from me?

scripts.text: I need a piece of your father's wing.

scripts.text: Isn't that what you already have in your hand right now?

scripts.text: What! When did it get here?!
scripts.translation: 什麼！它什麼時候跑到我這裡來的？！

scripts.text: Why would you need a piece of my father's wing...?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼需要我父親的翅膀碎片...？

scripts.text: I see... It resulted from their research together...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...這是他們一起研究造成的結果...

scripts.text: Ok, sure. I will give it to you. I'm sure that's what my father would have liked you to have it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，可以給你。我想父親也會願意把它交給你。

scripts.text: Please tell him I wish him the best.
I went to go see my father.

scripts.translation: 我想在這裡再回憶一會兒父親。

scripts.text: Prontera, the capital of Rune-Midgarts, is filled with beautiful buildings that were thoroughly designed.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲的首都普隆德拉，到處都是精心設計的美麗建築。

scripts.text: Here, they have a leader called 'king,' who used to arrange marriages.
scripts.translation: 這裡的統治者被稱為“國王”，過去還會替人安排婚姻。

scripts.text: There are many arenas, in which warriors race and wrestle to compete with each other.
scripts.translation: 這裡有許多競技場，戰士們會在那裡賽跑、摔跤，一較高下。

scripts.text: The group of winners are supposedly to get some kind of rewards, but seems like it lost its popularity nowadays.
scripts.translation: 據說勝者能得到某種獎勵，不過這些比賽如今似乎已經不流行了。

scripts.text: You need to be careful because there are some people in Prontera with superhuman powers.
scripts.translation: 要小心，普隆德拉有些人擁有超凡的力量。

scripts.text: They're able to destroy any type of weapons or armors with a few punches, and what they use for that is just a small hammer.
scripts.translation: 他們只用幾拳就能砸壞任何武器或盔甲，手裡拿的卻只是一把小錘子。

scripts.text: I don't understand why adventurers keep laying tools at their feet. Could it be that they're priests and people are offering a tribute to them?
scripts.translation: 我不明白冒險者為什麼總把工具放在他們腳邊。難道他們是祭司，人們在向他們獻祭嗎？

scripts.text: There's a village called Payon in the forest. It has a place called 'Palace' as well, although its purpose is unclear.
scripts.translation: 森林裡有個叫斐揚的村莊，那裡還有一處“宮殿”，用途不明。

scripts.text: Maybe it's a place used before Prontera became the capital of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation: 也許那是普隆德拉成為盧恩·米德加茲首都之前留下的...

scripts.text: Humans, too, establish border towns close to the boundary of their residential area, and the city of Aldebaran is one of them.
scripts.translation: 人類也會在居住區邊界附近建立邊境城鎮，阿爾德巴蘭就是其中之一。

scripts.text: In the middle of the village, there are clock-shaped monsters living in a clock tower. Further investigation is needed to find out why monsters appear in the middle of the village.
scripts.translation: 村子中央有座鐘樓，裡面住著鐘形魔物。為什麼村子中央會出現魔物，還得繼續調查。

scripts.text: Although it's called a clock tower, there are more monsters inside than clocks. I personally count them my self, I really did!
scripts.translation: 雖然叫鐘樓，裡面的魔物卻比鍾還多。我自己數過，真的！

scripts.text: Geffen, a city built by great wizards, is characterized by Tower of Wizards in the middle of the city.
scripts.translation: 吉芬是偉大魔法師建造的城市，最顯眼的就是城中央的魔法師之塔。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, there's a fountain in the center of Prontera, a clock tower in Aldebaran, and a tower in Geffen as well.
scripts.translation: 仔細想想，普隆德拉中央有噴泉，阿爾德巴蘭有鐘樓，吉芬也有一座塔。

scripts.text: Maybe human's urban planning is based on symmetry or circular placement. I think it's less sophisticated.
scripts.translation: 人類的城市規劃或許講究對稱或環形佈局。我覺得這可不怎麼高明。

scripts.text: Izlude is a port city and is the gateway to Prontera. Since humans can't fly, they travel in big boxes.
scripts.translation: 依斯魯得是座港口城市，也是通往普隆德拉的門戶。人類不會飛，所以只能坐大箱子旅行。

scripts.text: I'm sure they think that big boxes made a great contribution to their civilization...but is it true?
scripts.translation: 我敢說，他們覺得大箱子對文明貢獻很大...真有那麼神奇嗎？

scripts.text: Alberta is a place that people of Rune-Midgarts visit when they need to travel to other countries.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲的人要去別的國家時，常會經過艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: There are many ships--a moving box that floats on water--ready and people travel on them.
scripts.translation: 那裡有許多船——也就是能浮在水上的移動箱子——人們會搭船出行。

scripts.text: Seriously, human capability is...so disappointing. If they're wise enough, they'll use Warp-portal.
scripts.translation: 說真的，人類的本事真讓人失望...聰明的話，直接用空間傳送術不就好了。

scripts.text: Morocc Village is known to be a place where Morocc, the king of demons, rests.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克村據說是惡魔之王夢羅克的棲身之處。

scripts.text: Making waterways and lakes in the barren inhospitable desert...what an exceptional piece of work for humans.
scripts.translation: 在荒涼的不毛沙漠裡開鑿水道和湖泊...人類還真做了件了不起的事。

scripts.text: I think it's a very peaceful place...at least until monsters appear in the buildings where their leader is burried.
scripts.translation: 我覺得那裡很寧靜...至少在魔物出現在首領長眠的建築裡之前是這樣。

scripts.text: There is the sea in the east of Rune-Midgarts, a desert in the south, forest and vegetation in the middle, and mountains in the north.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲東臨大海，南接沙漠，中部遍佈森林與植被，北部則是群山。

scripts.text: If you ask children to draw a world, wouldn't they draw it like this?
scripts.translation: 如果讓孩子畫出一個世界，他們不也會畫成這樣嗎？

scripts.text: However, it's not an ideal place nor is it a great place to live.
scripts.translation: 不過，那地方既不理想，也不適合居住。

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -

scripts.text: Humans often find great joy in venturing their lives in uncertain future.
scripts.translation: 人類常常會為了未知的未來冒險，並從中獲得極大的樂趣。

scripts.text: Comodo is a place for people who gamble with their future for something called 'fortune.' It seems irrelevant to ruling the kingdom though.
scripts.translation: 克魔島的人為了所謂的“運氣”賭上自己的未來。不過，這似乎跟治理王國沒什麼關係。

scripts.text: Unidentifiable groups such as 'Female and Foot Volleyball' and 'Play Ranking Committee' got rid of games in that city.
scripts.translation: “女子與腳排球”和“遊戲排名委員會”這類來歷不明的團體，把城裡的比賽都取消了。

scripts.text: Comodo was known to be a beach city filled with pleasure, and it used to be a place where you could find all sorts of entertainment. But I can't really say if it's still like that.
scripts.translation: 克魔島曾是座充滿歡樂的海濱城市，過去能在那裡找到各種娛樂。不過現在是否依然如此，我就不清楚了。

scripts.text: There's a female priest, who is admired by the people of the village, and there seems to be good reasons for her existence.
scripts.translation: 村裡有位受人敬仰的女祭司，她的存在似乎自有其道理。

scripts.text: People bring her diamonds as a tribute, and she gives them gods' gifts in return. Although it seems like you have to be pretty lucky to receive it...
scripts.translation: 人們獻上鑽石作為貢品，她則回贈神明的禮物。不過，想得到禮物似乎還得有相當好的運氣...

scripts.text: First of all, I would like to start this book by expressing my respect to the challenging spirit of humans.
scripts.translation: 這本書開篇，我想先向勇於挑戰的人類致敬。

scripts.text: In Umbala, where a gigantic tree forms a village, there are people who challenge themselves to jump off from tall trees for various reasons.
scripts.translation: 汶巴拉是一座由巨樹構成的村莊，那裡的人會因為各種理由挑戰從高樹上跳下。

scripts.text: It's kind of strange if you think about it. I thought jumping off from a tree was a type of coming-of-age ceremony for human males. I can't believe there's another reason for it.
scripts.translation: 仔細想想，這還真奇怪。我以為從樹上跳下來是人類男性的成年禮，沒想到還有別的理由。

scripts.text: Comodo is the only village in the southern part of this continent.
scripts.translation: 克魔島是這片大陸南部唯一的村莊。

scripts.text: Then, what is Paros Lighthouse for?
scripts.translation: 那麼，帕樂斯燈塔又是做什麼用的？

scripts.text: Further investigation is delayed because only a sailor is stationed in that area currently and I couldn't find any evidence to suggest that a political or social organization is involved in that area.
scripts.translation: 目前那一帶只有一名水手駐守，也沒有證據表明那裡有政治或社會團體活動，因此調查只好暫時擱置。

scripts.text: You can get to an island called Bahia by boat, and you can find an underground cave there.
scripts.translation: 乘船可以抵達一座名為巴伊亞的島嶼，島上有個地下洞窟。

scripts.text: The existence of such a deep and long cave in an island is a geographical mystery!
scripts.translation: 島上竟有如此深邃漫長的洞窟，真是地理學上的謎團！

scripts.text: Moreover, would any scholar be able to explain how humans here can breathe without gills in a place filled with water?
scripts.translation: 而且，誰能解釋人類為何能在水下呼吸？那裡明明全是水，他們又沒有鰓。

scripts.text: Prontera is a big city, so ensuring the stable supply of resources is very important.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是座大城市，穩定供應各類資源至關重要。

scripts.text: Especially, the supply of water resources is important for humans are vulnerable and they can't survive even for 30 days without water.
scripts.translation: 尤其是水，人類很脆弱，沒有水連30天都活不了。

scripts.text: Therefore, they built a huge building that looks like a water and sewer facility...
scripts.translation: 所以他們建造了一座巨大的建築，看起來像是供水和排汙設施...

scripts.text: But why can't I find the entrance inside the city? Is it a structural problem? Or is it for security?
scripts.translation: 可為什麼我在城裡找不到入口？是建築結構的問題，還是出於安全考慮？

scripts.text: Glast Heim, the ruins of what was once a great castle.
scripts.translation: 葛拉斯特海姆——一座宏偉古堡的廢墟。

scripts.text: Soon, they're going to reveal what have happened here and the story behind it. So, let's focus on the development of the situation.
scripts.translation: 這裡發生過什麼、背後又有什麼故事，很快就會揭曉。我們還是關注事態的發展吧。

scripts.text: Anyway, there are a number of monsters living together in more than 10 regions; all in the upper and lower parts of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 葛拉斯特海姆的上層和下層分佈著十多個區域，許多魔物在其中棲息。

scripts.text: More detailed geographic information on this region is...so limited that I want to just grab any urban engineer by the collar and start asking.
scripts.translation: 這個地區的詳細地理資料少得可憐...真想揪住哪個城市規劃師的衣領問個明白。

scripts.text: Although human civilization is advanced enough to establish a country, humans are not accumulating knowledge but merely shifting their focus from one to another,
scripts.translation: 人類文明已經發展到足以建立國家，卻沒有積累知識，只是不斷把注意力從一處轉向另一處，

scripts.text: and it seems like they're no longer able to differentiate a certain tree or grass from another.
scripts.translation: 他們似乎連不同種類的樹木和草都分辨不出來。

scripts.text: Otherwise, they wouldn't have named this well-organized forest as 'the mysterious forest.' I can't believe they gave such a strange name to this forest just because they can't find their way out.
scripts.translation: 要不然，他們怎麼會把這片規劃整齊的森林叫作“神秘森林”？僅僅因為找不到路，就起這麼奇怪的名字，真讓人想不通。

scripts.text: They might have believed that language is an exclusive possession of human. But I'm sure they changed their mind after meeting us, the fairies.
scripts.translation: 他們或許曾認為語言是人類獨有的。不過遇見我們這些妖精後，我相信他們改變想法了。

scripts.text: However, they're not surprised to see that some cats, much bigger in size than normal ones, are living in a socialized society and are able to communicate with humans.
scripts.translation: 可他們看到有些貓比普通貓大得多，還能組成社會、與人類交流，居然一點也不驚訝。

scripts.text: There's something I don't know. Should I reveal the truth?
scripts.translation: 有件事我還不清楚。要把真相揭露出來嗎？

scripts.text: Breaking News: Thoughts on a secret place.
scripts.translation: 突發訊息：關於一處秘密地點的見聞

scripts.text: There is constant exploitation and harassment going on in a monastery, not far from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 離普隆德拉不遠的一座修道院裡，剝削和騷擾的事一直在發生。

scripts.text: They lure people who attempt to walk in god's way and make them gather mushrooms or run long distances...why is this acceptable!
scripts.translation: 他們誘騙那些想走在神之道上的人，叫他們採蘑菇或長跑...這怎麼能被允許！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about the northern parts of Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看見一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是一本關於米德加爾特北部的書。 -

scripts.text: Humans continued to float big boxes on water and the sea, and finally, they began to use the sky.
scripts.translation: 人類先讓大箱子漂在江河和海上，後來甚至開始征服天空。

scripts.text: Where are they going next? Underground? Or are they going to transcend time and space?
scripts.translation: 他們下一步要去哪裡？地下？還是要穿越時空？

scripts.text: At this rate, people will be willing to travel to the past. Human's technological advancements require attention.
scripts.translation: 照這樣下去，人類說不定還想回到過去。人類科技的發展可得好好留意。

scripts.text: Einbroch is filled with machines. They don't seem to manufacture a lot of industrial goods, but machines are their weapons definitely.
scripts.translation: 艾音布羅克到處都是機器。這裡似乎不怎麼生產工業品，不過機器肯定就是他們的武器。

scripts.text: What are those numerous factories producing, and for what are people working?
scripts.translation: 那麼多工廠到底在生產什麼？人們又是為了什麼而工作？

scripts.text: Don't they know that civilization development doesn't necessarily improve the value of life?
scripts.translation: 他們難道不知道，文明進步未必能提升生活的價值嗎？

scripts.text: If you take a train in Einbroch, you can get to a village called Einbech.
scripts.translation: 從艾音布羅克搭火車，就能到達一個叫艾音貝赫的村莊。

scripts.text: Of course I hate this form of transportation (smells like iron too much), but it's a useful for humans because of its cheap price and transport capacity.
scripts.translation: 我當然討厭這種交通工具（鐵鏽味實在太重），不過它價格便宜、載貨量大，對人類來說倒是很實用。

scripts.text: By the way, don't they have enough materials to make railroad tracks? When will they make extensions to the train routes?
scripts.translation: 說起來，他們的材料還不夠鋪鐵軌嗎？什麼時候才會延長火車路線呢？

scripts.text: Hugel, a small rural village, is like Comodo of southern region.
scripts.translation: 毀葛是座小鄉村，就像南方的克魔島。

scripts.text: There are a variety of mini games and the landscape is very idyllic as well.
scripts.translation: 那裡有各種小遊戲，風景也很田園。

scripts.text: But aren't those entertainment facilities supposed to be in the center of a country?
scripts.translation: 不過，這些娛樂設施不是應該建在國家中心地帶嗎？

scripts.text: A city called Juno is even floating in the sky! How incredible is this.
scripts.translation: 竟然有座叫朱諾的城市漂浮在空中！太不可思議了。

scripts.text: And there is a special reward for those who escape the maze: there is a place where rebirth is given.
scripts.translation: 逃出迷宮的人還能獲得特別獎勵：那裡有個能讓人轉生的地方。

scripts.text: Humans are truly scary. But I feel like I've seen this maze somewhere...
scripts.translation: 人類真可怕。不過，我好像在哪裡見過這個迷宮...

scripts.text: In Rahel, the capital of Arunafeltz, there lives a small, cute, and white creature that seems really soft.
scripts.translation: 阿魯納佩斯首都拉赫的居民中，有一種小巧可愛、通體雪白，看起來軟綿綿的生物。

scripts.text: If you thought of Siroma, you are wrong. It's not marine either.
scripts.translation: 如果你想到小雪獸，那就錯了。它也不是海洋生物。

scripts.text: The answer is a girl who is both a priest and a leader. This is because Arunafeltz is a theocratic entity.
scripts.translation: 答案是一位女孩，她既是祭司，也是領袖。畢竟阿魯納佩斯是個神權國家。

scripts.text: In the plains of Audhumbla, there lives many monster flowers and herbivore animals.
scripts.translation: 奧丁神殿原野上生活著許多魔物花和食草動物。

scripts.text: Although one would think that they are not herbivores seeing how they attack humans, but
scripts.translation: 看到它們攻擊人類，你或許會覺得它們不像食草動物，不過——

scripts.text: if they were really carnivores, what food would they live on? Moreover, there is no record of them eating the adventurers who travel by after attacking them.
scripts.translation: 如果它們真是肉食動物，又靠什麼為生呢？而且，它們攻擊路過的冒險者後，也沒有把人吃掉的記錄。

scripts.text: Veins, a village built on a hill, seems like a well-planned city.
scripts.translation: 伯仁斯這座建在山丘上的村莊，看起來規劃得井井有條。

scripts.text: While it's confusing to know where you would exit and enter from, but
scripts.translation: 雖然讓人摸不著頭腦，不知道該從哪裡進出，不過——

scripts.text: if you want to see interesting sights such as a stone eating up a coin you dropped, it's a good place to visit.
scripts.translation: 如果你想看看石頭吞掉你掉落的硬幣之類的奇景，這裡倒值得一遊。

scripts.text: There was also a place that was extremely hot somewhere in Arunafeltz..
scripts.translation: 阿魯納佩斯某處還有個熱得驚人的地方...

scripts.text: The heat there felt like it would burn through my wings in their entirety. The residents of that place also did not seem very friendly.
scripts.translation: 那裡的熱浪像是要把我的翅膀整個燒焦，居民看起來也不太友善。

scripts.text: So I had to stop the expedition. I hope that you, the readers, would also distance yourselves from that place.
scripts.translation: 所以我只好中止探險。讀者們也最好離那地方遠點。

scripts.text: Well...It's not that I was afraid of the guardian there, you see!
scripts.translation: 我可不是害怕那裡的守衛哦！

scripts.text: In Lighthalzen, there is a colossal building constructed by technicians. Although what they exactly do in there is a little suspicious...
scripts.translation: 裡希塔樂鎮有座由技術人員建造的巨型建築，他們在裡面究竟做什麼，實在令人起疑...

scripts.text: I'm not sure if a profit-seeking corporation should be doing something like that.
scripts.translation: 我不確定以營利為目的的企業是否該做這種事。

scripts.text: It's also very strange that clean and dirty areas in the city are divided...
scripts.translation: 而且，城裡的乾淨區和髒亂區竟然分得涇渭分明...

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about various regions in Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本書，伸手去拿。我想那是介紹米德加爾特各地的書。 -

scripts.text: If you ride the boats in Alberta, you can get to various destinations.
scripts.translation: 從艾爾貝塔搭船，可以前往許多地方。

scripts.text: I don't know why so many of these boats end up at Alberta specifically, but for that, traveling is much easier.
scripts.translation: 不知道為什麼那麼多航線都從艾爾貝塔出發，不過這樣旅行確實方便多了。

scripts.text: Places you can reach through Alberta are as follows.
scripts.translation: 從艾爾貝塔可以前往這些地方：

scripts.text: A country of Gods, Amatsu, a place of refuge, Kunlun, Luoyang where many martial art experts reside, Ayothaya in which a huge sculpture is present, and many others.
scripts.translation: 諸神之國天津町、避世之地崑崙、武術高手雲集的洛陽、矗立著巨大雕像的哎喲泰雅，還有許多別處。

scripts.text: I can see that more places would be available in the future as delegates from many other countries are arriving there more recently.
scripts.translation: 最近許多國家的使節都抵達了那裡，看來今後還會有更多地方開放通行。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is one famous destination.
scripts.translation: 有個地方是搭船能去的著名目的地。

scripts.text: Regrettably for them, they didn't take me just because I am a lone traveler. It wasn't even that they would give me a discount on the boat ride.
scripts.translation: 可惜他們沒肯載我這個獨自旅行的人，連船票折扣都不給。

scripts.text: As a scholar, I couldn't be more enraged by the ignorance of the Jawaii-bound ship's captain. Even during wars, historians are exempt from hostility.
scripts.translation: 身為學者，我對那位前往爪哇伊的船長的無知怒不可遏。即使身處戰亂，歷史學家也不該遭受敵意。

scripts.text: Also from Alberta, there is an island known for its high concentration of turtles.
scripts.translation: 從艾爾貝塔還能前往一座以海龜眾多聞名的島嶼。

scripts.text: There are no regular routes, but after a long research, I found out that there is a captain who travels specifically to that place.
scripts.translation: 那裡沒有固定航線，不過經過一番調查，我發現有位船長專程前往。

scripts.text: Upon getting there, there were many exotic turtles including cold turtles, hot turtles, and ninja turtles.
scripts.translation: 到了那裡，我看見各種奇特的烏龜：冰龜、火龜，還有忍者龜。

scripts.text: From Clock Tower Village, I could arrive at a snowing village through an elderly man who wears thick, red clothes all year around.
scripts.translation: 從鐘樓村出發，找一位全年穿著厚重紅衣的老人，就能抵達一座雪村。

scripts.text: The entire village was covered by snow, and as expected from a place that is preparing for a celebration, the atmosphere was great.
scripts.translation: 整個村莊都被白雪覆蓋。那裡正在籌備慶典，氣氛果然很熱鬧。

scripts.text: Inside the village, there was also a place that produces toys for children, but for some reason, they chased me out.
scripts.translation: 村裡還有一家生產玩具的工廠，不知為何，他們卻把我趕了出來。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is a small island where a wrecked ship rests.
scripts.translation: 搭船能去的地方中，還有一座小島，擱淺的船隻就停在那裡。

scripts.text: I'm not sure if the ship was to be salvaged, but it was already occupied by strange creatures.
scripts.translation: 我不清楚那艘船是不是準備打撈，不過已經有奇怪的生物佔據了那裡。

scripts.text: The main god of the faith practiced in this continent is Odin. Accordingly, there is a temple for Odin as well.
scripts.translation: 這片大陸信奉的主神是奧丁，因此也建有奧丁神殿。

scripts.text: I was also outcasted here. People had no conception of hospitality and generosity toward outsiders.
scripts.translation: 我在那裡也被排斥了。人們對外來者毫無待客之道，更談不上慷慨。

scripts.text: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
scripts.translation: 村子南邊有幾個碼頭。我調查了很久，想弄清楚它們的用途，卻始終沒有頭緒。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
scripts.translation: 後來我跟著偷偷使用碼頭的冒險者，總算發現了他們前往的地方。

scripts.text: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
scripts.translation: 那地方令人毛骨悚然，我在那裡看到的景象也著實令人震驚。

scripts.text: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.
scripts.translation: 冒險者理應記錄所見的一切，但這件事涉及政治敏感內容，不便公開，就說到這裡吧。

scripts.text: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
scripts.translation: 村子南邊有幾個碼頭。我調查了很久，想弄清楚它們的用途，卻始終沒有頭緒。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
scripts.translation: 後來我跟著偷偷使用碼頭的冒險者，總算發現了他們前往的地方。

scripts.text: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
scripts.translation: 那地方令人毛骨悚然，我在那裡看到的景象也著實令人震驚。

scripts.text: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.
scripts.translation: 冒險者理應記錄所見的一切，但這件事涉及政治敏感內容，不便公開，就說到這裡吧。

scripts.text: Breaking News! Prontera's Issue Maker!! Exclusive Interview!!
scripts.translation: 突發新聞！普隆德拉的問題人物！！獨家專訪！！

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Hi, everyone. We have Mr. Hollgrehen, the master of refinement, here with us today. Hi, Mr. Hollgrehen.
scripts.translation: [記者]：大家好！今天請到精煉大師霍爾格倫先生。您好，霍爾格倫先生。
[霍爾格倫]：你好，很高興見到你。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: What made you devote yourself to refinement for the last 10 years?
scripts.translation: [記者]：是什麼讓您在過去十年裡一直專注於精煉？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I went to a swimming pool when I was little, and I could just float in the water even though I didn't know how to swim. I could just do it. That's how I started working as a refiner.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：小時候我去過游泳池，明明不會游泳，卻能漂在水面上。我就這麼漂起來了。這就是我後來成為精煉師的原因。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: What? You float well? Hmm? It sounds weird..
scripts.translation: [記者]：什麼？您很會漂浮？嗯？聽起來有點奇怪...

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Have you ever done refining in the water? Don't even start if you've never done it.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：你試過在水裡精煉嗎？沒試過就別妄下評論。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Okay, I see. I heard you have an amazing skill. What is it?
scripts.translation: [記者]：原來如此。聽說您有一項驚人的本領，是什麼呢？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I can refine objects with my eyes closed.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：我能閉著眼睛精煉物品。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Isn't that why you're breaking objects?
scripts.translation: [記者]：所以您才老是把東西弄壞嗎？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Have you ever done refining with your eyes closed? Don't even start if you've never done it.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：你閉著眼睛精煉過嗎？沒試過就別妄下評論。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: I see.. Could you show us then? Let's start with something lighter, like...a knife?
scripts.translation: [記者]：這樣啊...能現場示範一下嗎？先拿輕一點的東西，比如...小刀？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I don't do cheap weapons like that. It should be at least level 4.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：我可不精煉那種便宜武器。至少得是四級武器。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Huh? Cheap weapons? You're kidding, right?
scripts.translation: [記者]：啊？便宜武器？您是在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I don't tell jokes. Oh good, you're holding an '+9 Ice Pick.' Give it to me. I'll upgrade it to 10.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：我從不開玩笑。哦，你手上這把是+9破甲短錐吧？給我，我把它升到+10。
[霍爾格倫]：爾格倫]：嗚啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Hahaha, maybe I don't feel very well today. Oh! Today is Sunday, right? I forgot that sundays are not good for refining weapons. Maybe, armors will do. Right, it will definitely float.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：哈哈，今天狀態可能不太好。哦，今天是星期天吧？我忘了星期天不適合精煉武器。也許盔甲可以。對，盔甲肯定浮得起來。

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: This is a pretty good armor. Is this +7 High Risk Valkyrie's Armor?
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：-[霍爾格倫]：這盔甲不錯啊。是+7高等瓦爾基里之鎧嗎？
[霍爾格倫]：爾格倫]：嗚啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Now that I think about it, today is a even-day. Even-days are not good for armor refining. Right, shoes will float well.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：仔細想想，今天是雙數日。雙數日不適合精煉盔甲。對了，鞋子肯定浮得起來。

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Hey, you're pretty well off. These are +9 Dull Black Leather Boots. I'll make you even richer.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：。 -[霍爾格倫]：你還挺有錢啊。這是+9黑色皮革長靴。讓我給你升升級。
[霍爾格倫]：爾格倫]：嗚啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Oh, now that I see the calendar, today is the first Sunday of this month. For some reason, I couldn't refine shoes well on first sundays. Right, today's perfect for clothes!!
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：哦，看日曆才想起來，今天是這個月第一個星期天。不知為什麼，我每逢第一個星期天都精煉不好長靴。對了，今天適合精煉衣服！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: It's +9 Wandering Valkyrie's Cape. Good, I'll upgrade this to 10 for sure.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：這是+9流浪者瓦爾基里斗篷。好，我一定能把它升到+10。
[霍爾格倫]：爾格倫]：嗚啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Hahaha, I think I had something really important...I should go now.
scripts.translation: [霍爾格倫]：哈哈哈，我剛才好像有件要緊事...我該走了。

scripts.text: We apologize for not completing the interview due to the reporter's condition. - Editors.
scripts.translation: 由於記者身體不適，本次採訪未能完成。——編輯部
《盧恩·米德加茲月刊》十一月號

scripts.text: This month's reader's memoir is on Malangdo, an island of cats. Aren't you excited to find out what's going on in Malangdo?!
scripts.translation: 本月的讀者遊記帶你探訪貓島馬蘭島。你不好奇馬蘭島上發生了什麼嗎？！
探訪馬蘭島 × 精煉記錄 ○

scripts.text: Malangdo, an island of cats. So soft and tender, ah...it's an island filled with lovely cats. Aww, what should I do...they're all so cute and lovely that I wanted to hug...
scripts.translation: 馬蘭島，貓咪之島。軟綿綿、毛茸茸，啊...島上滿是可愛的貓咪。哎呀，我該怎麼辦...它們都太可愛了，好想抱一抱...

scripts.text: them...yes, I wanted to, until I met these scary father cat and his daughter.
scripts.translation: 它們...是啊，我本來想抱抱它們，直到遇見那隻可怕的貓爸爸和他的女兒。

scripts.text: Yes, I was waiting to catch the King Octopus. I guess it was when I was passing by a boat? I met a cat with slanted eyes.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我當時在等國王章魚。大概是經過一艘船時吧？我遇見了一隻眯眯眼的貓。

scripts.text: That cat introduced himself and told me that he studied in Morocc.
scripts.translation: 那隻貓自我介紹說，他曾在夢羅克留學。

scripts.text: Then he assured me that he could upgrade my +9 Violet Fear to +10 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 接著他拍胸脯保證，能把我的+9納戶特基格的雙劍精煉成+10。

scripts.text: He sounded so reliable since he studied abroad and all that, right? So I trusted him and gave him my +9 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 他留過洋，聽起來特別可靠，對吧？所以我信了他，把+9納戶特基格的雙劍交給了他。

scripts.text: Then my +9 Violet Fear shattered into pieces. I was so shocked because it was the only weapon that I had.
scripts.translation: 結果我的+9納戶特基格的雙劍碎成了片。我震驚極了，因為那是我唯一的武器。

scripts.text: I spent all of my money to buy a Enriched Oridecon, too. Right, I couldn't trust him 100% even if he studied abroad.
scripts.translation: 我還花光了所有錢買了一塊濃縮神之金屬。是啊，就算他留過洋，我也不該百分之百相信他。

scripts.text: So I comforted myself and mourned for my +9 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 我只能安慰自己，為碎掉的+9納戶特基格的雙劍默哀。

scripts.text: But that wasn't the end. After that, a little cat approached me, saying she has a hammer that can refine even the stars in the sky.
scripts.translation: 可事情還沒完。後來一隻小貓湊過來，說她有把連天上的星星都能精煉的錘子。

scripts.text: A hammer that refines the starts in the sky! Doesn't it sound awesome? Since I lost my only weapon, I thought I should strengthen my armors. So I gave her everything I had.
scripts.translation: 能精煉天上的星星！聽起來多厲害啊？既然我失去了唯一的武器，就想著至少強化一下防具。於是把身上所有東西都交給了她。

scripts.text: Shoes, clothes, armor, and even helmet...everything I had is just gone...now that I think about it, she said it's a hammer that can refine the stars of the sky.
scripts.translation: 鞋子、衣服、盔甲，連頭盔都沒剩下...我所有東西全沒了...現在想想，她只說那是能精煉星星的錘子。

scripts.text: But she didn't say it doesn't break things, right? So, if you ever visit Malando, be aware of those cats called 'Strip' and 'Shatter.' I'm a Rune Knight and I still catch Porings...you don't want to be like me...
scripts.translation: 可她沒說不會把裝備敲壞，對吧？所以你要是去馬蘭島，小心那些叫“Strip”和“Shatter”的貓。我堂堂盧恩騎士，結果還在抓波利...你可別學我...

scripts.text: This is a story of 'Appearing in Morocc Chocheon****.'
scripts.translation: 這是一個關於“夢羅克晨星****現身”的故事。

scripts.text: You are working for.. The king.
This the prison where we put criminals.
scripts.translation: 這裡是關押罪犯的監獄。外

scripts.text: Hey Guard~ I think the humidity here is too high. My skin is gonna be ruined. Is that ok? Huh?
scripts.translation: 喂，衛兵~我覺得這裡溼氣太重了，皮膚都要變差了。這樣沒問題嗎？嗯？

scripts.text: ^000099Looking tired, the prison guard glances at the prisoner. He seems irritated from constantly bickering with the prisoner.^000000
scripts.translation: 獄卒疲憊地瞥了囚犯一眼。他似乎被囚犯沒完沒了的爭吵惹惱了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Mr. Clever, you have to understand this. You are currently under a sentence as a prisoner.
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼先生，你得明白，你現在是囚犯，正在服刑。

scripts.text: Yes, I know. I know that. So please bring me some kind of furnace up here. The humidity is too much and making everything really sticky.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道。那就給我搬個爐子來吧。這裡太潮了，弄得渾身黏糊糊的。

scripts.text: Don't you get it? There's no such thing as making the conditions favorable for a prisoner to serve their sentence.
scripts.translation: 你還不明白嗎？囚犯服刑可沒有改善待遇這一說。

scripts.text: ^000099The guard, holding his anger, just returns to his position. He is too gracious in letting the prisoner have his way.^000000
scripts.translation: 獄卒強忍怒火，回到了崗位。他對囚犯也未免太縱容了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Oh! You are the one from earlier. I'm so thankful that you're here! Please help me out. I can't seem to take care of things here.
scripts.translation: 哦，你就是剛才那位！太感謝你來了，請幫幫我。我實在應付不了這裡的狀況。

scripts.text: Don't you look elsewhere~ Don't you talk with other prisoners~ Look at me, only me~~ Be good to me when I'm with you~~
scripts.translation: 別東張西望~別跟別的囚犯說話~眼裡只准有我~~跟我待在一起時，要乖乖聽話哦~~

scripts.text: ^000099The situation was immediately understandable. The prison guard was in need of someone to help him out with the prisoner.^000000
scripts.translation: 情況一目瞭然：獄卒需要有人幫忙對付這個囚犯。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Well I didn't submit a requisition...
An official request? No, it's not even necessary. You came to visit Mr. Clever, right? Here, look. It's already been recorded.
scripts.translation: 正式申請？不用，完全沒必要。你是來探望聰明鬼先生的吧？你看，這裡已經登記好了。

scripts.text: ^000099It's probably better not to randomly make up an official record right in front of me.^000000
scripts.translation: 當著我的面隨便編造官方記錄，恐怕不太合適吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You are here.{0}I don't know what you did but Mr. Clever is quiet now.
scripts.translation: 你來了。不知道你做了什麼，不過聰明鬼先生現在安靜了。 {0}

scripts.text: Do I need to fill out a visitation form?
scripts.translation: 我需要填寫探視申請嗎？

scripts.text: No, no! What are you saying...{0}Your prison visits are welcome at any time. I'll do it for you especially if it's for Mr. Clever!
scripts.translation: 不不！你說什麼呢...隨時歡迎你來探監。尤其是探望聰明鬼先生，我一定幫你安排！ {0}

scripts.text: ^000099Yeah, I keep thinking about it. It's probably better not to randomly make up an official record right in front of me.^000000
scripts.translation: 嗯，我也是這麼想的。最好別當著我的面隨便編造官方記錄。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: {0}Are you already leaving? Ah... That's no good~ It just got quiet!!
scripts.translation: 你這就要走了嗎？啊...別呀~這裡才剛安靜下來！！ {0}

scripts.text: Well, I thought my time for the visit was over...
scripts.translation: 我還以為探視時間已經結束了...

scripts.text: What! What are you talking about? {0} Is the time for a visitation a problem for you? Here.. I will extend it for 3 hours!
scripts.translation: 什麼！你在說什麼？探視時間不夠嗎？來，我給你延長三小時！ {0}

scripts.text: ^000099How he makes things up so randomly... I don't have anything to say anymore...^000000
scripts.translation: 他怎麼什麼都能隨口編出來...我都不知道該說什麼了... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Has Clever been giving you problems again?...
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼又給你添麻煩了嗎？...

scripts.text: It's not a song. {0}when you are not here, Mr. Clever keeps chanting some kind of spell and tortures me!
scripts.translation: 那才不是歌。你不在的時候，聰明鬼先生一直念著什麼咒語折磨我！ {0}

scripts.text: Since you are here, let me first record this for you!
scripts.translation: 既然你來了，我先把這件事替你登記一下！

scripts.text: ^000099I'm getting used to this with his making stuff up all the time now.^000000
scripts.translation: 他總是這麼胡編亂造，我都快習慣了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text: ^000099Clever is still deep asleep. Be careful not to awaken him.^000000
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼還在熟睡。小心別把他吵醒。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Clever scribbled a map on my hand. It looks like the place where the books are.^000000
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼在我手上畫了張地圖，看起來像是藏書的地方。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099I see Clever working hard with his writing tools. It must be the new history report. ^000000
scripts.translation: 我看見聰明鬼正拿著筆認真寫東西。那一定是新的歷史報告。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Mm? Who are you? You aren't a visitor. Guard~!!! Guard~!!! There is a suspicious person here! What are you doing not taking him away?!
scripts.translation: 嗯？你是誰？你不是來探監的。衛兵~！！！衛兵~！！！這裡有個可疑人物！怎麼還不把他帶走？！

scripts.text: Hmm, In any case, I've never seen you before. Why are you here to visit me?
scripts.translation: 嗯，總之我以前沒見過你。你為什麼來看我？

scripts.text: I never wanted to visit you either.
Oh~ Really? Ok, you get out of here. I'm going to start torturing the guard. Let's see... Alright, I'll sing to him!
scripts.translation: 哦~真的？那你滾吧。我要開始折磨那個獄卒了。讓我想想...好，我給他唱歌！

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as Clever starts singing, the guard looks at me in exhaustion. Of course, it was torture for myself as well.^000000
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼一開口唱歌，獄卒就疲憊地看向我。當然，對我來說這也是一種折磨。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: For what crime? Why do you ask such a boring question?
scripts.translation: ？犯了什麼罪？幹嘛問這麼無聊的問題？

scripts.text: I thought you were kind of interesting, seeing how you come to visit a stranger. How disappointing~ I'm going to sing the rest of this tune.
scripts.translation: 我還以為你會來看一個陌生人，應該挺有趣的呢。真失望~我要把這首歌唱完。

scripts.text: ^000099I saw real fear and despair in the guard's face. The prisoner known as Clever was getting ready to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: 我從獄卒臉上看到了真切的恐懼與絕望。名叫聰明鬼的囚犯正要開唱。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Please, I ask you. Please shut Mr. Clever's mouth. I've been listening to him for a year now and it's driving me insane. I can't beat a prisoner either...
scripts.translation: 求求你，幫幫我。讓聰明鬼先生閉嘴吧！我聽他唱了一整年，快被逼瘋了。我又不能打囚犯...

scripts.text: Don't you look elsewhere~ Don't you talk with other prisoners~ Look at me, only me~~ Be good to me when I'm with you~~
scripts.translation: 別東張西望~別跟別的囚犯說話~眼裡只准有我~~跟我待在一起時，要乖乖聽話哦~~

scripts.text: The prisoner is singing a song that seems to come from another dimension.
scripts.translation: 囚犯正在唱一首彷彿來自異世界的歌。

scripts.text: Wait! Wait! Stop your singing for a minute!
Hmm? Why? Do you have an interesting story?
scripts.translation: 嗯？為什麼？你有有趣的故事要講嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him about the journey until now.

scripts.translation: 告訴他米德加爾特的事

scripts.text: Ask him what he wants to eat.
Hmm. What do I want to eat? I have lots of things I want to eat. After all, I've been eating stale prison rice all this time. I had one thing in particular.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我想吃什麼？想吃的可多了。畢竟我一直都在吃難吃的牢飯。有一樣東西我尤其想念。

scripts.text: At one point, some adventurer shared with me as a present some ^000099Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000 and it was really refreshing.
scripts.translation: 以前有位冒險者送過我葡萄果汁草藥茶，喝起來特別清爽。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you bring me ^0000991 cup of Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000, I'll tell you various gossip stories of Eclage in return. How's that?
scripts.translation: 給我帶一杯葡萄果汁草藥茶，我就告訴你一些埃克拉珠的秘聞。怎麼樣？ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Alrighty~ It was nice meeting you. I'm going to sing the rest of this tune.
scripts.translation: 好吧~見到你很高興。我要把這首歌唱完了。

scripts.text: Ho~ Ok, then shall I wait for you getting some sleep?
scripts.translation: 呵~好吧，那我等你去睡一覺再來？

scripts.text: Hmm hmm.. Let me think for a bit...
^000099He looks like he won't wake up until I bring back some Grape Extract Herb Tea.^000000
scripts.translation: 看來不帶葡萄果汁草藥茶回來，他就不會醒。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Wow, you really brought me some. In any case, did you even request a visit? Hey~ Guard!! Don't you have to see if this guy came here with a formal visitation request? Random people can't be in here!
scripts.translation: 哇，你真的給我帶來了。對了，你申請探監了嗎？喂~衛兵！！你不該查查這傢伙有沒有正式探視許可嗎？可不能讓隨便什麼人進來！

scripts.text: NO I DON'T HAVE TO! I DON'T HAVE TO CHECK!
scripts.translation: 我才不用檢查！不用檢查！

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's irritated voice screamed from afar.^000000
scripts.translation: 遠處傳來獄卒惱火的吼聲。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Well, the guard says it's ok. Thanks for bringing it to me. Since I am a prisoner, I don't have much to give aside from praying for a blessing upon home tree.
scripts.translation: 嗯，獄卒說可以。謝謝你把茶帶來。我身為囚犯也沒什麼能給你的，就替你向家園之樹祈求祝福吧。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你獲得了家園之樹的祝福，並得到基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Whew~ How refreshing. You are the only visitor I could appreciate this entire past year of imprisonment.
scripts.translation: 呼~真舒服。這一年牢獄生活裡，你是唯一讓我覺得開心的訪客。

scripts.text: Yes, that's right~ I did promise you that.
There's so many. Why don't you choose one among these topics.
scripts.translation: 秘聞可多了。你挑個話題吧。

scripts.text: A story about the Seneth King's father
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王父親的故事

scripts.text: A story about Seneth King's arsony
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王縱火的故事

scripts.text: The assistant chief of staff's real name
A dimensional rift in nearby regions
This is a secret gossip related to the old king. Have you heard about a first-rate criminal named Florence? He was a first-rate criminal, but he was the father of an old king named Seneth.
scripts.translation: 這是和老國王有關的秘密。你聽說過一流罪犯弗洛倫斯嗎？他雖是個大罪犯，卻是老國王塞內斯的父親。
