scripts.text: What crime did he commit? Haha, no one knows that. But in Eclage, ^000099it's actually prohibited to mention the name Florence^000000.
scripts.translation: 他到底犯了什麼罪？哈哈，沒人知道。不過在埃克拉珠，提起弗洛倫斯的名字其實是禁忌。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you mention his name, you might be in the same situation as I am.
scripts.translation: 你要是提起他的名字，說不定也會落得和我一樣的下場。

scripts.text: There's also a secret tale about Florence's son, King Seneth. Because of his low self-esteem related to having a criminal father, he is a king who implemented radical policies.
scripts.translation: 還有一段關於弗洛倫斯之子塞內斯王的秘聞。他因為父親是罪犯而自卑，因此推行了激進的政策。

scripts.text: There are also rumors that he had a mental illness, I don't know to what degree that is true. I heard that he actually chewed through the stem of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 還有傳言說他精神不太正常，具體是真是假我也不知道。聽說他甚至啃斷了世界樹的樹幹。

scripts.text: Can you imagine? What it could mean for the Mayor to cause harm to Yggdrasil? It's a terrible thing.
scripts.translation: 你想想看，市長傷害世界樹意味著什麼？這可是件可怕的事。

scripts.text: There are rumors that after disconnecting himself from Yggdrasil, he grew sicker and sicker, and ultimately set himself on fire.
scripts.translation: 據說他與世界樹斷開聯絡後，病情日益加重，最後還放火燒了自己。

scripts.text: Of course, it's just a hearsay, so I can't guarantee that it's true, but I'm positive that ^000099he was the first Mayor to break the relationship with Yggdrasil^000000.
scripts.translation: 當然，這只是傳聞，我不能保證屬實。不過我敢肯定，他是第一位與世界樹斷絕聯絡的市長。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: This is a story that most Laphines don't recognize. The assistant chief of staff Shenime's real name is not Shenime.
scripts.translation: 大多數拉菲尼族都不知道這件事：參謀長謝尼梅的真名並不是謝尼梅。

scripts.text: But no one remembers what is real name is. It's the same with me. It's as if a giant eraser stormed through the mind.
scripts.translation: 但沒人記得他的真名，我也一樣。就像腦海裡刮過一陣橡皮擦風暴，把一切都抹掉了。

scripts.text: All I know for sure is that Shenime is not his real name. So I conjured up an interesting story. Do you happen to know what it means to control the public?
scripts.translation: 我只確定謝尼梅不是真名，所以編了個有趣的故事。你知道操縱輿論意味著什麼嗎？

scripts.text: If you have a strong ability in controlling the public, I could make you believe that not just my name but my face also ^000099are my original ones even if they really weren't^000000.
scripts.translation: 只要擅長操縱輿論，我就能讓你相信我的名字和長相都是原本的模樣，即使它們根本不是。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Shenime formed that kind of identity... Or rather, changed into such an identity. But this is also one of many rumors. Heh.
scripts.translation: 謝尼梅塑造了那樣的身份...或者說，變成了那種身份。不過這也只是眾多傳聞之一。呵。

scripts.text: I don't mean to brag, but I used to be a historian, researching the Alfheim continent along with geography, biology, and archaeology.
scripts.translation: 我可不是自誇，以前我當過歷史學家，也研究阿爾夫海姆大陸的地理、生物和考古。

scripts.text: Recently, they discovered a suspicious rift in this vicinity. Because of how I am now, I couldn't check it out myself, but my colleague participated in the research team here and seemed to have brought back something.
scripts.translation: 最近有人在附近發現了可疑的裂隙。我現在這個樣子，沒法親自去查，不過我的同事參加了調查，似乎帶回了什麼東西。

scripts.text: What do you mean something? Did he bring back something like a rift fragment?
scripts.translation: 你說的是什麼？他帶回了裂隙碎片之類的東西嗎？

scripts.text: I think so. I don't know if you understand this, but if you utilize a dimensional rift fragment, you can travel through time or different dimensions.
scripts.translation: 大概吧。你可能不清楚，利用空間裂隙碎片可以穿越時間，或前往不同次元。

scripts.text: Yes, that is why I am here in the first place.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我就是為此來到這裡的

scripts.text: Oh, that's right. You are a human traveller from Midgard, so you would know more about this than I do.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了。你是從米德加爾特來的旅行者，這方面肯定比我懂。

scripts.text: In any case, the discovery of a rift in this vicinity is an absolute secret.
scripts.translation: 總之，在附近發現裂隙這件事絕對要保密。

scripts.text: How fun would it be to return to the past with the rift fragment~ I would be able to do whatever I want out of this boring prison.
scripts.translation: 要是能用裂隙碎片回到過去，該有多有趣啊~我就能離開這無聊的監獄，想做什麼就做什麼。

scripts.text: Hmm~ I've said too much. I think I talked to much for a cup of herb tea. I'm going to rest a little bit.
scripts.translation: 嗯~我說得太多了。為了喝一杯草藥茶，我可真是說了不少。我要休息一會兒。

scripts.text: Oh right. You showed some interest when I talked about the dimensional rift fragment.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了。我提到空間裂隙碎片時，你好像很感興趣。

scripts.text: If you are wondering about something, you can go find my friend ^000099Hiel^000000. He's as crazy as I am, but he's a good guy, hehehe.
scripts.translation: 有疑問就去找我的朋友希爾。他和我一樣瘋，不過人不錯，呵呵呵。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Thanks for being my ears. I don't have the strength to talk any more, so I have to rest up.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你願意聽我說話。我沒力氣繼續聊了，得休息一下。

scripts.text: ^000099Clever seems to be in deep sleep.^000000
I have many other gossip stories. What else do you want to hear about?
scripts.translation: 我還知道不少秘聞。你還想聽什麼？

scripts.text: Hey hey, who's this? You're my friend from earlier. Hehehe.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，這位是誰？哦，是之前提到的那位朋友啊。呵呵。

scripts.text: I'm just gonna be on my way.

scripts.translation: 我覺得希爾的實驗成功了

scripts.text: What? You don't find any inspiration from hearing my voice? That's sad.
scripts.translation: 什麼？聽我說話竟然沒給你帶來靈感？真令人難過。

scripts.text: Hold on... Keep your voice down. What did you just say?
I can't believe it. Did you help him? Wait, that's not the important part. The most important thing is understanding how that was possible.
scripts.translation: 不敢相信！是你幫了他嗎？等等，這不重要。最要緊的是弄清楚他是怎麼做到的。

scripts.text: Even a non-engineer like me understands that if the rift fragment reacts to pressure, it releases a force beyond understanding.
scripts.translation: 我雖不是工程師，也明白裂隙碎片一旦受到壓力併產生反應，就會釋放出難以想像的力量。

scripts.text: But I couldn't experience anything related to the rift from here. That means...
scripts.translation: 可我在這裡並沒有感受到任何裂隙相關的動靜。這就說明...

scripts.text: That must mean that it succeeded without any particular side effects...
scripts.translation: 這說明實驗成功了，也沒有造成什麼特別的副作用...

scripts.text: Yes, I see that Hiel must have resolved all technical aspects. Did something happen after the reaction? Could you tell me whatever you saw?
scripts.translation: 沒錯，看來希爾已經解決了所有技術問題。反應之後發生了什麼？把你看到的一切都告訴我吧。

scripts.text: Two Laphines related to home tree appeared? I have to look for the history records that I organized. Wait here.
scripts.translation: 出現了兩位與家園之樹有關的拉菲尼族？我得找找整理好的史料。你等一下。

scripts.text: This is the area of interest I used to research prior to imprisonment. The history of the birth of Eclage. And they are parts of history that have not been recorded in the official history documents.
scripts.translation: 這就是我入獄前研究的領域：埃克拉珠誕生史。其中有些片段並未記載在官方史書裡。

scripts.text: So it's part of the Unofficial history?
scripts.translation: 所以這是非官方史料的一部分？

scripts.text: Even if there are great accomplishments, there are times when those can't be recorded in the history.
scripts.translation: 有些偉大的事蹟，也無法載入史冊。

scripts.text: If there were ^000099oppositions among Dona forces^000000 of nobility, or ^000099slaughtering among Dona forces^000000, those acts cannot be recorded as official history.
scripts.translation: 如果貴族之間的多納勢力內部存在對立，或是多納勢力內部發生屠戮，官方史書都不會記載這些事。 ^000099^000000^000099^000000

scripts.text: Then how do those accounts get recorded?
scripts.translation: 那這些事又是怎麼記錄下來的？

scripts.text: Even if you don't want to reveal it, history is history. There is unofficial history as handed down among historians like me.
scripts.translation: 即便有人不願公開，歷史仍然是歷史。像我這樣的歷史學家之間，會口耳相傳一些非官方史料。

scripts.text: Of course, there would be thorny pieces of history among the higher-level members of Dona forces. There are a lot of facts distorted for political reasons. My job is to discover those aspects and correct them.
scripts.translation: 多納勢力的高層當然也有許多棘手的歷史。很多事實都因政治原因遭到歪曲，而我的工作就是揭露並糾正這些問題。

scripts.text: Could your imprisonment be due to...
scripts.translation: 你被關起來，難道是因為...

scripts.text: No, I was only imprisoned for defacing properties...
scripts.translation: 不是，我只是因為在公物上亂塗亂畫才坐牢的...

scripts.text: (I was foolish to expect something like that)
scripts.translation: （我真不該期待會有什麼驚天內幕。）

scripts.text: I digressed a bit there. The story of the birth of Eclage is actually an unofficial history record handed down as classified material. But there have been parts of it that were incorrect.
scripts.translation: 我扯遠了。埃克拉珠的誕生史，其實是以機密資料形式流傳的非官方史料，不過其中有些記載並不準確。

scripts.text: First, the figure with the short hair. He must be the Dona named Etran who was recorded in the unofficial academy. He is the one who argued for Bifrost's recovery.
scripts.translation: 先說那個短髮的人物。他應該是非官方學院史料中記載的多納族埃特蘭，主張復興彩虹橋。

scripts.text: And the figure with the long hair, I'm sure he's a Dona named Robert. He's the head of the group that promoted the recovery of Bifrost and restored home tree.
scripts.translation: 至於長髮那位，我確定是名叫羅伯特的多納族。他帶領眾人推動彩虹橋復興，並重建了家園之樹。

scripts.text: They were excluded from the official history records for their deep antagonism despite their profound contribution to the birth of Eclage. However...
scripts.translation: 他們為埃克拉珠的誕生立下大功，卻因彼此嚴重對立而被排除在官方史書之外。不過...

scripts.text: How does it seem from your perspective? Eclage is operating so peacefully. It's way too normal for a city that has been antagonized by high-class Donas.
scripts.translation: 你怎麼看？埃克拉珠如今運作得如此安穩。要是高階多納族之間真的有那麼深的仇怨，這座城市不該這麼平靜才對。

scripts.text: Doesn't really seem that way to me.
scripts.translation: 我倒沒覺得有那麼嚴重

scripts.text: Really? But at least take a look at this place's home tree. It's doing just so well! And all of the plant life in Bifrost are vividly alive... If there was an antagonist force, it should have been impossible.
scripts.translation: 是嗎？可你看看這裡的家園之樹，長得多好！彩虹橋的植物也都生機盎然...如果真有敵對勢力，這一切根本不可能。

scripts.text: Yes, it is just as you say. This place's home tree is alive and well. And the plant life of Bifrost are also vivacious...
scripts.translation: 沒錯，正如你所說，這裡的家園之樹生機勃勃，彩虹橋的植物也欣欣向榮...

scripts.text: If there was really as much antagonism as to be excluded from the history, Eclage and Bifrost could not be the way they are now.
scripts.translation: 如果他們真的對立到要被史書除名，埃克拉珠和如今的彩虹橋就不可能是這副模樣。

scripts.text: The explanations would not be enough with just the documents in this jail cell. Hold on a minute. I will let you know where there are book references that you can use to look it up yourself.
scripts.translation: 光憑牢房裡的這些檔案還不足以解釋清楚。等我一下，我告訴你可以去哪裡查閱相關書籍。

scripts.text: I came back after viewing those references.
scripts.translation: 我看完那些參考資料後回來了

scripts.text: Looks like you read quite a bit. How did you like that journal? Others claim that it is a third-rate journal, but the information in that journal is actually more accurate than legitimate journals.
scripts.translation: 看來你讀了不少。那本期刊怎麼樣？有人說它是三流刊物，可裡面的資訊其實比正規期刊還準確。

scripts.text: It's not that the journal itself is very systematic, but more so that it's not examined by the superiors because it's so negatively criticized for being a third-rate.
scripts.translation: 倒不是它的內容有多系統，只是因為被批成三流刊物，上面的人懶得審查它。

scripts.text: I thought that you were a savvy adventurer, but I guess I thought wrong.
scripts.translation: 嗎？我還以為你是個機靈的冒險者，看來是我看走眼了。

scripts.text: Hoh~ You seem like you discovered something. Great, what did you find there?
scripts.translation: 哦~看來你發現了什麼。很好，說來聽聽？

scripts.text: Are Dona and Papang in opposition?
scripts.translation: 多納族和帕潘族彼此對立嗎？
問問埃特蘭和羅伯特的事
拉菲尼族喜歡君市長嗎？

scripts.text: No, Dona and Papang are just words for distinction, not discrimination. Some without thought use them for fun but no one really thinks that way.
scripts.translation: 不，多納和帕潘只是區分族群的稱呼，不帶歧視意味。雖然有人隨口拿來開玩笑，但沒人真這麼想。

scripts.text: If you walk around talking about those things without caution, you'll become like me. Yes, certainly, I'm not in here because of that. Like I said before, I was charged for anonymous defacement of properties...
scripts.translation: 你要是不小心到處談論那些事，就會落得和我一樣的下場。當然，我可不是因為這個才被關起來的。就像我說的，我只是因為匿名塗鴉破壞公物被起訴...

scripts.text: ^000099I ended up imagining Clever's daily life of spray painting the walls, remembering the ones I saw in Monthly Eclage. ^000000
scripts.translation: 我不禁想像聰明鬼每天拿噴漆塗牆的樣子，和《埃克拉珠月刊》裡寫的一模一樣。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Oh, you talking about Mayor Jun? Just call him His Majesty. He is an idol-like existence to us.
scripts.translation: 哦，你說君市長？叫他陛下就行。他在我們心目中就像偶像一樣。

scripts.text: Of course, pure scholars like Hiel and I don't care much for him. I heard he was very beautiful, but I don't really care about the current world.
scripts.translation: 當然，像希爾和我這樣的純粹學者不太在意他。我聽說他長得很俊美，不過我對當今世界不怎麼關心。

scripts.text: ^000099Along with that, Clever rattled on about things that I had no idea about like 'Valkyries are best. Uncle loves so much'.^000000
scripts.translation: 除此之外，聰明鬼還滔滔不絕地說些我聽不懂的話，比如：“瓦爾基里最好了，叔叔最喜歡了。” ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You even looked up stories about Etran and Robert. In fact, we know that most Laphines here were established by the elder assemblies that influenced the noble forces at the time.
scripts.translation: 你還查了埃特蘭和羅伯特的故事。事實上，當時這裡的大多數拉菲尼族，都是由影響貴族勢力的長老議會建立的。

scripts.text: However, the real history was built on the sacrifices of the young Laphines. At first, as a historian, I could not accept that truth.
scripts.translation: 然而，真正的歷史是由年輕拉菲尼族的犧牲鑄成的。起初，身為歷史學家的我也無法接受這個事實。

scripts.text: Unofficial documents that are being constantly discovered always talk about the sacrifies of two young Laphines, so how could they be believed as legitimate?
scripts.translation: 不斷出土的非官方文獻都提到兩位年輕拉菲尼族的犧牲，誰能輕易相信這才是正史呢？

scripts.text: So I tried to present on the topic by writing a related paper but... As expected, the outcome was terrible.
scripts.translation: 於是我試著寫論文討論這件事...結果不出所料，糟透了。

scripts.text: I mean what else could be done? It must have been ridiculous for them since a young scholar was insisting on his ideas just because he didn't like the recorded history.
scripts.translation: 還能怎麼辦呢？在他們看來，一個年輕學者只是因為不喜歡既有記載，就固執己見，當然很荒唐。

scripts.text: After losing my mind due to the presentation's failure, I was imprisoned after spray painting all Yai's of Eclage with 'Eat dirt you Laphine Official Aacademy scumbags'. Well, I could have avoided being caught.
scripts.translation: 報告發表失敗後，我一時失控，在埃克拉珠所有的雅伊上噴了“吃土吧，拉菲尼官方學院的混蛋”，結果就被關起來了。其實我本來可以不被抓到的。

scripts.text: ^000099He's a pit bull to his roots.^000000
Hold on, the prison guard is looking this way. Let's see how he's doing and change the subject for a minute.
scripts.translation: 等等，獄卒正看著這邊。先看看

scripts.text: Hold on, the prison guard is looking this way. Let's see how he's doing and change the subject for a minute.
scripts.translation: 他在做什麼，暫時換個話題。

scripts.text: Hmm? It wasn't anything? I thought he had a problem with our having this conversation...
scripts.translation: 嗯？沒什麼事嗎？我還以為他不想讓我們聊這個呢...

scripts.text: ^000099(No, that's not it!! It's actually the opposite!)^000000
Well, let me make one thing clear. What I'm going to tell you from now, I never told anyone else until now.
scripts.translation: 先說清楚一件事：接下來我要告訴你的秘密，我從未對任何人說過。

scripts.text: If you don't like something about it, or don't want to involve yourself, just forget everything I told you. But if my story interests you, or you have an inkling of desire to help me...
scripts.translation: 如果你不喜歡其中任何內容，或是不想捲入，就把我說的一切都忘掉。但如果我的故事讓你感興趣，或者你願意幫我...

scripts.text: Could you promise me that you'll keep everything that you hear from me a secret and help me out?
scripts.translation: 你能答應替我保守秘密，並幫我一把嗎？

scripts.text: Well I got this far, I'll hear you out.
scripts.translation: 既然都聊到這一步了，我就聽你說完

scripts.text: That's too bad. You are the only adventurer that I ever told this much. I guess I can't do much about it. Come back to me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 真遺憾。你是唯一一個聽我說了這麼多的冒險者。既然如此，我也沒辦法。等你改變主意再來找我吧。

scripts.text: Great. That's a deal. First, I thank you for this favor. I hope that home tree will have many blessings.
scripts.translation: 太好了，一言為定。先謝謝你願意幫忙。願家園之樹賜福於你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 在獲得家園之樹的賜福後，你獲得了經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: The reason why Hiel was researching rift fragments is because he has the same goal as I do. ^000099He wants to resolve things by directly meeting the Laphines of the past by transcending the space-time continuum.^000000
scripts.translation: 希爾研究裂隙碎片，是因為他和我有同一個目標。他想穿越時空，親自見見過去的拉菲尼族。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: For me, it is to find out the truth about history and for Hiel, it is to obtain one of the limited copies of the interior architectural planning of home tree.
scripts.translation: 我的目標是查明歷史真相；希爾的目標，則是取得家園之樹內部建築規劃圖的限量副本。

scripts.text: Somehow, it feels like Hiel's goal is different.
scripts.translation: 不知為何，感覺希爾的目標和你不太一樣

scripts.text: Let him be. He's an engineer, so he has that passion only engineers have. While he sometimes lacks the sense of conventionality, but his ability as an engineer is considered outstanding.
scripts.translation: 隨他去吧，他是工程師，有工程師特有的熱情。雖然有時不太懂人情世故，但工程本領確實出眾。

scripts.text: ^000099Well, even a person like you are far from the normal Laphines, aren't you...? The thought just crosses my mind.^000000
scripts.translation: 不過，像你這樣的人也遠不算普通的拉菲尼族吧...我腦中突然冒出這個念頭。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: While we were talking about history this way, I bet the guy figured out dozens of ways to operate through and apply the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation: 我們聊歷史聊到這兒，我敢說那傢伙已經想出幾十種操作和運用次元裂隙的方法了。

scripts.text: He might be already talking about the engineering manual with the Laphines of the past.
scripts.translation: 他現在說不定正和過去的拉菲尼族討論工程手冊呢

scripts.text: I ask that you would use Hiel's rift tool to meet with the past's Etran and Laphines.
scripts.translation: 麻煩你用希爾的裂隙工具，去見

scripts.text: And it's fine if they're trivial. I just ask that you would record them all in detail and get back to me.
scripts.translation: 哪怕只是些瑣事也沒關係。請你把所有事情詳細記錄下來，再回來告訴我。

scripts.text: I ask that you would use Hiel's rift tool to meet with the past's Etran and Laphines.
scripts.translation: 見過去的埃特蘭和拉菲尼族。

scripts.text: And it's fine if they're trivial. I just ask that you would record them all in detail and get back to me.
scripts.translation: 哪怕只是些瑣事也沒關係。請你把所有事情詳細記錄下來，再回來告訴我。

scripts.text: Yes, did Hiel's research find good outcome?
scripts.translation: 對了，希爾的研究有進展嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him about the things that happened.
As expected, the sacrifices of Etran and Robert, two young Donas, built this Eclage. Now it's for certain that the official history is recorded incorrectly.
scripts.translation: 。果然，是埃特蘭和羅伯特這兩位年輕多納族犧牲自己，才建立了埃克拉珠。現在可以確定，官方歷史記載有誤。

scripts.text: Thank you so much. {0} if it weren't for you, I wouldn't have been able to achieve my long-cherished wish.
scripts.translation: 太感謝你了。要不是有你幫忙，我這輩子的夙願恐怕就無法實現了。 {0}

scripts.text: Oh, wait... The two friends reunited together again, right?
scripts.translation: 哦，等等...那兩位朋友後來重逢了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm sure they would sometime soon, right?
scripts.translation: 我想他們很快就會重逢吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I guess we wouldn't know that at this point.
scripts.translation: 也是，現在的我們無從得知。

scripts.text: Well, I guess that doesn't matter anymore!
I feel like I accomplished something truly significant! Shall we sing?!
scripts.translation: 覺得自己完成了一件大事！來唱歌吧？！

scripts.text: ^000099I can see Etran's face through Clever's smile. This must be from the joy he's feeling.^000000
scripts.translation: 看著聰明鬼的笑容，我彷彿看到了埃特蘭的臉。那一定是因為他心中充滿喜悅。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Thank you for hearing me out all this time. Thanks to you, after my release from prison, I have much to record into the history with full confidence. In return, I will pray for home tree's blessings.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你一直聽我傾訴。多虧了你，等我出獄後，就能滿懷信心地把許多事寫進歷史。作為回報，我會祈求家園之樹賜福於你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree from Clever, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼為你祈求家園之樹的祝福後，你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Clever is diligently transcribing things on paper.^000000
scripts.translation: 聰明鬼正專心地謄寫紙上的內容。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text: It is said that the leaves from home tree have the length X with the average m and standard deviation of 4. If P(m<X<a)=0.3413 ... (Mumble mumble)
scripts.translation: 據說家園之樹的葉長為X，平均值是m，標準差為4。若P(m<X<a)=0.3413...（喃喃自語）

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt doesn't look like I'll understand anything he says. Let's get out of here.^000000
scripts.translation: 他說的我好像完全聽不懂。還是先離開這裡吧。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Hmm? What brings a human traveler to my room? This is not a room that anyone can enter.
scripts.translation: 嗯？是什麼風把人類旅行者吹到我的房間來了？這裡可不是誰都能進的。

scripts.text: I was referred to meet you here.
Oh~ Someone referred you to me? Who was it? You better make sense, or I'll be sure to kick you out.
scripts.translation: 哦~有人介紹你來的？是誰？最好說清楚，不然我可要把你趕出去。

scripts.text: Oh really? Give me a minute. I'm going to wrap up what I am doing and come back.
scripts.translation: 這樣啊？等我一下，我先把手頭的事做完，馬上回來。

scripts.text: I don't know that person! Aren't you suspicious!
scripts.translation: 我不認識那個人！你很可疑啊！

scripts.text: I don't really believe that you could have a normal conversation with the socially inept Clever, but I'll at least give you the benefit of the doubt. So, what did he tell you?
scripts.translation: 我不太相信你能和不善交際的聰明鬼正常聊天，不過姑且先信你一次吧。他跟你說了什麼？

scripts.text: A story about the Seneth King's father
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王父親的故事

scripts.text: A story about Seneth King's arsony
scripts.translation: 關於塞內斯王縱火的故事

scripts.text: The assistant chief of staff's real name
A dimensional rift in nearby regions
How uninteresting. I'm busy so why don't you go on your way.
scripts.translation: 真無聊。我很忙，你還是走吧。

scripts.text: I don't have much interest in the rumors about the royalty here.
scripts.translation: 我對這裡的王族傳聞沒興趣。呵~你還真會找話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text: I don't even know how this gossip is going to useful for me. Is this all you talked about with Clever?
scripts.translation: 我實在不明白這些八卦對我有什麼用。你和聰明鬼就聊了這些？呵~你還真會找話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text: The current name of the assistant chief of staff is not real?
scripts.translation: 參謀長現在用的名字不是真名？

scripts.text: I mean, even so, how does that matter to me? I'd rather just continue my research.
scripts.translation: 就算如此，又關我什麼事？我還是繼續研究好了。

scripts.text: Hoh~ You really know how to find an interesting topic. As Clever may have told you, I have in my room a fragment of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation: 呵~你還真會找話題。就像聰明鬼可能告訴你的，我房間裡有一塊次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text: ^000099Hie, super excited, showed me a weird container filled with rubble and talked on and on for 30 minutes.^000000
scripts.translation: 希爾興奮地拿出一個裝滿碎石的奇怪容器給我看，還滔滔不絕地講了半個小時。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This is... irritating on a different level from Clever. I have to somehow stop his nonstop talking...^000000
scripts.translation: 這傢伙的煩人方式和聰明鬼截然不同。我得想辦法讓他停下這沒完沒了的講話... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Ask how the fragment was obtained
So what can you do with this?
Well, I am working on figuring that out. The past and the future. I just know for sure that you can trascend the conception of space and overcome the dimensional barriers.
scripts.translation: 我正在研究它的用途：過去、未來...我只確定一點，它能突破空間概念與次元屏障。

scripts.text: If you can operate the rift fragment properly, it would not be very hard to meet ^000099historical figures of the past^000000.
scripts.translation: 只要能正確操作裂隙碎片，見到過去的歷史人物應該不難。哦...嗯...（洩氣...） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Not too long ago, there was a huge dimensional rift. Although, lots of Laphine soldiers are regulating the area now.
scripts.translation: 不久前那裡出現了一道巨大的次元裂隙。不過現在有許多拉菲尼族士兵在那一帶巡邏。

scripts.text: Very briefly, for research purposes, they allowed access to the area. That's when I slipped one for myself.
scripts.translation: 簡單來說，他們為了研究開放了那片區域，我就趁機偷偷拿了一塊出來。

scripts.text: Of course, if this is discovered, I would immediately be jailed. So please don't let anyone else know.
scripts.translation: 當然，這事要是被發現，我馬上就會坐牢。所以千萬別告訴別人。哦...嗯...（洩氣...）

scripts.text: Why are you getting down on yourself?
You see, I tried everything possible. Haha... This rift fragment won't listen to me at all. It is essentially void of any reaction.
scripts.translation: 我什麼辦法都試過了。哈哈...這塊裂隙碎片根本不理我，幾乎毫無反應。

scripts.text: What I really desire is to witness with my own eyes the kind of chemical reaction given off by this metaphysical thing.
scripts.translation: 我最想親眼看看這件超自然物質會產生怎樣的化學反應。

scripts.text: But it's not like I have the necessary resources or information... (Mumble mumble)
scripts.translation: 可我既沒有所需的資源，也沒有相關資料...（喃喃自語）
這傢伙情緒起伏也太大了吧！ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099How does someone get so depressed so quickly?! ^000000
I heard that you human beings have succeeded in combining the right materials to create a reaction with the rift fragment. Is that true?
scripts.translation: 我聽說你們人類已經把合適的材料組合起來，成功讓裂隙碎片產生反應了。是真的嗎？
我就是這樣來到這裡的

scripts.text: I guess those cats were right.
Guys who regarded themselves as former cat merchants came by here to sell books containing the knowledge of Midgard humans.
scripts.translation: 有幾個自稱前貓族商人的傢伙來這裡賣書，書裡記載著米德加爾特人類的知識。

scripts.text: At that time, they told me that they knew the contents of humans' rift experiments, so I called them liars and kicked them out.
scripts.translation: 他們當時說知道人類進行裂隙實驗的內容，我不信，就把他們當騙子趕走了。

scripts.text: Cats don't mess around with money.
Oh, is that right? I guess what they said was true. I'm really sorry to ask you this favor, but would you mind retrieving that information from them?
scripts.translation: 哦，是這樣嗎？看來他們說的是真的。真不好意思麻煩你，能幫我去找他們拿回那些資料嗎？

scripts.text: I would like to go myself, but as you can see, I have to continue my research... And... (Fidget fidget)
scripts.translation: 我也想親自去，可你看，我還得繼續研究...而且...（扭捏）

scripts.text: Oh, are you here to help me out? I guess what they said was true. I'm really sorry to ask you this favor, but would you mind retrieving that information from them?
scripts.translation: 哦，你是來幫忙的嗎？看來他們說得沒錯。不好意思要麻煩你，能幫我從他們那裡取回那些資料嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm, I'd like to, but I'm busy myself...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我是想幫忙，可我自己也很忙...

scripts.text: Sure, I'll go check it out.
Oh... I guess it was too much to ask for. That's too bad then.
scripts.translation: 哦...看來是我強人所難了。真遺憾。

scripts.text: Wow wow! Thank you so much! I'll return the favor by operating it together when the experiments are complete! In the meantime, I'll start preparing for material combination!
scripts.translation: 哇哇！太感謝你了！實驗完成後，我會和你一起操作，報答你的幫忙！趁這段時間，我先準備材料組合！

scripts.text: Cat merchants are stationed at various places in El Dicastes which is far east of Mora village. I am not exactly sure which of those really have that information...
scripts.translation: 穆拉村以東很遠的埃爾迪卡斯特，各處都駐紮著貓族商人。我不太確定哪位手裡有那些資料...

scripts.text: Tell him about the materials necessary.
I see, both Dark Debris and Gem Stone are unfamiliar to me. Could it be that my work was just impossible to begin with...?
scripts.translation: 原來如此，暗黑碎片和寶石我都沒聽說過。難道我的研究從一開始就註定不可能...？

scripts.text: It does seem impossible. You should give up.
scripts.translation: 看來確實不可能。你還是放棄吧

scripts.text: I see, I guess changing the very physics is an impossible thing...
scripts.translation: 原來如此，改變物理法則果然是不可能的...

scripts.text: Would you do that for me?? If so, I have nothing more to ask!
scripts.translation: 你願意替我做這件事嗎？那我就沒別的要求了！

scripts.text: Ooo, so this is what is called Dark Debris. I'm so glad that I can continue my experiments.
scripts.translation: 哦，原來這就是暗黑碎片。太好了，我的實驗可以繼續了。

scripts.text: I didn't say that I'd just give them to you.
scripts.translation: 我可沒說要把它們給你

scripts.text: How ruthless... Saying that he won't give them after showing them to me.
scripts.translation: 也太無情了吧...給我看了，卻又不肯給。

scripts.text: Wow~ This will be a big step forward in the scientific progress among the Laphines. I pray for your home tree's blessings.
scripts.translation: 哇~這會讓拉菲尼族的科學向前邁出一大步。願家園之樹保佑你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving Scientist Hiel's blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你獲得了科學家希爾給予的家園之樹祝福，並得到基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Wait, but where is the material you are talking about? I don't see it.
scripts.translation: 等等，你說的材料呢？我沒看到啊。

scripts.text: Hmm... But this is very strange. I arranged them exactly the way it says on the documents, but why isn't there any reaction?
scripts.translation: 嗯...真奇怪。我明明完全按照檔案上的說明擺好了，為什麼一點反應也沒有？

scripts.text: Hmm. Is it this way? No, that's not it. Is it this way? Okay here. We'll put this guy over here. And there.
scripts.translation: 嗯，是這樣嗎？不對。這樣擺嗎？好，就放這裡。再把那個放到那邊。

scripts.text: Ahh~ Why isn't this working! You, you have to react when I place you like this!! Ahh nothing is working! Whoa, it slipped from my hand! (CLASH)
scripts.translation: 啊~怎麼還是不行！我把你擺成這樣，你就該有反應啊！！什麼都不管用！哎呀，滑出手了！（哐當）

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel, moving wildly for lack of reaction, dropped the Dark Debris to the floor. At this rate, it might shatter...^000000
scripts.translation: 希爾因遲遲沒有反應而手忙腳亂，把暗黑碎片掉在地上。再這樣下去，它可能會摔碎... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: I grabbed it before it dropped to the floor.
scripts.translation: 我趕在它落地前接住了

scripts.text: Hey, how can you handle something like this so carelessly! This is hard to find!
scripts.translation: 你怎麼能這麼不小心！這東西很難找的！

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as the Dark Debris was placed in the middle of Hiel's arrangement, everything went dark and a strange voice appeared out of nowhere.^000000
scripts.translation: 暗黑碎片剛放到希爾擺設的中央，四周便陷入黑暗，一個陌生的聲音憑空響起。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Ok, let's say that you restore home tree first. Then what? What are you going to do about all of the energy it's going to suck from the land?
scripts.translation: 好吧，假設你先讓家園之樹復甦，然後呢？它會從土地吸走大量能量，你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text: You might be right. To restore home tree, we will probably need a life force that is beyond our imagination. But even so, home tree must be revived.
scripts.translation: 你或許說得對。要讓家園之樹復甦，恐怕需要超乎想像的生命力。即便如此，我們還是必須讓它復甦。

scripts.text: Then what are you going to do about all the other living creatures? The land might grow barren for at least decades, or even centuries. Are things aside from home tree not even considered living?
scripts.translation: 那其他生靈怎麼辦？土地可能會荒蕪幾十年，甚至幾百年。難道除了家園之樹，其他生命都不算生命嗎？

scripts.text: Even if you sustain other life forms, it won't be for long without home tree. We have to tolerate the immediate losses. Don't you know that, Etran?!
scripts.translation: 就算保住其他生命，沒有家園之樹也撐不了多久。我們必須承受眼前的損失。埃特蘭，你不明白嗎？！

scripts.text: Sure, it would be easy to restore the land after we revive home tree!
scripts.translation: 等家園之樹復甦之後，恢復土地當然就容易了！

scripts.text: But do we even have the right to let all other life forms die while we wait until home tree revives?
scripts.translation: 可我們有權讓其他生命在等待家園之樹復甦時死去嗎？

scripts.text: I don't think anyone has that right! No one!
scripts.translation: 我不認為任何人有這種權利！誰都沒有！

scripts.text: You are dreaming big, Etran. In any case, this isn't something that we can solve by arguing. I'm going to follow the decision of the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭，你想得太理想了。總之，這不是爭論就能解決的問題。我會遵從長老議會的決定。

scripts.text: Did you see that just now?! The weird sounds. Ahhh~ I'm an engineer who does not believe in spiritual things. Is it because I haven't studied enough? How could there be such an illogical occurrence?!
scripts.translation: 你剛才看見了嗎？！那些奇怪的聲音！啊~我可是個不信鬼神的工程師。難道是我研究得還不夠？怎麼會發生這麼不合邏輯的事？！

scripts.text: Yes, what I heard was the same. I don't know what that was. And I never heard anything about reviving a home tree.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我聽到的也是這些。我不知道剛才那是什麼，而且從沒聽說過復甦家園之樹的事。

scripts.text: Ok, there's no other way. If it's not of our imagination, we have to confirm it again to identify what that sound really was. We have to make sure that it's just just some hallucinations.
scripts.translation: 好吧，只能再確認一次，弄清楚那聲音究竟是什麼。我們得確認那只是一場幻覺。

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel took more time to rethe arrangements = but the rift fragment did not react to any of his movements.^000000
scripts.translation: 希爾花了更多時間重新擺放裝置，但裂隙碎片對他的操作仍毫無反應。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Looks like whatever I do won't let it react. Do you want to give it a try yourself?
scripts.translation: 看來我怎麼弄它都沒反

scripts.text: Looks like whatever I do won't let it react. Do you want to give it a try yourself?
I don't think this is anything spiritual, but rather a moment from the past.
scripts.translation: 我覺得這不是什麼靈異現象，而是過去某個時刻的影像。

scripts.text: Do you have an idea of whose those voices may be?
scripts.translation: 你覺得那些聲音可能是誰發出的？

scripts.text: No, no, I have no historical knowledge. But I do have a friend who is truly an expert in that field. He's also the person you met recently.
scripts.translation: 不，我不懂歷史。不過我有位朋友是這方面的專家，而且你最近剛見過他。

scripts.text: Yeah, that's him. He really has problems with his social skills that left him in prison. In historical knowledge, he is truly unparallel.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，就是他。他社交能力差得很，才會坐牢。不過論歷史知識，他無人能及。

scripts.text: If you want to figure out more about the content of that dialogue, it would be better to go and ask him. In the meantime, I'll analyze the arrangement of this.
scripts.translation: 想弄清楚那段對話的內容，最好去問問他。我會繼續研究這個裝置。

scripts.text: If you would like to find out more about the dialogue heard in the reaction, go talk to Clever in prison. He is far better than I am in that field.
scripts.translation: 想了解剛才聽到的對話，就去監獄找聰明鬼吧。他比我更懂那方面的事。

scripts.text: While you are gone, I tried constructing a portable rift reactor, but I think there is a slight problem.
scripts.translation: 你不在的時候，我試著造了一臺行動式裂隙反應器，不過好像有點問題。

scripts.text: Who in the world are you! How are you looking just like me? Answer me! Are you an imposter established by the Elder Assembly to be used after assassinating me?!
scripts.translation: 你到底是誰！為什麼長得和我一模一樣？回答我！你是長老議會派來刺殺我、再頂替我的冒牌貨嗎？！

scripts.text: Excuse me, please calm down and listen to me. My name is Hiel and the Elder Assembly no longer exists in the world.
scripts.translation: 請先冷靜下來聽我解釋。我叫希爾，長老議會早已不復存在了。

scripts.text: You see... This is very complicated to explain... Where do I start...
scripts.translation: 這個嘛...實在太複雜了...我該從哪兒說起...

scripts.text: ^000099A Dona that looks surprisingly similar to Hiel (^990000Although he seems so much more dignified...^000099) is holding Hiel by his collar. Who could that Dona be?^000000
scripts.translation: 一個與希爾驚人相似的多納族正揪著他的衣領（不過那人看起來威嚴得多...）。那位多納族究竟是誰？ ^000099^990000^000099^000000

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but who are you?
scripts.translation: 不好意思，請問您是哪位？

scripts.text: I am a high-level Laphine Life Restorer. How are you related to this look-alike of mine?
scripts.translation: 00000。我是高階拉菲尼族生命復原師。你和這個長得像我的人是什麼關係？

scripts.text: ^000099Robert?... Is this the Life Restorer whose sillouette I've been seeing all this time?^000000
scripts.translation: 羅伯特？...難道這就是我一直看到的那位生命復原師的身影？ ^000099^000000
把事情經過解釋給他聽

scripts.text: Hmm, this is very difficult for me to comprehend. So you are saying that you are from thousands of years away? My head is beginning to hurt.
scripts.translation: 嗯，這實在難以理解。你是說自己來自幾千年以後？我聽得頭都疼了。

scripts.text: Yes, but if I were to let you know another thing...
scripts.translation: 沒錯，不過我還想告訴你另一件事...

scripts.text: The engineer scientist Hiel and Sir Robert are very similar in appearance, but the way he carries himself is extremely different. So please refrain yourself from stating that the two look alike. It hurts me to listen.
scripts.translation: 工程師希爾和羅伯特爵士長得很像，可舉止截然不同。請別再說你們長得相像了，聽得我都難受。

scripts.text: I thought I was looking into a mirror.
scripts.translation: 我還以為自己在照鏡子呢。

scripts.text: To hear that we are so different in quality, I am quite offended... At any rate, let me explain the current situation.
scripts.translation: 聽說我們氣質差這麼多，我可有點受打擊...總之，先讓我說明一下目前的情況。

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel added his explanation of his research up to now. Robert seemed to follow most of the story.^000000
scripts.translation: 希爾補充說明了他迄今為止的研究，羅伯特似乎聽懂了大半。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: That's the basic gist. Anyways, I'm having trouble remaining calm. I can't believe you, Sir Robert, really existed.
scripts.translation: 大致情況就是這樣。總之，我實在很難冷靜下來。真不敢相信羅伯特爵士真的存在！

scripts.text: You are like a legend to all engineering scientists. It's almost difficult to believe a person like you existed in the past.
scripts.translation: 對所有工程師來說，您簡直是傳奇人物。很難相信過去真的有您這樣的人。

scripts.text: It's just so incredible how you were able to construct home tree in its amazing form by amalgamating the life and the setting.
scripts.translation: 您竟能將生命與環境融為一體，建造出如此壯觀的家園之樹，真是不可思議。

scripts.text: home tree... I can't believe it grew back... It was nearly an impossible task. It has restored to its full form in the future of thousands of years later?
scripts.translation: 家園之樹...我真不敢相信它重新長起來了...這幾乎是不可能完成的任務。幾千年後的未來，它真的恢復了原貌？

scripts.text: It's true. I can show it to you if you'd like.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。您想看的話，我可以帶您去

scripts.text: I thought it was impossible. In the end, it actually succeeded in the future. Please take me to home tree immediately! If you lied to me, I won't let you off easy.
scripts.translation: 我原以為絕無可能，沒想到未來竟真的成功了。快帶我去家園之樹！你要是騙我，我可不會輕饒你。

scripts.text: His personality is like fire. If you would like to lead the way to home tree, please exit this place and go to the center of the plaza.
scripts.translation: 他的性子像火一樣。如果你想前往家園之樹，請離開這裡，到廣場中央去。

scripts.text: Hmm... I think this is the problematic area here. Darn, I should have had studied more.
scripts.translation: 嗯...問題應該出在這裡。可惡，我早該多做些研究的。
羅伯特在交談中消失了

scripts.text: Oh, that error. Hoh... Oh no! It's a problem that I did not anticipate.
scripts.translation: 哦，是那個故障啊。呵...糟了！我沒料到會出這種問題。

scripts.text: Ahahhaa, no, it's not like that. I just found out a few minor problems while operating the portable rift reactor.
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈，沒那麼嚴重。我只是操作行動式裂隙反應器時發現了幾個小問題。

scripts.text: This thing is made portable, so the output is not very strong. In other words, the range of reaction is very limited.
scripts.translation: 這臺機器為了方便攜帶，輸出功率不高。也就是說，反應範圍很有限。

scripts.text: To find Sir Robert, this machine's chronological frequency is set at the time right when we encountered him. We will be able to meet him many times over.
scripts.translation: 為了找到羅伯特爵士，我把機器的時間頻率設定在與他相遇的那個時刻。我們可以多次和他見面。

scripts.text: The only problem is that... it has to be at a designated location.
scripts.translation: 唯一的問題是...必須在指定地點使用。

scripts.text: Does that mean it can't be at any other location?
scripts.translation: 所以不能在別的地方使用嗎？

scripts.text: I think so, according to my estimation. Entities with life cannot communicate beyond the range of this reactor while inanimate objects are not affected the same way.
scripts.translation: 根據我的估算，應該不行。生命體無法在反應器範圍之外交流，無生命物體卻不受同樣的限制。

scripts.text: ^000099(Holding up a very worn out pen)^000000 The pen that Sir Robert was using is still here as proof even though we lost contact with him.
scripts.translation: （舉起一支磨損嚴重的鋼筆）即使我們失去了聯絡，羅伯特爵士用過的鋼筆仍留在這裡，作為證據。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Then could we also meet his contemporary, Etran?
scripts.translation: 那我們也能見到和羅伯特同時代的埃特蘭嗎？

scripts.text: Theorectically, we could. However, we have to go to the location where he may have been. No matter how many times we operate this reactor here, we can only meet Robert.
scripts.translation: 理論上可以。不過得去他當時可能在的地點。在這裡無論啟動多少次反應器，都只能見到羅伯特。

scripts.text: We could expand this machine's output to increase the range, but at this time it's not possible. We can't do much else for now.
scripts.translation: 提高這臺機器的輸出功率，就能擴大範圍，但現在還辦不到。眼下我們也沒別的辦法。

scripts.text: Would you let me see that reactor for a minute?
scripts.translation: 能讓我看看那臺反應器嗎？

scripts.text: I don't know how long it will take. It would be difficult to meet Etran and Robert simultaneously for now.
scripts.translation: 我也不知道還要多久。目前恐怕沒法同時見到埃特蘭和羅伯特。

scripts.text: You are not thinking of taking this out to Bifrost, are you? I think you are taking things too far. It's probably too dangerous.
scripts.translation: 你該不會想把它帶去彩虹橋吧？這也太冒險了，實在危險。

scripts.text: I am a person who made it all the way here alive and well.
scripts.translation: 我可是一路平安地活著走到這裡的

scripts.text: Don't you want to test out your theory?
scripts.translation: 你不想驗證自己的理論嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm not worried about you. I'm worried that this precious reactor will break.
scripts.translation: 我才不是擔心你。我擔心這臺寶貝反應器會壞掉

scripts.text: (It is so obvious that Hiel is genuinely in a dilemma)
Surely, it is dangerous. But what you're saying is right. The engineer's blood that runs through me wants to test this machine out.
scripts.translation: 確實危險。不過你說得沒錯，我身為工程師，真的很想試試這臺機器。

scripts.text: Arg. Well, it can't be helped! Please be careful with this! While I do have a spare, that's the only one with the correct chronological frequency settings!
scripts.translation: 唉，好吧！沒辦法了。請務必小心！我雖然有備用機，但只有這臺設定了正確的時間頻率！

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel's rift reactor was obtained. The energy from the reactor feels like it's channeling through the body.
scripts.translation: 獲得了希爾的裂隙反應器。反應器的能量彷彿在你體內流動。 ^000099

scripts.text: You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000000

scripts.text: Please handle the reactor with care. That's the only one we can use at this time...
scripts.translation: 小心操作反應器。目前能用的只有這一臺...

scripts.text: You're back. {0} While you were gone, I added various functionalities onto the spare rift reactor.
scripts.translation: 你回來了。你不在的時候，我給備用裂隙反應器加了不少功能。 {0}

scripts.text: Now the rift will react wherever you are at the speed of light. Also infinite data transfer is now made available. Ah, what should I call this?
scripts.translation: 現在無論你身在何處，裂隙都會以光速產生反應。此外還實現了無限資料傳輸。啊，該給它起個什麼名字呢？

scripts.text: Can we obtain a leaf of home tree?
scripts.translation: 能拿到一片家園之樹的葉子嗎？

scripts.text: Huh? Even if the reactor were to be very capable, it can't possibly do something like creating a home tree leaf. That just couldn't be. This is merely a communicator.
scripts.translation: 什麼？反應器再厲害，也不可能憑空造出家園之樹的葉子。這根本辦不到，它只是個通訊器。

scripts.text: Explain to him the promise made with Etran.
scripts.translation: 向他說明你和埃特蘭的約定

scripts.text: Hmm, even so, that's very difficult. Any action that harms a home tree leaf is illegal in Eclage. The consequence is immediate exile.
scripts.translation: 嗯，即使如此也很難。損害家園之樹的葉子在埃克拉珠是違法的，會被立即流放。

scripts.text: Besides, dried up home tree leaves don't just drop to the ground, but transform into life energy and spread throughout the land. It's impossible to even pick them up as dried leaves.
scripts.translation: 而且，枯萎的家園之樹葉不會落到地上，而是化成生命能量散佈到各處。連枯葉都撿不到。

scripts.text: Hmm... I wonder if there's a way.
It won't be illegal if the creator of home tree himself hands you its leaf.
scripts.translation: 如果由家園之樹的創造者親手把葉子交給你，那就不違法了。

scripts.text: That's right. I don't know why I didn't think of that earlier. If it's Robert who gives you the home tree leaf, it would be perfectly fine.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。我怎麼之前沒想到呢？只要是羅伯特親手交給你的家園之樹葉子，就完全沒問題。

scripts.text: Let's try channeling our way to Robert. Well... This isn't exactly to test out the machine's new functionality. (Hesitating)
scripts.translation: 我們試著通過機器聯絡羅伯特吧。嗯...這倒不完全是為了測試機器的新功能。（猶豫）
那就試著聯絡羅伯特吧

scripts.text: Hmm, that's too bad. If you are thinking of attacking home tree, it's way too dangerous. You'll just be jailed.
scripts.translation: 嗯，真遺憾。要是你想攻擊家園之樹，那也太危險了，只會害你被關進監獄。

scripts.text: Now, shall we start our communication? Place your hand on the reactor here.
scripts.translation: 那我們開始通訊吧。把手放在這裡的反應器上。

scripts.text: It always feels like looking into a mirror whenever I meet Sir Robert...
scripts.translation: 每次見到羅伯特爵士，都像是在照鏡子...

scripts.text: Not in the least bit delightful...
I only met him twice, and I feel really familiar and somewhat nostalgic when I meet him. I don't know how to call it. It's just a very familiar feeling.
scripts.translation: 我只見過他兩次，可每次見到他都覺得很親切，甚至有些懷念。我也說不上來，就是有種熟悉的感覺。

scripts.text: Oh, anyways, don't you lose your focus on the reactor. It is currently connecting.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了，集中精神看著反應器。現在正在連線。

scripts.text: Hey hey~ Now it's almost complete.
scripts.translation: 嘿~現在差不多快完成了。

scripts.text: The current range of this reactor surpasses Eclage and reaches Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 反應器的範圍已經超出埃克拉珠，延伸到了彩虹橋。

scripts.text: If I modify it a bit, I am sure I could even freely select the time point of interest.
scripts.translation: 稍作改造後，我肯定就能自由選擇要前往的時間點了。

scripts.text: Etran wanted me to thank you on his behalf.
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭托我代他向你道謝

scripts.text: Really? I'm glad... I would like to one day help Sir Etran and Sir Robert to reunite within this reactor.
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？太好了...希望有一天能讓埃特蘭大人和羅伯特大人在這臺反應器中重逢。

scripts.text: ^000099Instantly, Hiel's smile reminded me of Robert. I must have been in the moment.^000000
scripts.translation: 希爾的笑容一下子讓我想起羅伯特。我大概是被當時的氣氛感染了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Oh, hello~ I'm busy as usual, ahah.
scripts.translation: 哦，你好~我還是一如既往地忙，哈哈。

scripts.text: I just came by to say hi.
scripts.translation: 我只是順道來打個招呼
請求調整埃特蘭的項鍊

scripts.text: Well, there's really nothing else to improve. I'll let you, {0}, especially to use this whenever you want.
scripts.translation: 嗯，已經沒什麼可改進的了。我特別允許你隨時使用這臺機器。 {0}

scripts.text: Please come anytime to use it. I made it to reach a variety of time channels, but I don't exactly know what will come of it myself.
scripts.translation: 隨時都可以來用。我把它改造成能連線各種時間通道，不過連我也不知道最後會連到哪裡。

scripts.text: You mean Sir Etran's keepsake? I could try to utilize a special magic power stone to imbue the desired effects, but it is an expensive material costing 10 Splendide Coins...
scripts.translation: 你是說埃特蘭大人的信物？我可以試著用特殊魔力石賦予它想要的效果，不過材料很貴，要10枚輝煌領域硬幣...

scripts.text: I guess I'll come back next time...
Sure, let me know when you have them ready. I'll imbue the desired effects.
scripts.translation: 好，準備好後告訴我，我就為它賦予效果。

scripts.text: Oh ok, then should we try imbuing the effects? This process isn't my specialty so I'm a bit nervous, but... hahaha...
scripts.translation: 好，那我們現在就賦予效果嗎？這不是我的專長，我有點緊張...哈哈。

scripts.text: Sure, let me know when you have them ready. I'll restore its effects.
scripts.translation: 好，準備好後告訴我，我會恢復它的效果。

scripts.text: It looks like you don't have enough coins. I would like to take care of it for you, but the material is just way too expensive...
scripts.translation: 你帶的硬幣好像不夠。我很想幫你，可材料實在太貴了...

scripts.text: You don't seem to carry Etran's keepsake with you right now.
scripts.translation: 你身上好像沒帶埃特蘭的信物。

scripts.text: Hmm, what else should I fix. I should have had studied more...
scripts.translation: 嗯，還要修什麼來著？我真該多做些研究...

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我身上的東西好像太重了。減輕負重後再試試吧。

scripts.text: ^000099He is busy fighting against Ford. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: 他正忙著和福特打架。再不阻止的話，可能就沒機會跟他說話了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Where did you find that canned food?
scripts.translation: 你從哪兒弄來那些罐頭的？

scripts.text: I brought it for you guys.
You are a human being and you eat canned food? What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你一個人類居然吃罐頭？你在搞什麼？

scripts.text: Shelby is looking away!! Ford doesn't miss this chance! (Pow pow)
scripts.translation: 謝爾比分心了！！福特不會放過這個機會！（砰砰）

scripts.text: ^000099The fight continues. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: 戰鬥還在繼續。再不阻止的話，可能就沒機會跟他說話了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: should I really receive this from you?......
scripts.translation: 你真的要把這個給我嗎？...

scripts.text: Forget it if you don't want it.
Nah, I'm just kidding! Why would I?
scripts.translation: 騙你的啦！我怎麼會不要呢？

scripts.text: Alright. What is it that you want? Is it what you asked earlier, about dimensional rift fragment?
scripts.translation: 好吧，你想要什麼？是之前問過的次元裂隙碎片相關資料嗎？

scripts.text: Ask about activating the rift fragment.
scripts.translation: 詢問如何啟動次元裂隙碎片

scripts.text: I see, that is what you wanted. It was really difficult to find out since even Midgard scientists try to keep the information away from everyone. Although the information itself was relatively simple compared to the security for it.
scripts.translation: 原來你想要這個。找到資料可不容易，連米德加爾特的科學家都想把它保密。不過比起重重防護，資料內容本身倒挺簡單。

scripts.text: First, to activate the dimensional rift fragment, you need ^0000991 Dark Debris ^000000 to serve as a host. Since the fragment reacts with Moroq's body, you need something that at least resembles it.
scripts.translation: 首先，要啟動次元裂隙碎片，需要1份暗黑碎片作為載體。碎片會和夢羅克的身體產生反應，所以載體至少得和它相似。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you have Dark Crystal, you could exert a greater force, but I could not attain that combination method.
scripts.translation: 如果有暗黑水晶，產生的力量會更強，不過我沒能弄清楚那種組合方法。

scripts.text: If I were to arrange all of the ingredients, you need ^0000991Dark Debris ^000000in addition to ^000099Red/Yellow/Blue Gemstones, 2 of each^000000.

When you create a reaction with rift fragment with the Dark Debris as the host, the surrounding is placed under much metaphysical force. At that time, if you don't have something to offthat side effect = what would happen?
scripts.translation: 以暗黑碎片為載體和裂隙碎片反應時，周圍會受到強烈的超自然力量影響。要是不拿東西抵消副作用，你猜會怎樣？

scripts.text: You probably have seen it before. Like the dimensional rift found in Morocc, the area surrounding it deteriorates. The sacrificial fodder to prevent that are the gemstones.
scripts.translation: 你應該見過類似情況。夢羅克的次元裂隙周圍就會逐漸衰敗。寶石原石就是用來吸收影響的犧牲品。

scripts.text: Now, did I explain that enough? But why are you trying to activate such dangerous items as rift fragments? Are you trying to hold a ritual of summoning from hell or something?
scripts.translation: 這下解釋清楚了吧？不過你為什麼要啟動這麼危險的裂隙碎片？想舉行什麼地獄召喚儀式嗎？

scripts.text: First hand him the canned food.
Hmm? What happened to the canned food you had until a minute ago? Why are your hands empty now?
scripts.translation: 咦？你剛才手裡還有罐頭，怎麼一下子不見了？現在怎麼兩手空空？

scripts.text: Oh! Thanks! This is the first time to receive salary from a human being. I bless your future in the name of the Leopard God.
scripts.translation: 哦！謝啦！這是我第一次收到人類發的薪水。我以豹神之名祝福你的未來。

scripts.text: ^000099Shelby's chubby front paw pats your back to bless you. You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 謝爾比用胖乎乎的前爪拍了拍你的背，為你送上祝福。你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you want cat merchant service, you should look for the agent, not me.
scripts.translation: 嗯？想用貓族商人的服務

scripts.text: If you want cat merchant service, you should look for the agent, not me.
scripts.translation: 就去找代理人，別來找我。

scripts.text: Why? Is it weird to see me after seeing all the cats that are so polite and overly excited?
scripts.translation: 怎麼，見過那些禮貌又熱情過頭的貓之後，再看到我就覺得奇怪嗎？

scripts.text: Meow~ How are youeow~ I really liked canned fisheow~!!...Is this what you wanted?
scripts.translation: 喵~你好嗎喵~我最喜歡魚罐頭喵~！！...這就是你想聽的嗎？

scripts.text: Just because we are cats, it doesn't mean we are all the same. I'm also really depressed right now, so it's probably best for you to look for other cats to help you.
scripts.translation: 我們雖然都是貓，可也各不相同。我現在心情也很差，你還是去找別的貓幫忙吧。

scripts.text: Haha, I can't believe you are asking a cat about that. Our science is not something a lot of people pay attention to. We have our biggest interest in commerce and fishery.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，真不敢相信你會問一隻貓這種事。沒多少人關心我們的科學，我們最感興趣的還是貿易和漁業。

scripts.text: Here's an advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation: 聽我一句勸，別在我這兒浪費時間，去找別人幫忙吧。

scripts.text: Here's some advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation: 聽我一句勸，別在我這兒浪費時間，去找別人幫忙吧。

scripts.text: Let me remind you before you forget, the materials you need to activate the rift fragment are ^000099 1 Dark Debris, 2 of each red/yellow/blue Gemstone^000000.
scripts.translation: 免得你忘了，我提醒一下：啟動裂隙碎片需要1份暗黑碎片，以及紅、黃、藍寶石原石各2顆。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey~ Did you do the past experiment well?
It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品種類好像太多了。減少種類後再試試吧。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我身上的東西好像太重了。減輕負重後再試試吧。

scripts.text: ^000099He is busy fighting against Shelby. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: 他正忙著和謝爾比打架。再不阻止的話，可能就沒機會跟他說話了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Tendery Brand Canned Foods^000000, which are used as salaries, are not being released. Ford is sad. ^000099Shelby^000000 over there also seem depressed~.
^000099Tendery Brand Canned Foods^000000, which are used as salaries, are not being released. Ford is sad. ^000099Shelby^000000 over there also seem depressed~.

Ford doesn't know a difficult thing like that. Ford knows sardines well! Also mackerels! ^000099Dimension... Stuff Shelby knows better!^000000 But Shelby isn't working because he's a down. I don't either!!
scripts.translation: 福特不懂那麼複雜的東西。福特很懂沙丁魚！還有鯖魚！次元...那些謝爾比更懂！可謝爾比心情不好，不肯工作。我也一樣！！ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099You hear the sound of two cats fighting.^000000
scripts.translation: 你聽見兩隻貓打架的聲音。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You gave us salary! You are kind! Shelby likes you too! We don't have to starve anymore!
scripts.translation: 你給我們發工資了！你真好！謝爾比也喜歡你！我們不用捱餓了！

scripts.text: ^000099Seeing how Shelby isn't screaming at Ford, he really must be in a good mood now.^000000
scripts.translation: 謝爾比沒有衝福特大喊大叫，看來他的心情確實好多了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: I've never seen you before... Are you a visitor?
scripts.translation: 我以前沒見過你...你是來探監的嗎？

scripts.text: I see, I don't think I ever saw you on our visitor's list. Who are you visiting?
scripts.translation: 我好像沒在訪客名單上見過你。你要探望誰？

scripts.text: Huh? I've got a visitor? Yahoo! It's a visit! Yay~
scripts.translation: 嗯？有人來看我？耶！有人探監啦！太棒了~

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's expression grows dim. He looks so terrible upon just mentioning the name Clever...^000000
scripts.translation: 獄卒的臉色暗了下來。光是提起聰明鬼的名字，他就一臉痛苦... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Well, on the list at least... It doesn't seem like there is a visit scheduled with Clever...
scripts.translation: 嗯，至少名單上...沒有安排探望聰明鬼的記錄...

scripts.text: Hey~ Guard~ What are you doing? Open this cell quickly, would you! This is a visit, hahaha! If you interfere with my visits, I'm going to sing everytime you work! Aren't you excited?
scripts.translation: 嘿~獄卒~你在幹什麼？快開牢門！有人來看我，哈哈哈！你要是敢妨礙探視，我每次上班都唱歌給你聽！是不是很期待？

scripts.text: Actually, why don't I start singing now?
^000099The guard's face grows even dimmer. His expression betrays his great irritation with the curent situation.^000000
scripts.translation: 獄卒的臉色更加陰沉了，神情裡滿是對當前狀況的不耐煩。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You aren't on the list, but, haha, I guess this is an administrative error. Please go ahead. As far as the time for visitation, hm...
scripts.translation: 你確實不在名單上，不過，哈哈，大概是行政上的疏漏。請進吧。至於探視時間嘛...

scripts.text: You can take as much time as you want. Don't worry about it, and take your time.
scripts.translation: 你想待多久都行。別擔心，慢慢來。

scripts.text: Hmm? You want to visit ^000099{0}^000000? I don't see that visitation on the list. Are you sure you made a formal request?
scripts.translation: 嗯？你要探望？我在名單上沒看到預約。你確定正式申請過了嗎？ ^000099{0}^000000

scripts.text: Please, I ask you. Please shut Mr. Clever's mouth. I've been listening to him for a year now and it's driving me insane. I can't beat a prisoner either...
scripts.translation: 求求你，幫幫我。讓聰明鬼先生閉嘴吧！我聽他唱了一年，快被逼瘋了。我又不能打囚犯...

scripts.text: This is all thanks to you! The fact that Mr. Clever is sleeping, it means that he won't be awake for a few days.
scripts.translation: 這都多虧了你！聰明鬼現在睡著了，接下來幾天應該都不會醒。

scripts.text: I don't know when's the last time I've had this much peace. I pray for the blessing of your home tree.
scripts.translation: 我都不記得上次這麼清靜是什麼時候了。願你的家園之樹賜福於你。

scripts.text: ^000099You gained experience points and job experience points, thanks to Clever's sleep and the guard's happiness.^000000
scripts.translation: 多虧聰明鬼睡著了、獄卒心情大好，你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: ^000099I see a plain-looking journal. It seems to deal with third-rate gossip stories.^000000
scripts.translation: 我看到一本封面樸素的期刊，內容似乎都是三流八卦。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This must be the one that Clever talked about. Extreme articles are faded out. ^000000
scripts.translation: 輯）這應該就是聰明鬼提到的那本。激烈的評論部分已經褪色了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This isn't a history document. It's just a third-rate magazine. Let's look through the table of contents.^000000
scripts.translation: 這不是歷史文獻，只是一本三流雜誌。先看看目錄吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Is there a problem in Yggdrasil? A smell of death began to fill the peaceful land.
scripts.translation: 000000世界樹出問題了嗎？死亡氣息開始瀰漫在這片寧靜的土地上。

scripts.text: Polluted gardens, dried lands, attack of various mutant life forms. A huge change is found in Laphine's place of life.
scripts.translation: 花園遭到汙染，土地乾涸，各種變異生物發起攻擊。拉菲尼族的居住地發生了鉅變。

scripts.text: ^000099(I flip through various faded out pages.)^000000

Laphine's leaders did not doubt that this is the best place for Yggdrasil's guardian. Because of the Elder Assemblly's pressure to establish at such a barren land, it is now difficult to control Laphine citizens.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族的領袖們原本深信，這裡最適合成為世界樹守護者的居所。但長老議會強迫他們在如此貧瘠的土地上建城，如今族人已難以管束。

scripts.text: Cursed times passed with many families and friends suffering through multiple diseases and attacks by indigenous life forms.
scripts.translation: 在那段黑暗時期，許多家庭和朋友飽受疾病與當地生物襲擊之苦。

scripts.text: ^000099(The rest of it is faded out significantly, so it is hard to tell.)^000000
scripts.translation: （剩下的部分褪色得太嚴重，難以辨認。） ^000099^000000
第二章：長老議會的陰謀 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Elder Assembly continued to blame the Laphine leaders for ongoing failures.
scripts.translation: 長老議會將持續的失敗歸咎於拉菲尼族領袖。

scripts.text: Upon hearing that the land has been selected incorrectly, they internally decided to move the capital to the southern areas where the area is flourishing with forests.
scripts.translation: 得知選址有誤後，他們私下決定把首都遷往南方森林茂密的地區。

scripts.text: The scouts sent south found the shocking truth. The forests in the south could not be close to being safe. 90% of the scouts sent were eliminated by an unknown monstrous figure.
scripts.translation: 派往南方的偵察隊發現了驚人真相：南方森林並不安全。派出的偵察兵中有九成遭不明魔物殺害。

scripts.text: However, the Elder Assembly insisted that the area was our destiny and continued to delegate scouting teams. It was a ridiculous decision.
scripts.translation: 然而長老議會堅持認為那片土地是族人的命運，繼續派出偵察隊。這決定簡直荒唐。

scripts.text: As for the leaders, they needed something drastic to oppose Elder Assembly's ridiculous demands. The elders were just too old and ambitious to think practically.
scripts.translation: 領袖們必須採取果斷行動，反對長老議會荒謬的要求。那些長老年紀太大、野心太盛，根本不切實際。

scripts.text: At this point, two Donas, ^000099Etran and Robert,^000000 suggested large-scale restorative efforts to the leaders. These were individuals of greatest restorative abilities and authority among the Laphines.
scripts.translation: 這時，兩位多納族——埃特蘭和羅伯特——向領袖們提出大規模復原計劃。他們是拉菲尼族中最有能力、最有威望的復原專家。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: The leaders began to listen to the strategies suggested by the experts of nature restoration who lived out the principles of restoration all their lives.
scripts.translation: 領袖們開始聽取自然復原專家的方案。他們畢生踐行復原之道。

scripts.text: The suggestions made by the two Dona were crystal clear. ^000099It was to create an enormous home tree to directly fellowship with Yggdrasil and to restore the land all at once^000000.
scripts.translation: 兩位多納族的建議十分明確：建造一棵巨大的家園之樹，直接與世界樹溝通，一舉復原土地。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: As expected, Elder Assembly completely undermines their suggestion. ^000099In order to create home tree, it was necessary to drain the life force from the land. ^000000
scripts.translation: 不出所料，長老議會徹底否決了他們的提議。因為建造家園之樹需要汲取土地中的生命力。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: As such, ^000099creating a home tree to restore the land could be an obstacle instead.^000000 The Elder Assembly argued that the process would be impossible.
scripts.translation: 因此，建造家園之樹來復原土地，反而可能造成阻礙。長老議會聲稱這根本辦不到。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: And they continued to say that for everyone to live, it would be better to move to the south than to restore the barren land. That was their ploy to begin with.
scripts.translation: 他們還說，與其復原貧瘠之地，不如遷往南方，讓所有人活下來。這從一開始就是他們的盤算。

scripts.text: ^000099(There are many ink stains that seem to purposely block out the writing here.)^000000
scripts.translation: （這裡有許多墨跡，像是有人故意塗掉了文字。） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099(There are many ink stains that seem to purposely block out the writing here.)^000000
scripts.translation: （這裡有許多墨跡，像是有人故意塗掉了文字。） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099If it is unfolded carefully, it may reveal the page.^000000
scripts.translation: 小心展開的話，或許能看清上面的文字。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There is a page of reflections by Laphine readers. It might be that they were anonymous, but the comments were written aggressively.^000000
scripts.translation: 這是拉菲尼族讀者留下的評論頁。或許是匿名留言，但語氣都很激烈。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000Who ruined this part here? This is the only copy left!! I love this story.
scripts.translation: 回覆：是誰把這部分弄壞了？這是僅存的一份！！我最喜歡這個故事。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I have another copy that I made. If you want it, let me know.
scripts.translation: ----回覆：我還有一份自己做的副本。想要的話告訴我。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000Hey guys, do you know this? The Elder Assembly at first completely opposed the building of home tree. But it says in the history books that they're the ones that came up with the idea. Isn't that weird? Who's right?
scripts.translation: 回覆：大家知道嗎？長老議會最初完全反對建造家園之樹，可歷史書卻說是他們提出這個主意的。這不奇怪嗎？到底誰說得對？ ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000If you are a Laphine with a wing span greater than 180cm, I'll consider dating you.
scripts.translation: 回覆：如果你是翼展超過180釐米的拉菲尼族，我就考慮和你約會。---------- ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: How did you come up with that?
scripts.translation: 回覆：你怎麼想出這種條件的？ ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000I heard this from my father, but to fight against Elder Assembly's decisions, ^000099Etran and Robert argued one another in front of the elders on purpose.^000000 Is that true?
scripts.translation: 回覆：我聽父親說，為了反對長老議會的決定，埃特蘭和羅伯特曾故意在長老面前爭吵。這是真的嗎？ ^990000^000000^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I heard that too. ^000099To make sure they seem authentic, they started arguing each other a bit by bit from a few days before the meeting^000000. That's the most controversial topic among historians.
scripts.translation: 回覆：我也聽說了。為了讓演戲顯得逼真，他們在會議前幾天就開始一點點爭吵。這是歷史學家間最有爭議的話題。 ^990000^000000^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000There are more idiots that believe this stuff. Hey kids, Eclage Monthly is a third-rate gossip magazine. Don't confuse it with history.
scripts.translation: 回覆：還有人信這種鬼話。喂，小鬼...《埃克拉珠月刊》是三流八卦雜誌，別把它和歷史混為 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: Oh I see. Thank you so much for your wisdom. I guess if you leave comments like that on a third-rate magazine, you just look incredibly smart.
scripts.translation: ----------回覆：噢，明白了。多謝指教。看來在三流雜誌上留言，確實顯得自己特別聰明。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000I'll be running with the high profile photo of Mayor Jun in undies. I'll give it to the first one to claim it!
scripts.translation: 回覆：我要刊出一張君市長穿內衣的高畫質照片。誰先認領就送給誰！------- ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I'll take the photo. I'll put you on our editorial staff.
scripts.translation: 回覆：照片我要了，順便把你招進編輯部。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^000099(You've gathered information about the two Donas, Etran and Robert. Take a note of this and ask Clever about it)^000000
scripts.translation: （你收集到了關於兩位多納族——埃特蘭和羅伯特——的資料。記下來，再去問問聰明鬼。） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The book must be damaged. I can't really open it.^000000
scripts.translation: 這本書似乎損壞了，沒法開啟。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: Hmm? What is this? Am I dreaming? Something feels different.
scripts.translation: 嗯？這是什麼？我是在做夢嗎？總覺得哪裡不一樣。

scripts.text: Can you hear me? Would you be Sir Etran?
scripts.translation: 你聽得到我說話嗎？您是埃特蘭大人嗎？

scripts.text: You know my name? Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你知道我的名字？你是誰？

scripts.text: Are you telling me to believe that story? You are from the future of thousands of years away? That kind of science is available in the future?
scripts.translation: ？你要我相信這種說法？你來自幾千年後的未來？未來竟有這種技術？

scripts.text: Explain to him about the rift reactor.
Sir Etran, it's not that we are from the future, but rather, we opened the walls between the past and the future just temporarily. I have so many questions to ask.
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭大人，並不是我們來自未來，而是暫時打通了過去與未來之間的屏障。我有很多問題想請教您。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran suprisingly looks similar to Clever. Could it be that Clever and Hiel are reincarnations of Etran and Robert? No, that couldn't be...^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭竟然和聰明鬼長得很像。難道聰明鬼和希爾是埃特蘭和羅伯特的轉世？不，不可能... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Ask about the fight with Robert.
scripts.translation: 詢問他和羅伯特爭吵的事

scripts.text: Hmm, the Elder Assembly is really a rotten organization. They're like fossils, still living in the times when Laphines began to exist.
scripts.translation: 長老議會真是腐朽不堪。他們像一群活化石，還活在拉菲尼族剛誕生的年代。

scripts.text: They try to interfere with presidency, politics, culture, and everything else. They are even minding the matters that deal with our survival.
scripts.translation: 他們想幹涉領導層、人事、政治、文化，什麼都要管。甚至連關乎我們生死的事也不放過。

scripts.text: The elders are trying to ignore the practical young leaders of this area who want to establish a capital nearby here. They are only trying to carve out their place in the center of this issue regarding the capital.
scripts.translation: 長老們不理會那些務實的年輕領袖。年輕人想在附近建立首都，長老們卻只想在首都問題上爭權奪勢。

scripts.text: That's why they are pushing for the ridiculous idea of settling in the south.
scripts.translation: 所以他們才會極力推動那個荒唐的南遷計劃。

scripts.text: The young Laphines could never accept that. That's why Robert and I made the outrageous claim that we could restore the area here and blocked off the movement toward the south.
scripts.translation: 年輕的拉菲尼族絕不會接受。於是羅伯特和我提出一個大膽的主張：復原這片土地，以此阻止南遷。

scripts.text: Of course... It would only be significant if we succeed. If we fail, many more young Laphines would be sent off to the south.
scripts.translation: 當然，只有成功才有意義。一旦失敗，就會有更多年輕的拉菲尼族被送往南方。

scripts.text: I can no longer let the elders shed the blood of the young Laphines.
scripts.translation: 我不能再讓長老們犧牲年輕拉菲尼族的性命。說實話，我沒什麼把握。如今彩虹橋已衰敗得太嚴重，再多生命力也看不到盡頭。

scripts.text: Oh yeah, you talking about the time we argued in front of the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation: 哦，你是說我們在長老議會面前爭吵的事。

scripts.text: That happened about a year ago from the dimension that I'm currently in. Because we wanted to draw the elders' attention to our idea, we made them focus on only two issues, home tree's restoration or the land's restoration.
scripts.translation: 那是我所在的維度裡，大約一年前發生的事。為了讓長老們正視我們的主張，我們把議題集中在兩件事上：復原家園之樹，還是復原土地。

scripts.text: We succeeded ultimately. They didn't even get to discuss the option of settling in the forests of the south. It just had too many Laphine lives at stake.
scripts.translation: 最後我們成功了。他們甚至沒能討論遷往南方森林的方案，因為那會犧牲太多拉菲尼族的性命。

scripts.text: If I could meet Robert later, I wish to continue that conversation.
scripts.translation: 若之後能再見到羅伯特，我還想把那次談話

scripts.text: I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation: 繼續下去。說實話，我沒什麼把握。如今的彩虹橋已衰敗得太嚴重，再多生命力也看不到盡頭。

scripts.text: Furthermore, the energy that the home tree consumes is just too colossal and too rapid.
scripts.translation: 而且家園之樹消耗能量的規模太大，速度也太快。

scripts.text: Robert is probably doing everything he can. Once the home tree connected to a piece of land, the entire area will be consumed. To prevent that, he put his life on the line.
scripts.translation: 羅伯特一定在竭盡全力。家園之樹一旦紮根某片土地，整片區域都會被它吸乾。為了阻止這一切，他賭上了性命。

scripts.text: You get the idea right? Our roles are in two parts right now. Me, who focuses on pouring out the energy into the land. Robert, who blocks off the home tree's wild consumption.
scripts.translation: 明白了嗎？我們現在各司其職：我負責把能量注入土地，羅伯特負責阻止家園之樹瘋狂汲取能量。

scripts.text: If the balance between us two is not maintained, the entire land will be destroyed along with home tree. The problem is, I just don't know if we are doing it all correctly.
scripts.translation: 如果我們無法維持平衡，整片土地和家園之樹都會毀滅。問題是，我不知道我們的做法到底對不對。
實際上，你的計劃成功了

scripts.text: You succeeded. Bifrost, full of flowers and grass, is a land of plenty.
scripts.translation: 你成功了。彩虹橋繁花綠草遍地，是一片富饒的土地。

scripts.text: Would you like to see for yourself?
Sure. Lead the way. I'll follow...
^000099The additional reaction does not get reduced.^000000
Oh? Something's familiar. Would you be that traveler from the future?
scripts.translation: 哦？這感覺真熟悉。你就是那位來自未來的旅行者吧？

scripts.text: You are here! I was worried that you wouldn't come back!
scripts.translation: 你來了！我還擔心你不會再回來了！

scripts.text: After your visit, I felt so much lighter. I was also excited to control the life force.
scripts.translation: 你來過之後，我感覺輕鬆多了，也更有信心去操控生命力了。

scripts.text: More importantly, did you give the necklace to Robert? And what about the leaf of the home tree?
scripts.translation: 對了，你把項鍊交給羅伯特了嗎？家園之樹的葉子呢？

scripts.text: Give the necklace and the home tree leaf.
scripts.translation: 交出項鍊和家園之樹的葉子

scripts.text: Wow, it was true that home tree has grown! What a relief!!
scripts.translation: 哇，家園之樹真的長大了！太好了！！

scripts.text: But even so, it's a bit sad that he didn't keep the necklace...
scripts.translation: 不過，他沒把項鍊留下，還是有點讓人難過...

scripts.text: I see. Robert, as usual, is strong unlike me. That's Robert's strong point.
scripts.translation: 原來如此。羅伯特一如既往地堅強，而我卻不一樣。這正是羅伯特的過人之處。

scripts.text: And, Sir Robert also asked me to tell you this.
scripts.translation: 還有，羅伯特先生讓我轉告您：

scripts.text: That as much as you trust in me, ^000099I trust in you^000000...

scripts.translation: 羅伯特真的這麼說？真的嗎？

scripts.text: I think this is the first time he's ever said he trusts me ever since we started working together. Now I can just focus and give all my heart to putting energy into this land.
scripts.translation: 這是我們開始合作以來，他第一次說信任我。現在我可以全心投入，把能量注入這片土地了。
埃特蘭的肩膀似乎微微顫抖。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: I didn't get to know you very long, but thank you, traveler from the future.
scripts.translation: 雖然我們相識不久，還是謝謝你，來自未來的旅行者。

scripts.text: By the way, the necklace that Robert refused to keep. I'll give it to you as a token of gratitude. Just keep it for yourself.
scripts.translation: 對了，羅伯特不肯收下的項鍊，就送給你作謝禮吧。請你留著。

scripts.text: Well then, I should get going. Also, please send my word of appreciation to the person who built this incredible machine.
scripts.translation: 那麼，我該繼續忙了。也請替我向製造這臺奇妙機器的人道謝。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's keepsake was received. It is possible to equip it, but ^ff0000to utilize its full strength,^000099 I would need Hiel's help later.^000000
scripts.translation: 你得到了埃特蘭的信物。雖然可以裝備，但要發揮它的全部力量，之後還得請希爾幫忙。 ^000099^ff0000^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This is a grave where communication with Etran was established. He must have spent his last days around here.^000000
scripts.translation: 這裡是與埃特蘭建立聯絡的墓地。他晚年應該就在附近度過。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There is a cemetery unfitting with the tower. It's so worn down that it's difficult to tell whose graves these are.^000000
scripts.translation: 這座墓地和高塔格格不入。墓碑風化得太嚴重，已經難以辨認墓主。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: This is tough. The energy consumed by the home tree is greater than I thought. Even if Robert is providing some control, was this impossible to begin with?
scripts.translation: 這很難辦。家園之樹消耗的能量比我想像的要大。即使有羅伯特進行一些控制，這從一開始就是不可能做到的嗎？

scripts.text: ^000099I'm here!! Let's take this reactor closer.^000000
scripts.translation: 我來了！！我們把反應器再往前移一點吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: Is this real. This isn't a dream, is it... {0}.
scripts.translation: 這是真的嗎。這不是夢，對吧... 。 {0}

scripts.text: What you are seeing now is home for thousands of Laphine descendants, Bifrost the land of life.
scripts.translation: 你現在看到的，是數千名拉菲尼族後裔的家園——生命之地彩虹橋。

scripts.text: I wasn't wrong. I wasn't wrong.
^000099Etran started to sob and seemed to be free from the burden of his life. He seemed to remember something and asked a question.^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭開始啜泣，似乎卸下了生命中的重擔。他似乎想起了什麼，問了一個問題。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: But, what about Robert's home tree? What happened to his home tree?
scripts.translation: 那麼，羅伯特的家園之樹呢？長得怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: His home tree also grew very well.
scripts.translation: 他的家園之樹也長得很好

scripts.text: I see. I would like to see the home tree he nurtured... Would you take me there too?
scripts.translation: 是嗎...我真想看看他培育的家園之樹...你能帶我去看看嗎？

scripts.text: Unfortunately, this reactor's range is too small that while I try to take you there, the connection will drop. I'm afraid it's impossible.
scripts.translation: 很遺憾，這臺反應器的作用範圍太小，帶您過去的話，連線就會中斷。恐怕辦不到。

scripts.text: Did Robert really succeed too? Are you trying to keep his failures from me by any chance?
scripts.translation: 羅伯特真的成功了嗎？你該不會是在隱瞞他的失敗吧？

scripts.text: Should I bring something to prove it to you?
scripts.translation: 我該帶點什麼來證明給你看嗎？
帶一片家園之樹的葉子

scripts.text: A cat's canned food? How does that have anything to do with home tree?
scripts.translation: 貓罐頭？這和家園之樹有什麼關係？

scripts.text: Oh, I was just talking nonsense for a bit.
scripts.translation: 哦，我剛才隨口亂說的。啊，家園之樹的葉子！沒錯，家園之樹長成後就會長出葉子，這種葉子是其他植物沒有的。

scripts.text: A Laphine's coin? Is it something new? Does home tree produce coins now?
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族的硬幣？那是什麼新東西嗎？家園之樹還會長硬幣？

scripts.text: No, that doesn't happen. I just chose a bad example.
scripts.translation: 不，不會那樣。我只是舉了個不恰當的

scripts.text: Ah, home tree's leaf. Tha's right. If a home tree grows properly, it would bare leaves. It's not something you can see in other plants.
scripts.translation: 例子。啊，家園之樹的葉子！沒錯，家園之樹長成後就會長出葉子，這種葉子是其他植物沒有的。

scripts.text: How does a home tree leaf look like? Are there characteristics that make it unique such as color?
scripts.translation: 家園之樹的葉子是什麼樣的？有什麼特別之處嗎，比如顏色？

scripts.text: I only heard about it. I never saw it myself. I've heard that a home tree with abundant life force demonstrates a gold color.
scripts.translation: 我只聽說過，自己從沒見過。據說生命力旺盛的家園之樹會呈現出金色。

scripts.text: I don't know anything besides that. But if it is a real home tree leaf, there's no way I wouldn't be able to tell. The life reaction from a home tree leaf is incredible.
scripts.translation: 除此之外我就不知道了。但如果是真正的家園之樹葉子，我肯定認得出來。它散發的生命反應非常強烈。

scripts.text: If you bring me a fully grown home tree leaf, I will never give up. You can't fake Robert's success, you see.
scripts.translation: 如果你帶來一片完全成熟的家園之樹葉子，我就絕不會放棄。畢竟羅伯特的成功是偽造不了的。

scripts.text: This necklace... Please give it to Robert. Tell him that I never gave up and that we must give our all...
scripts.translation: 這條項鍊...請把它交給羅伯特。告訴他我從未放棄，我們必須全力以赴...

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's figure begins to fade out. The reactor's force must have weakened. ^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭的身影開始消散，反應器的能量似乎減弱了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099His necklace dropped onto the grass as Etran's figure faded away. ^000000
scripts.translation: 隨著埃特蘭身影的消失，他的項鍊掉在了草地上。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099You obtained a worn out necklace. It feels like an unknown energy of life is entering the body.^000000
scripts.translation: 你獲得了一條破舊的項鍊。感覺有一股未知的生命能量正湧入體內。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你獲得了經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: This is the home tree that you nurtured.
scripts.translation: 這就是你培育的家園之樹

scripts.text: It grew up so well. I thought it was impossible... I thought I would never see it.
scripts.translation: 它長得真好。我曾以為這是不可能的...我以為我永遠看不到這一天。

scripts.text: ^000099Robert teared up, full of emotion. Right then, Robert's figure started fading away.^000000
scripts.translation: 羅伯特淚流滿面，情緒激動。就在那時，羅伯特的身影開始消散。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hmm? I feel weird. What's happening to my body? Am I dreaming?
scripts.translation: 嗯？我感覺不對勁。我的身體怎麼了？我是在做夢嗎？

scripts.text: Hey, are you there? I can't hear my own voice. Hey!! {0} Can you hear me?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你在嗎？我聽不到自己的聲音了。嘿！！ 你能聽到我嗎？ {0}

scripts.text: ^000099It hasn't even been more than a few minutes, but Robert's figure disappeared. Let's go back to Hiel first and figure out what may be going on.^000000
scripts.translation: 這才過了幾分鐘，羅伯特的身影就消失了。讓我們先回到希爾那裡，弄清楚到底發生了什麼。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: Whoaaa~ It's a green monster! Run awayyy! (Static static)
scripts.translation: 哇哦~是綠色的怪物！快跑啊！（滋滋聲）

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Is the meat ready yet? I can't wait any longer... (Static static)
scripts.translation: 肉好了嗎？我等不及了...（滋滋聲）

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Ayyyy!!! What did I tell you!!!
^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran. It's actually a dimension that makes me feel bad.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。不知為何，我感覺有些不舒服。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。
