scripts.text: My father did not steal the refined items!!
scripts.translation: 我父親沒有偷那些精煉物品！！

scripts.text: Quiet kid. No matter what anyone says, your father is a cheap shot who stole refined items. If you are upabout that = try coming back. I'll face up to your revenge any day.
scripts.translation: 閉嘴，小孩。不管別人怎麼說，你父親就是個偷竊精煉物品的卑鄙小人。如果你不服氣=就回來試試。我隨時接受你的復仇。

scripts.text: I'll refine your helm with your head in it one day.
scripts.translation: 總有一天，我會把你連同頭盔一起精煉掉。

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: I... I did it. The restricted area!! Absolute zero ductility!!!!!! And they stole it from me. My gravitational pull of 300 grams.
scripts.translation: 是...是我乾的。禁區！！絕對零度延展性！！！！！！他們從我這裡偷走了它。還有我300克的引力場。

scripts.text: Chatting is prohibited in front of the oven, student Orlean.
scripts.translation: 奧爾良同學，在爐子前禁止閒聊。

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Is this-...(Static static) Is this guy really in the right mind?
scripts.translation: 這是...（滋滋聲）這傢伙真的神志清醒嗎？

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。 ^000099^000000

scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: Son... What is the meaning of this.
I'm putting the equipment to rest, father...
scripts.translation: 父親...我要讓裝備安息了...

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran. It's cold somehow.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。不知為何，這裡很冷。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated, but the dimension does not seem to be related to Etran. It smells delicious somehow.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了，但這個次元似乎和埃特蘭無關。不知為何，這裡聞起來很香。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You don't know why I'm upset, do you?
scripts.translation: 你不知道我為什麼生氣，對吧？

scripts.text: I said I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我說我很抱歉。我很抱歉。

scripts.text: What are you sorry about it.
^000099The reactor was activated but... For some reason, I'm getting annoyed.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了...不知為何，我有點煩躁。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: Now now, if you sleep, it will be all over... Such a thing as Christmas.
scripts.translation: 好了好了，如果你睡著了，這一切就都結束了...比如聖誕節之類的事情。

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated but... For some reason, I'm getting lonely.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了...不知為何，我感到很孤獨。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: I give my body and soul to this set of headphones.
scripts.translation: 我將我的身體和靈魂都獻給了這副耳機。

scripts.text: Music is the only drug that the nation allows legally...
scripts.translation: 音樂是唯一一種被國家合法允許的毒品...

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor picked up the desperation of an adventurer who acquired some headphones from some place... ^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器捕捉到了一名冒險者的絕望氣息。他不知從哪裡弄來一副耳機... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: Turn to the right twice. No, to the left. Yes~ Little bit more to the left. Hold your breath~ Yes, let it out now. Please keep the remaining medication in your mouth.
scripts.translation: 向右轉兩次。不，向左。對~ 再往左一點。屏住呼吸~ 對，現在吐出來。請讓剩下的藥物留在嘴裡。

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated. Somehow it felt like I had to do whatever they said in it.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了。不知為何，我覺得自己不得不照他們說的做。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Baby, you don't know why I'm upset, do you?
scripts.translation: 寶寶，你不知道我為什麼生氣，對吧？

scripts.text: I said I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我說我很抱歉。我很抱歉。

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated but... For some reason, I'm getting annoyed.^000000
scripts.translation: 反應器啟動了...不知為何，我有點煩躁。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Pan-galactic ultra genius engineer Hiel's strange and creepy workshop.
scripts.translation: 泛銀河系超天才工程師希爾的怪異且令人毛骨悚然的工作室

scripts.text: Normal Laphines, animals, and Saphas are prohibited.
scripts.translation: 。禁止普通拉菲尼族、動物和薩法族進入。

scripts.text: If you would like to go down, please press the bell~
scripts.translation: 如果您想下去，請按下鈴鐺~

scripts.text: Baby, you don't know why I'm upset, do you?
scripts.translation: 寶寶，你不知道我為什麼生氣，對吧？

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起來物品種類太多了。讓我們減少種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。讓我們減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: ^000099It's a workshop with lots of oddities.^000000
scripts.translation: 這是一個充滿奇奇怪怪東西的工作室。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099It looks like Hiel's preliminary rift reactor. It seems like it could be operated upon touching it.^000000
scripts.translation: 看起來像是希爾的初步裂隙反應堆。似乎觸控它就可以操作。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as the Dark Debris was placed in the middle of Hiel's arrangement, everything went dark and a strange voice appeared out of nowhere.^000000
scripts.translation: 當暗黑碎片被放置在希爾排列的中心時，一切變得黑暗，一個奇怪的聲音不知從哪裡出現了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: According to the estimation, the time it takes for home tree's restoration is at least 200 years. During that period, 80% of life forms on this land will be destroyed.
scripts.translation: 根據估算，家園之樹的恢復至少需要200年。在此期間，這片土地上80%的生命形式將被摧毀。

scripts.text: However, if we were to take care of the life forms in the land without restoring home tree, without the basic resources to support the life forms, it will inevitably reach destruction. That period would not even last more than 400 years.
scripts.translation: 然而，如果我們不恢復家園之樹，就無法維持這片土地上的生命形式。沒有維持生命所需的基本資源，毀滅是不可避免的。那段時期甚至不會超過400年。

scripts.text: Will we enjoy long lasting peace taking into account the 200 years of sacrifice? Or, do we just die out after working to sustain life for 400 years.
scripts.translation: 考慮到200年的犧牲，我們能否享受長久的和平？還是說，我們在維持生命400年後就會滅絕。

scripts.text: We ask for the wisdom of Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation: 我們請求長老議會的智慧。

scripts.text: We will first consider your report. The assembly's decision is.... (Static... Static)
scripts.translation: 我們將首先考慮你們的報告。議會的決定是... (靜電... 靜電)

scripts.text: ^000099Noises interfered the voice and the present time returned.^000000
scripts.translation: 噪音干擾了聲音，時間回到了現在。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099It looks like Hiel's preliminary rift reactor. It seems like it could be operated upon touching it.^000000
scripts.translation: 看起來像是希爾的初步裂隙反應堆。似乎觸控它就可以操作。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel seems to continue with the improvement. It does not seem right to touch it.^000000
scripts.translation: 希爾似乎還在繼續改進。現在去碰它似乎不太合適。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Could this be... the guys from last time?
scripts.translation: 難道這是...上次那幾個人？

scripts.text: Come to think of it,{0}, you disappeared after leaving me in front of home tree!
scripts.translation: 說起來，，你把我丟在家園之樹前就消失了！ {0}

scripts.text: ^000099It was good that Robert appeared in such clarity. But he seems really mad about the time when the communication got cut off last time. Let's first calm his hand holding my collar up.^000000
scripts.translation: 羅伯特出現得如此清晰，這很好。但他似乎對上次通訊中斷的事非常生氣。先讓他鬆開抓著我衣領的手吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Please give me some time to explain!
Hmm? The necklace in your right hand...
I bought it at the market.
You may fool others, but you can't fool me. Tell me straight. Where is that necklace from?
scripts.translation: 你可以騙別人，但騙不了我。老實說。那條項鍊是從哪來的？

scripts.text: As you know, this is Sir Etran's necklace.
scripts.translation: 如你所知，這是埃特蘭大人的項鍊。

scripts.text: Sir Etran seemed exhausted. So I showed him how the future of his work looks like.
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭大人看起來筋疲力盡，於是我讓他看了自己努力的成果在未來是什麼樣子。

scripts.text: He didn't know whether his work was a success or a failure, but after seeing Bifrost full of life, he found the strength to continue.
scripts.translation: 他不知道自己的努力究竟成功還是失敗，但看到生機盎然的彩虹橋後，終於有了繼續下去的力量。
我明白了。原來是這麼回事。

scripts.text: And Sir Etran asked me to deliver this necklace to you. It was to let you know that he won't ever give up the future of Bifrost he's seen.
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭大人托我把這條項鍊交給您。他想讓您知道，絕不會放棄自己所看見的彩虹橋未來。

scripts.text: The only thing is.. He was worried about how you were doing. Especially since he couldn't see whether your home tree grew successfully.
scripts.translation: 只是...他很擔心您的情況，尤其是沒法確認您的家園之樹是否成功長成。

scripts.text: That can't be helped. The one who is putting in the life force cannot leave the place.
scripts.translation: 那也沒辦法。負責注入生命力的人不能離開那裡。

scripts.text: Is it possible to obtain a home tree leaf?
scripts.translation: 能拿到一片家園之樹的葉子嗎？

scripts.text: Ah, you are trying to show Etran my home tree's leaf. You ask such an obvious question...
scripts.translation: 啊，你想把我家園之樹的葉子拿給埃特蘭看。你問得還真直接...

scripts.text: In fact, my home tree just bloomed up its first leaf. It's very big and full of splendor. Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 我的家園之樹剛剛長出第一片葉子。它又大又美。稍等我一下。

scripts.text: ^000099Robert's reaction has not emerged yet. He must be still in the process of obtainig a home tree leaf.^000000
scripts.translation: 羅伯特還沒有回應，應該還在設法取得一片家園之樹的葉子。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Take this home tree leaf. This is a leaf that I obtained myself, so it won't affect home tree much at all.
scripts.translation: 拿著這片葉子吧。這是我親自摘下的，不會對家園之樹造成什麼影響。

scripts.text: And the necklace you gave me earlier, I understand very well the will of Etran, so you can just return it back to him.
scripts.translation: 至於你之前給我的項鍊，我明白埃特蘭的心意。請把它還給他。

scripts.text: There's no way I would feel good after receiving a necklace from that kid. I know it might be troublesome, but please give it back to him.
scripts.translation: 收下那孩子的項鍊，我怎麼可能心安？雖然麻煩你了，還是請把它還給他。

scripts.text: Oh, and please tell him I said this. As much as you trust in me, ^000099I trust in you^000000.^000000
scripts.translation: 還有，請把這句話轉告他：正如你信任我，我也信任你。 ^000099^000000^000000

scripts.text: And to not cry anywhere he goes... Wait, no I take that one back.
scripts.translation: 還有，叫他別到處哭...等等，這句我收回。

scripts.text: ^000099After making that statement, Robert disappeared back into the reactor. In my hand were Robert's home tree leaf and Etran's necklace.^000000
scripts.translation: 說完後，羅伯特的身影消失在反應器中。我手裡拿著羅伯特的家園之樹葉和埃特蘭的項鍊。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099With the energy from the golden leaf, my body and mind feel like they are rejuvenated. Gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 金色葉片的能量讓我的身心彷彿重獲新生。你獲得了基礎經驗值和職業經驗值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The rift reactor is lying here. I guess I don't have use for it right now.^000000
scripts.translation: 裂隙反應器放在這裡。現在應該用不上。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Now, the rift reactor could be used to look at the past, present, or other dimensions. Let's take a look at it whenever necessary. ^000000
scripts.translation: 現在可以用裂隙反應器檢視過去、現在或其他次元。需要時再來看看吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: A person like you who doesn't know the power of love is destitute!!
scripts.translation: 不知道愛的力量有多強大的人，真可憐！！

scripts.text: ^000099It's been a while since I felt that about myself. Yes, indeed... This machine is getting on my nerves.^000000
scripts.translation: 我好久沒這麼有感觸了。沒錯...這臺機器真讓我火大。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: CHTTTTSTATIC~~~~ ANG!?~~ CHTTTTT ~ oh my shoulder!!
scripts.translation: 嘶嘶嘶~~~~啊！？~~嘶嘶嘶~我的肩膀！！

scripts.text: ^000099Oh, I'm sorry. I'm going to leave this channel.^000000
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉，我要退出這個頻道了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey Robert, do you know? My sad expression... There is a sad legend here.
scripts.translation: 羅伯特，你知道嗎？我這張悲傷的表情背後，還有個悲傷傳說。

scripts.text: The person who drew me. He couldn't get into it when he was drawing the sad expression.
scripts.translation: 畫我的那個人，畫這個悲傷表情時怎麼也畫不出來。

scripts.text: Wait a minute! What are you trying to say. If you are trying to say something dangerous for the present time, you should let it be!!
scripts.translation: 等等，你想說什麼？要是這話會影響現在，就別說了！！

scripts.text: Nah~ why not? This trascends time and space. Where else would I talk about it?
scripts.translation: 哎呀~有什麼關係？這可是超越時空的對話，我還能在哪兒說？

scripts.text: Hm, ok fine. If that's the case, let's just hear the rest of that story. So what happened to that Mr. L?
scripts.translation: 好吧，那就聽你把故事說完。那個L先生後來怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: (This guy mentioned his initial! Ok, this guy is making it more dangerous than I am!!) He took out equipments from the storage to see if he wants to refine them.
scripts.translation: （這傢伙居然說出了首字母！他比我還危險！！）他從倉庫拿了些裝備出來，想看看要不要精煉。

scripts.text: His expression then is this one here. Isn't it sad?
scripts.translation: 他當時就是這副表情。很悲傷吧？

scripts.text: ^000099What if Etran and Robert were the prisoner and the guard?^000000
scripts.translation: 如果埃特蘭和羅伯特就是囚犯和獄卒呢？ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey Guard~ I think the humidity here is too high. My skin is gonna be ruined. Is that ok? Huh?
scripts.translation: 嘿，衛兵~這裡溼氣太重了，我的皮膚都要毀了。這樣行嗎？嗯？

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were put to work as cat merchants.^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭和羅伯特被安排去當貓族商人了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Welcome welcomeow~! We are cat merchants, always serving guests as our kingeow~! Special sale! One piece of meat for 200 Zeny!!
scripts.translation: 歡迎歡迎喵~！我們是貓族商人，會像招待國王一樣招待客人喵~特價優惠！肉一塊只要200 Zeny！！

scripts.text: If you buy it now, we will also give you 3 canned foodseow!! Buy lotseow!!!
scripts.translation: 現在買還送三罐貓糧喵！！多買些喵！！！

scripts.text: (Hey, Robert! Don't just stand there and imitate a cat or something! If you just stand still, we are gonna be kicked out!)
scripts.translation: （喂，羅伯特！別站著學貓叫啊！你再不動，我們就要被趕走了！）

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were placed in a Flight machine.^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭和羅伯特被安排進了一臺飛行器。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey Robert, don't you love this machine that flies in the air?
scripts.translation: 嘿，羅伯特，你不喜歡這臺能在天上飛的機器嗎？

scripts.text: Huh? Why are you looking so green? What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 嗯？你臉色怎麼發青了？不舒服嗎？

scripts.text: Etran, I was looking for a restroom here.
Ok, so what about the restroom.
They don't have one here. No restrooms here.
scripts.translation: 這裡沒有洗手間。哪兒都沒有。

scripts.text: ^000099We will be arriving at Izlude Airport in 6 hours. ^000000
scripts.translation: 我們將在6小時後抵達依斯魯得島機場。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hahahha, I can't keep myself from laughing after listening to you.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈，聽你這麼一說我就忍不住笑。

scripts.text: Let us go as we are to Izlude!!!
scripts.translation: 我們就這樣飛去依斯魯得島吧！！！

scripts.text: I'm going to bake a pie now.
Are you going to add some blueberries too? I love blueberry pies!
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？會加藍莓嗎？我最喜歡藍莓派了！

scripts.text: Of course. I'm also going to add some raspberries from morning and add some syrup too.
scripts.translation: 當然。我還會加上早上摘的覆盆子，再淋些糖漿。

scripts.text: Raspberries will add that berry citrus flavor!! I love raspberry pies! How many are you baking? Isn't two just too little?
scripts.translation: 覆盆子會增添莓果的酸香！我超愛覆盆子派！你烤幾個？只烤兩個不嫌少嗎？

scripts.text: I'm going to bake 1. You aren't getting one.
Oh man~ I'm craving for some chilled beer and yakitori back in the human world~
scripts.translation: 哎呀~真想念人類世界的冰啤酒和烤串啊~

scripts.text: Robert! Robert! Did you see the new yakitori place here? They are doing a grand opening sale today! Let's go eat some!
scripts.translation: 羅伯特！你看到新開的烤串店了嗎？今天開業大酬賓！一起去吃吧！

scripts.text: How could you be talking about beer? You should be ashamed of yourself, Etran~
scripts.translation: 串？）居然提啤酒？埃特蘭，你該感到羞愧~

scripts.text: Huh?... You don't like beer, Robert?
scripts.translation: 咦？羅伯特，你不喜歡啤酒嗎？

scripts.text: That's just something that humans drink. You go ahead. I don't really care for it.
scripts.translation: 那是人類喝的東西。你去喝吧，我沒興趣。

scripts.text: But do they have good yakitori there?
scripts.translation: 不過，那裡的烤串好吃嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah!! Totally good! Do you want to go? Huh?
scripts.translation: 好吃！！特別好吃！你也想去嗎？嗯？

scripts.text: Well, it's not that I really want yakitori or anything, but....
scripts.translation: 我也不是特別想吃烤串啦，不過...

scripts.text: Etran is going to be back soon. By then, it should be ready.
scripts.translation: 埃特蘭很快就回來，應該剛好能烤好。

scripts.text: Ah~ very good. Look at this perfect pie. The fragrance is amazing, too. Should I taste it a bit?
scripts.translation: 啊~真不錯。看看這完美的派，香氣也很棒。要不要先嚐一口？

scripts.text: I'll eat it with him when Etran comes home.
^000099Robert who went over to Etran's house with the pie.^000000
scripts.translation: 羅伯特帶著派去了埃特蘭家。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Welcome to Etran's home! I went to Bifrost to water some plants! It's going to take at least two days because the land is so large. Any gifts can be left at the door.
scripts.translation: 歡迎來我家！我去彩虹橋給植物澆水了！地方太大，至少要花兩天。有禮物的話就放門口吧。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sure there won't be anyone with gifts. Especially nothing like Robert bringing a nicely baked pie, hahaha.
scripts.translation: 當然，肯定沒人帶禮物來。更不會有人像羅伯特那樣帶來剛烤好的派，哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ok, I didn't! My gosh, I didn't bake the pie!!!
scripts.translation: 才沒有！天啊，我根本沒烤派！！！
童年好友：埃特蘭與羅伯特 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey, why are you crying like that?
Sob sob...Dona of the same class are making fun of my size and calling me a Papang...
scripts.translation: 嗚嗚...同班的多納族笑我個子矮，還叫我帕潘族...

scripts.text: That's all it was? Just because they call you a Papang, it doesn't mean you, a Dona, will turn into a Papang! Those guys just wanted to see you cry. Why don't you stop crying?
scripts.translation: 就因為他們叫你帕潘族？你是多納族，怎麼可能就變成帕潘族！他們只是想看你哭，別哭了。

scripts.text: Really now... You cry too often.
I wish I was as calm and cool as you were, Robert.
scripts.translation: 我真希望自己能像你一樣冷靜又帥氣，羅伯特。

scripts.text: Psh, you are 100 years too early to be as cool as I am...
scripts.translation: 哼，想變得像我這麼帥，你還差一百年呢...

scripts.text: ^FF0000This is the place where those kids who make fun of Etran hang out often. Shall I see who they are?^000000
scripts.translation: 那些嘲笑埃特蘭的小鬼常在這裡出沒。要不要查查他們是誰？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Nobody knows why, but it was told that the Laphines who made fun of Etran were hospitalized for 4 weeks.^000000
scripts.translation: 沒人知道原因，不過據說那些嘲笑埃特蘭的拉菲尼族住院了四周。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You shouldn't be a kid like this~ School violence is an unforgivable crime. Friends should stay away from violence and spend good times together.
scripts.translation: 別做這種幼稚的事~校園暴力不可饒恕。朋友之間應該遠離暴力，好好相處。

scripts.text: ^0000993 minutes in boiling water... What after that. Does it mean it will die 3 minutes in boiling water? Do I pour the boiling water over a monster or something?^000000
scripts.translation: 沸水煮三分鐘...然後呢？是說它會在沸水裡煮三分鐘後死掉嗎？我要把沸水倒在魔物身上嗎？ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Houston~ Houston~ This is CHTTTCHTTT~ We see a large tower and a tree. It seems like there are life forms here on this planet as well~ STATIC~ ^000000
scripts.translation: 休斯頓~休斯頓~這裡是嘶嘶嘶~我們看到一座高塔和一棵樹。這個星球上似乎也有生命體~雜音~ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Some desperate voices are heard. Not sure what the words, planets and life forms, are referring to.^000000
scripts.translation: 傳來幾道絕望的聲音。我不明白他們說的“行星”和“生命體”指什麼。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There's too much static. Try adjusting the frequency. ^000000
scripts.translation: 雜音太多了。試著調一下頻率。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The work desk is a huge mess.^000000
Looking at this beautiful field, the song sings itself~
scripts.translation: 看著這片美麗田野，歌聲彷彿自然而然就響起來了~

scripts.text: It's always so beautiful with flowers blooming everywhere.
What is Eclage like? It's such a nice place.
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠是什麼樣的地方？那裡真不錯。

scripts.text: People wouldn't hate or hold each other at knife point if their hearts are filled with love for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation: 如果心裡充滿對花朵和大地的愛，人們就不會彼此憎恨，也不會刀劍相向。

scripts.text: You should avoid going into the tower. It's dangerous. We can't do much for the ones who have already entered, though.
scripts.translation: 別進塔裡，那裡很危險。至於已經進去的人，我們也幫不上忙。

scripts.text: I appreciate what you did last time. The earth seemed to be in a good mood, too. I could just feel it. Would you mind helping us again?
scripts.translation: 上次多虧你幫忙。大地看起來心情也很好，我能感覺到。你願意再幫我們一次嗎？

scripts.text: It seems like the earth is feeling well right now. A little break would be nice.
scripts.translation: 看來大地現在感覺不錯，稍微歇會兒也好。

scripts.text: There are four in the work group. Don't forget to tell everyone.
scripts.translation: 工作組有四個人，記得通知大家。

scripts.text: Thanks. Can you hear the earth singing? The sound of flowers and trees dancing in the wind. You'll hear it someday.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。你聽見大地的歌聲了嗎？那是花草樹木在風中起舞的聲音。總有一天你也會聽見。

scripts.text: Glad you're here. We're about to start working again. Would you help us?
scripts.translation: 很高興你來了。我們馬上要重新開工，能幫幫我們嗎？

scripts.text: Thanks so much! Tell Laphines to start working!
scripts.translation: 太感謝了！告訴拉菲尼族們開始工作吧！

scripts.text: Do you hear the voice of the earth fading to a whisper? Looks like it's not feeling well today.
scripts.translation: 你聽見大地的聲音微弱得像耳語嗎？看來它今天不太舒服。

scripts.text: We should do something to bring cheer to the earth at a time like this!
scripts.translation: 這種時候，我們得想辦法讓大地開心起來！

scripts.text: We should go check if the adventurers are okay.
scripts.translation: 我們去看看冒險者們是否平安吧。

scripts.text: Should I say it's a relief that they're all alive...? Well...at least it's good that they're still alive.
scripts.translation: 該說他們都活著真讓人安心嗎...嗯...至少還活著就好。

scripts.text: There are three adventurers in the tower still. I understand they have their own reasons, but I can't help worrying about them.
scripts.translation: 塔裡還有三名冒險者。我知道他們各有理由，可還是忍不住擔心。

scripts.text: Please, make sure you check how the adventurers are doing. Who knows, you'll get some help from them in the future.
scripts.translation: 記得確認那些冒險者的情況。說不定以後會需要他們幫忙。

scripts.text: I'm glad they're all safe and sound. I'll be relieved if they finish their business quickly and go back...Thanks anyway!
scripts.translation: 他們都平安無事，真好。要是他們辦完事趕緊回去，我就放心了。總之，多謝你！

scripts.text: I don't have any responsibility. But the earth will be sad if any of the adventurers gets hurt here.
scripts.translation: 這不算我的責任，但要是有冒險者在這裡受傷，大地也會難過。

scripts.text: Will you help checking the safety of the adventurers today?
scripts.translation: 今天能幫我看看冒險者們是否平安嗎？

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm kind of tired today.
Thanks! Make sure all three of the adventurers are doing well!
scripts.translation: 謝謝！確認那三名冒險者都平安無事吧！

scripts.text: Hmm, it's unfortunate, but I guess it can't be helped. I'm worried though, especially for the one who was singing.
scripts.translation: 嗯，真遺憾，不過也沒辦法。我還是很擔心他們，尤其是那個唱歌的人。

scripts.text: Are the adventurers doing okay? Don't forget to check all three of them~
scripts.translation: 冒險者們都還好嗎？記得確認他們三個人的情況哦~

scripts.text: Thank goodness they're all okay. What a relief. But did they tell you when they'll be out?
scripts.translation: 謝天謝地，他們都沒事。真讓人放心。他們有沒有說什麼時候出來？

scripts.text: Hmm...I can't just ignore them though...
scripts.translation: 嗯...可我還是沒法對他們置之不理...

scripts.text: The adventurer on the third floor is starving!
scripts.translation: 三樓的冒險者快餓壞了！

scripts.text: Seriously...I can't believe it's an adventurer. Would you mind giving it some food if you have any?
scripts.translation: 真是的...居然會有冒險者餓成這樣。你有食物的話，能分給他一點嗎？

scripts.text: Let's see...this is all I've got. It's not much, but hopefully it'll help him.
scripts.translation: 我看看...手邊只有這些。雖然不多，希望能幫上忙。

scripts.text: I should start checking their safety regularly. Stop by again later, please.
scripts.translation: 我得定期確認他們是否平安。請過一陣子再來。

scripts.text: Do you see the tower here? I don't know when it was built or who built it, but I heard it's been here since forever.
scripts.translation: 看到這座塔了嗎？我不知道它何時建成、由誰建造，只聽說它一直都在這裡。

scripts.text: And we're trying to stop travelers going into the tower since there are monsters inside.
scripts.translation: 塔裡有魔物，所以我們一直在勸旅行者別進去。

scripts.text: But you know, travelers...they want to go even more if it's dangerous.
scripts.translation: 可你知道，旅行者越聽說危險，越想進去。

scripts.text: ^FF0000three adventurers^000000went into the tower recently. I'm not sure if they're still alive...
scripts.translation: 最近有三名冒險者進了塔。我不確定他們還活著沒有... ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I should have tried harder to stop them...Could you go check if they're safe and sound?
scripts.translation: 我早該更努力地攔住他們...你能去看看他們是否平安嗎？

scripts.text: I'll do it! I'm an adventurer, too!
Sorry, I can't do it right now.
Good. There are three adventurers in the tower right now.
scripts.translation: 好。塔裡現在有三名冒險者。

scripts.text: The first adventurer went inside just now. He's pretty young and I gave him a good scolding. You'll find him in just a few minutes.
scripts.translation: 第一名冒險者剛進去沒多久。他挺年輕，我還訓了他一頓。進去幾分鐘就能找到他。

scripts.text: The second adventurer seemed like an uptight lady. I wonder how she's doing.
scripts.translation: 第二名冒險者看起來是位嚴肅的女士。不知道她怎麼樣了。

scripts.text: The third adventurer is the problem here...I don't know what he's doing but he's been inside for about a month now.
scripts.translation: 第三名冒險者最讓人擔心...不知道他在裡面做什麼，已經待了一個月左右。

scripts.text: He said proudly that he'll be out in a second and took his instrument to make a song inside the tower. But I haven't heard from him since then. Please look for him.
scripts.translation: 他信誓旦旦地說馬上就出來，還帶著樂器進塔唱歌。可之後就再沒訊息了。請幫我找找他。

scripts.text: It's nothing urgent, but I'm worried about the adventurers.
scripts.translation: 雖然不是什麼急事，可我還是擔心那些冒險者。

scripts.text: Four Laphines are preparing to work today. Make sure you tell every one of them.
scripts.translation: 今天有四位拉菲尼族要開始工作，記得逐個通知他們。

scripts.text: They're all preparing somewhere in the field.
scripts.translation: 他們都在田野某處準備著。

scripts.text: Ahng!? I think they already started the work. The field is breathing again. There are many stories to this field, you know.
scripts.translation: 啊？！他們好像已經開始工作了。這片土地又恢復生機了。這片土地的故事可多著呢。

scripts.text: You'll be able to hear its story from somewhere if you love flower, trees, and Laphines.
scripts.translation: 如果你喜歡花草樹木和拉菲尼族，或許能在某處聽到這片土地的故事。

scripts.text: I think their work for the field is finished for the day. By the way, ^FF0000there's another work. Ask about it if you're interested.^000000
scripts.translation: 他們今天的田野工作應該結束了。對了，還有別的工作，感興趣的話可以問問。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Now that I see...you're a traveler, right? Sorry, I can't really notice anything unless I'm interested.
scripts.translation: 現在才注意到...你是旅行者吧？抱歉，除非是我感興趣的事，否則我很難注意到。

scripts.text: I'll introduce myself first. My name is Fili and I'm a Laphine. I do a variety of work in Eclage. You can tell from these muscles, ahng?
scripts.translation: 先自我介紹一下，我叫菲利，是拉菲尼族，在埃克拉珠做各種工作。看看我這身肌肉就知道了，昂？

scripts.text: What's up with that 'ahng' sound you make?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼總髮出“昂”的聲音？

scripts.text: It's just a habit, don't mind. Anyway, it's time to start the work for the day...you're a traveler, right? Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 只是習慣，別介意。總之，該開始今天的工作了...你是旅行者吧？能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: See what kind of work it is.
Ahng? It's simple. Tell Laphines that are scattered all over the field to start today's work.
scripts.translation: 昂？很簡單，告訴散佈在田野各處的拉菲尼族開始今天的工作。

scripts.text: Laphines love this field, and in their own ways, they're sharing their energy with trees, grasses, winds, and the earth.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族熱愛這片田野，會用自己的方式把能量分享給樹木、草地、風和大地。

scripts.text: We're not sure how much it actually helps. They're mysterious creatures, you know.
scripts.translation: 我們也不知道這到底有多大作用。它們可是神秘的生物。

scripts.text: But we want to try anything that might help.
scripts.translation: 但只要可能有幫助，我們都願意一試。

scripts.text: It's something that I've been doing by myself usually. But now that my shoulder is injured, I can't really leave this place anymore. Help me, please.
scripts.translation: 平時這些事都是我一個人做。可我傷了肩膀，沒法再離開這裡了。拜託你幫幫我。

scripts.text: Ahng? Well, too bad. But if you have time later, please drop by. I could use a little help here.
scripts.translation: 昂？真遺憾。之後有空的話再來吧，我正好需要人幫忙。

scripts.text: Look at this beautiful field filled with little blades of grass and twigs breathing!
scripts.translation: 看看這片美麗的田野，小草和細枝都在呼吸呢！

scripts.text: But for some reason, I feel like I can't hear them breathing anymore. So, little Laphines water and sing to cheer them up.
scripts.translation: 可不知為何，我好像聽不見它們呼吸了。所以小拉菲尼族會澆水、唱歌，讓大地打起精神。

scripts.text: I think it's time for Laphines to start today's work.
scripts.translation: 我想該讓拉菲尼族們開始今天的工作了。

scripts.text: Take a look at this beautiful field. It feels like you can hear each twig and blade of grass singing, right?
scripts.translation: 看看這片美麗的田野。彷彿能聽見每根細枝、每株小草都在歌唱，對吧？

scripts.text: Can you...hear the voice of the earth? It sounds very sad right now.
scripts.translation: 你...聽得到大地的聲音嗎？它現在聽起來很悲傷。

scripts.text: Whew, did I sing too much? I'm so thirsty. A glass of rice wine sounds great, hah~
scripts.translation: 呼，唱太久了嗎？好渴啊。真想喝一杯米酒，哈~

scripts.text: Did the great Fili send you? Man, he's got skills for sure! I shall start singing then!?
scripts.translation: 是偉大的菲利派你來的？他可真有辦法！那我開唱了！？

scripts.text: I suppose you came to tell me to start working? Don't worry, my voice will touch the earth~
scripts.translation: 你是來叫我開工的吧？放心，我的歌聲會打動大地~

scripts.text: As soon as the Laphine started singing, it began to warm my heart.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族一開口歌唱，我的心也暖了起來。

scripts.text: I'm singing for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation: 我在為花朵和大地歌唱。

scripts.text: I think it's time to start singing...
It feels great to sing for the earth.
I think the earth is running dry.
I think this is enough for the day. I have to take a break and draw water, too. Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 今天澆到這裡就夠了。我也得休息一下，去打點水。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: I'll water these dying flowers and grasses again. This brings them back to life! Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 再給這些快枯萎的花草澆澆水，它們就能恢復生機！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: I'm watering here and there. You look so tired! Should I water you, too?
scripts.translation: 我正在到處澆水呢。你看起來很累，要不要也給你澆一點？

scripts.text: I'm sure Eclage needs a Laphine like me! Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠肯定需要我這樣的拉菲尼族！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: Oh, they started working? I'll start watering the earth then. I mean, sometimes we Laphines can be practical, too!
scripts.translation: 哦，他們開工了？那我也來給大地澆水吧。我們拉菲尼族有時也很務實呢！

scripts.text: Do you hear the sound of grasses and flowers coming alive again? It's all because I watered them diligently! Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 你聽到花草重新煥發生機的聲音了嗎？這可都是我勤快澆水的功勞！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: Hehe~! Now that I'm done watering, I should wait for the great Fili.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿~水澆完了，該等偉大的菲利來了。

scripts.text: It's my job to water the earth.
scripts.translation: 給大地澆水就是我的工作。

scripts.text: It's important to warm up like this before you start dancing. One, two, three, four....
scripts.translation: 跳舞前這樣熱身很重要。一、二、三、四...

scripts.text: I would love to see the great Fili next time...
scripts.translation: 下次真想讓偉大的菲利看看...

scripts.text: Ah, it's you again! You're so insensitive. Anyway, you're here to tell me to start working, right? I see, I see. You can go now.
scripts.translation: 啊，又是你！真不解風情。你是來叫我開工的吧？知道了，知道了。你可以走了。

scripts.text: I can't dance well when adventurers like you are watching! Don't worry and just go~ I won't slack off on the job, okay?
scripts.translation: 有冒險者看著，我跳不好！放心走吧~我不會偷懶的，好嗎？

scripts.text: I do Hip Hop dancing moves whenever I feel sad. Huh? Oh, it's a dance style. It's very elegant and it makes your heart ache.
scripts.translation: 我難過時就跳嘻哈舞。嗯？那是一種

scripts.text: You mean the great Fili said to start the work? But why would he ask you to tell us?
scripts.translation: 偉大的菲利讓我們開工了？他為什麼不自己來告訴我們？

scripts.text: I could've showed Fili my new moves!
scripts.translation: 我本可以向菲利展示我的新舞步的！

scripts.text: Oh well, I'll just do the moves I was doing earlier today. You know, Fili should be the first one to see my new moves, so...
scripts.translation: 算了，我就跳今天早些時候跳的那些舞步吧。畢竟，菲利應該是第一個看到我的新舞步的人，所以...

scripts.text: So, how does dancing help the earth exactly...?
scripts.translation: 跳舞到底是怎麼幫助大地的...？

scripts.text: Look at you, a cold-hearted adventurer! All the Laphines living in this area can feel it. We hear the sounds of the earth and creatures.
scripts.translation: 你可真是個冷酷的冒險者！住在這裡的拉菲尼族都能感受到，我們聽得到大地和生靈的聲音。

scripts.text: You'll see as you continue your adventure. Anyway, I'll start working now.
scripts.translation: 繼續冒險下去你就會明白了。總之，我要開工了。

scripts.text: I would really love to see the great Fili next time.
scripts.translation: 我真希望能再次見到偉大的菲利。

scripts.text: I do Hip Hop dancing moves whenever I feel sad. Huh? Oh, it's a dance style. It's very elegant and it makes your heart ache.
scripts.translation: 舞蹈，很優雅，看了會讓人心疼。

scripts.text: When the grasses sway in the wind, doesn't it look like they're actually dancing?
scripts.translation: 當草兒在風中搖曳時，看起來是不是就像在跳舞一樣？

scripts.text: Is this the first time that you're seeing a blooming field? It's so beautiful, just like me.
scripts.translation: 你第一次看到鮮花盛開的田野嗎？真美，就像我一樣。

scripts.text: It takes a cute person like me to bring joy to the earth...Too bad that you'll never be able to do so!
scripts.translation: 只有我這麼可愛的人，才能讓大地開心...可惜你永遠做不到！

scripts.text: You're new, right? Tell him I'll start the work.
scripts.translation: 你是新來的吧？告訴他我這就開工。

scripts.text: You might think smiling to the earth always is nothing, but it's not that easy actually. I mean, it's hard to be cute like me in the first place~
scripts.translation: 你可能覺得一直對大地微笑很容易，其實沒那

scripts.text: I hope someday the flowers, trees, grasses, and little creatures on this earth will smile with joy.
scripts.translation: 希望有一天，地上的花朵、樹木、小草和小生靈都能開心地笑。

scripts.text: You mean you were asked a favor from the great Fili? Are you a new worker then?
scripts.translation: 你接受了偉大的菲利委託？那你是新來的幫手嗎？

scripts.text: Don't be shy. I started working just recently, too. But since I was here first, I'm your boss, okay?!
scripts.translation: 別害羞嘛，我也是最近才開始工作的。不過我比你先來，所以我是你的老闆，懂嗎？！

scripts.text: We all love the earth, but we express it in different ways. Like, thorugh dancing or singing.
scripts.translation: 我們都熱愛大地，只是表達方式不同，比如跳舞或唱歌。

scripts.text: Looks like...you're not really good at anything!
scripts.translation: 看起來...你似乎沒什麼特長嘛！

scripts.text: Well, what do you do then?
Oh come on~You're insensitive, too? Look at me, so cute and nice!
scripts.translation: 哎呀~你也太遲鈍了吧？看看我，多可愛、多親切！

scripts.text: My job is to share my smile with the earth. If I smile like this, I'm sure the earth will feel so much better!
scripts.translation: 我的工作就是把笑容分享給大地。我這樣笑，大地一定會舒服多了！

scripts.text: Anyway, you should find some work for the earth as well. Tell Fili that I'll start working.
scripts.translation: 總之，你也該為大地做點事。告訴菲利我開始工作了。

scripts.text: As soon as he finished talking, he put on a bright smile.
scripts.translation: 他說完便露出了燦爛的笑容。

scripts.text: You might think smiling to the earth always is nothing, but it's not that easy actually. I mean, it's hard to be cute like me in the first place~
scripts.translation: 麼簡單。首先，要像我這麼可愛就很難啦~

scripts.text: Don't you always smile when you remember good memories of the past?
scripts.translation: 想起美好的回憶時，你不也會笑嗎？

scripts.text: I need to get a scoop. Something that will catch the eyes of adventurers!
scripts.translation: 我得挖到獨家新聞，找到能吸引冒險者目光的大訊息！

scripts.text: Anyway, this isn't an ordinary place. This place, it's filled with newsworthy stories!
scripts.translation: 總之，這裡可不是普通的地方，而是新聞不斷的好地方！

scripts.text: It's you again! Oh, is it because I'm a woman? Let me make it clear here. I'm going nowhere until I get a news item.
scripts.translation: 又是你！哦，因為我是女人，你就覺得我不行嗎？我說清楚，在挖到新聞之前我哪兒也不去。

scripts.text: Oh my gosh! You scared me! What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 天哪！你嚇到我了！你在這兒幹什麼？

scripts.text: I see...I didn't know they're worried about me. But I can't go back now. I'm a journalist.
scripts.translation: 原來如此...我不知道大家這麼擔心我。可我現在不能回去，我是記者。

scripts.text: I write news articles for adventurers for a magazaine called Monthly Brigan.
scripts.translation: 我在一本叫《月刊佈里根》的雜誌上為冒險者撰寫新聞。

scripts.text: I had a hard time coming here, and I feel like I'll get an exclusive scoop here any minute! But it's just not happening yet...
scripts.translation: 我費了好大勁才來到這裡，總覺得隨時就能挖到獨家新聞！可現在還沒動靜...

scripts.text: Anyway, I'm doing well. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation: 總之，我過得很好。告訴他別擔心。

scripts.text: This tower is very quiet yet mysterious. It's definitely something that adventurers would love, right?
scripts.translation: 這座塔既安靜又神秘，冒險者肯定喜歡這種地方，對吧？

scripts.text: Gosh, you're just bugging me. Don't worry, I can take care of myself just fine!
scripts.translation: 真是的，別煩我了。我能照顧好自己！

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'll get the biggest scoop of the year!
scripts.translation: 放心，我一定會挖到年度最大新聞！

scripts.text: I'm exploring every inch of the tower. I'll write about it in my memoirs later.
scripts.translation: 我正在探索這座塔的每個角落，以後要把經歷寫進回憶錄。

scripts.text: Don't take me lightly just because I'm young. I've already been to every part of Midgard continent. I'm a real adventurer, you know.
scripts.translation: 別看我年輕就小瞧我。我已經走遍米德加爾特大陸每個角落了，是真正的冒險者！

scripts.text: You really shouldn't worry about me. I'll go out when I'm done exploring...Tell him I'm doing okay.
scripts.translation: 真的不用擔心我。探索完我就會出去...告訴他我一切都好。

scripts.text: I shall leave to explore different parts now.
scripts.translation: 我現在要去探索別的地方了。

scripts.text: Are you an adventurer, too? Don't you dare cut in here. I was here first.
scripts.translation: 你也是冒險者？別插隊，是我先來的。

scripts.text: What do you mean? I didn't cut in!
scripts.translation: 你什麼意思？我沒有插隊！

scripts.text: Well, I was exploring here first. So you should come back later. I'll be a great adventurer!
scripts.translation: 明明是我先在這裡探索的，你晚點再來吧。我會成為偉大的冒險者！

scripts.text: Hah, that Laphine must be very idle, worrying about an adventurer. He shouldn't worry about a guy who's going to be the king of adventurers!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，那個拉菲尼族可真閒，居然擔心一個冒險者。我可是要成為冒險者之王的人，沒什麼好擔心的！

scripts.text: I'll leave my footprints in every part of the world, find all kinds of treasures and hide them somewhere. Every adventurer will try to follow my path then!
scripts.translation: 我要走遍世界每個角落，找到各種寶藏再藏起來。到時候每個冒險者都會追隨我的足跡！

scripts.text: If you get an autograph from me now, you might be able to feed three generations of your family in the future. How does it sound, you want one?
scripts.translation: 現在拿到我的簽名，將來能養活你們家三代人。怎麼樣，要不要？

scripts.text: You certainly are a poor judge of character! Anyway, tell him not to worry about me. I'll be the king of adventurers! I shall go explore more then.
scripts.translation: 你真不會看人！總之告訴他別擔心，我會成為冒險者之王！我繼續探索去了。

scripts.text: You want my autograph? If not, please don't interrupt.
scripts.translation: 你想要簽名嗎？不然就別打擾我。

scripts.text: Don't worry about me. I'll be a great adventurer!
Don't worry about me. I'll be a great adventurer!
This tower is mysterious. It's an interesting place.
This tower is mysterious. It's an interesting place.
No need to worry about me! ^FF0000I'll definitely go home this time!^000000 Thanks for everything! I'll take you out for a nice meal next time!
scripts.translation: 不用擔心我！這次我一定會回家的！謝謝你幫忙！下次我請你吃頓好的！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Ah...What a relief...I'm so glad you're here. I was about to leave this tower alone! But I think I'm lost.
scripts.translation: 啊...總算鬆了口氣...幸好你來了。我本來想獨自離開這座塔，結果好像迷路了。

scripts.text: I'm hungry again from walking around so much...I'm so hungry that I can't walk anymore.
scripts.translation: 走了這麼多路，我又餓了...餓得連路都走不動。

scripts.text: Did I walk too much? I'm covered with dust again. It keeps covering my eyes.
scripts.translation: 我是不是走太多了？身上又沾滿灰塵，眼睛都快睜不開了。

scripts.text: Whew, I guess I was walking around really hard...somehow, I lost all the souvenirs they collected for me...
scripts.translation: 呼，我剛才一定走得太急了...不知怎麼的，大家給我的紀念品全丟了...

scripts.text: Good to see you again, my friend!
I'm here to see if you're still alive.
It's from that muscular Laphine, right? He's a good guy. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation: 是那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族送來的吧？他人很好。告訴他不用擔心我。

scripts.text: I guess I'll have no problem finding my way out of this tower now. I'm full...and I just need to get a few more souvenirs...
scripts.translation: 現在我應該能找到出口了。我吃飽了...再收集幾個紀念品就好...

scripts.text: I'll be fine if only I could get rid of those in my way, haha...We're almost out, right?
scripts.translation: 只要把擋路的傢伙弄走就行，哈哈...我們快出去了吧？

scripts.text: I'm starving to death though... Could you please help me, my friend?
scripts.translation: 不過我快餓死了...朋友，能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text: I really liked the meat you brought. Except that it wasn't really well seasoned and the texture was a little crumbly...but...it was still eatable, haha...
scripts.translation: 我很喜歡你帶來的肉。雖然調味不足，口感也有點散...不過還是能吃，哈哈...

scripts.text: Ah, how long has it been since the last time I saw food! Yummm! Thank goodness it's meat! I think it's a little tough...and not warm enough...but still, it's meat!!
scripts.translation: 啊，我多久沒吃東西了！真好吃！謝天謝地是肉！雖然有點硬，也不夠熱...但這可是肉啊！！

scripts.text: Thank you so much!! Yum yum. You're such a good friend! Munch munch.
scripts.translation: 太感謝了！！好吃好吃。你真是我的好朋友！嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: I should get a hustle on and find a way out now! I feel like I can get out of here this time!
scripts.translation: 我得趕緊找出口！這次感覺一定能出去！

scripts.text: Food...I need food...It seems as if the sky is falling...
scripts.translation: 食物...我需要食物...感覺天都要塌下來了...

scripts.text: Seeing his eyes and hearing him coughing constantly, I can tell he needs something to eat, like meat.
scripts.translation: 看他眼神渙散，又咳個不停，應該是餓了，得給他吃點肉。

scripts.text: As you can see...I couldn't find a way out of this tower again. And I'm so hungry that I feel like I might pass out...
scripts.translation: 你看...我又找不到離開這座塔的路了。我餓得快暈過去了...

scripts.text: Ah...I'm so glad that I met a good friend like you.
scripts.translation: 啊...能遇見你這樣的好朋友真好。

scripts.text: I thought I was so close to getting out of this tower. But when I looked around, I was at the same place again.
scripts.translation: 我以為快走出塔了，結果一看，又回到了原地。

scripts.text: Maybe this tower is under a curse.
scripts.translation: 這座塔說不定被詛咒了。

scripts.text: Or maybe it's just that you have a poor sense of direction?
...I wouldn't really deny that. But anyway, could you get me something to eat? I'm starving...
scripts.translation: ...我也不否認。總之，能給我點吃的嗎？我快餓死了...

scripts.text: Alright! I'll be back in a second!
Thanks. I prefer meat, if possible...I really liked what you gave me last time, and I think acorns go well with meat. Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 謝啦。能給肉最好...上次你帶來的東西真不錯，我覺得橡果配肉也很合適。哈哈。

scripts.text: Why don't you just eat whatever I get you!
scripts.translation: 你就吃我帶來的東西吧！

scripts.text: As long as I'm getting something to eat, I was just hoping for a good one. I'm sorry, but do me a favor please. I couldn't forget the taste of the meat.
scripts.translation: 有吃的就行，我只是想吃點好東西。不好意思，再幫我一次吧，我忘不了那肉的味道。

scripts.text: Okay...I see. I'll try to find another way then. If you meet that muscular Laphine on your way out, tell him I won't be able to see him again...
scripts.translation: 好吧...那我再想別的辦法。你出去時要是遇到那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族，告訴他我可能再也見不到他了...

scripts.text: Ahaha, no need to worry about me! I can do this by myself!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，不用擔心我！我自己能搞定！

scripts.text: Hey, you really are a good adventurer! I'm actually starting to like you even more.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你真是個好冒險者！我越來越喜歡你了。

scripts.text: I'll take care of the rest. I can't just keep bothering you, right? Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 剩下的我自己來，不好一直麻煩你，對吧？哈哈。

scripts.text: These guys are not really visible and they're so annoying. Ah...I asked you to clean up, but it's not because I'm lazy or anything. Hahaha...
scripts.translation: 這些傢伙不太顯眼，卻煩人得很。啊，我讓你來清理可不是因為我懶，哈哈...

scripts.text: Eek! I was going to get out on my own while you were gone. But then I found something interesting...so I guess I was wandering around a little...
scripts.translation: 哎呀！趁你不在時我本想自己出去，可後來發現了有趣的東西...就到處逛了逛...

scripts.text: And then these guys piled up again!
scripts.translation: 然後這些傢伙又堆起來了！

scripts.text: Of course I can do it on my own~ But if I do it alone, then I'll end up using too much of my energy, and then I'll get hungry again...
scripts.translation: 我當然能自己來~可那樣太耗體力，之後我又會餓...

scripts.text: So you want me to help you brushing off the dust?
scripts.translation: 所以你想讓我幫你拍掉灰塵？

scripts.text: How did you know? I think we're really clicking! If I have a chance, I'll let you join my guild later.
scripts.translation: 你怎麼知道？我們真有默契！以後有機會，我讓你加入我的公會。

scripts.text: Fight off some Cherenes then. You don't have to eliminate that many because I'll start fighting soon, too! Haha.
scripts.translation: 去打倒幾隻切雷涅斯吧，不用打太多，我很快也會加入戰鬥！哈哈。

scripts.text: I see. Just don't feel too guilty if you find me dead next time you're here. It's not your fault.
scripts.translation: 我知道了。下次你要是發現我死在這裡，也別太自責，不是你的錯。

scripts.text: I think I have enough souvenirs! They'll be surprised to see these souvenirs with lots of memories!
scripts.translation: 紀念品應該夠了！朋友們看到這些充滿回憶的東西，一定會很驚喜！

scripts.text: Thanks! Man, you're awesome! What a desirable and talented individual you are!
scripts.translation: 謝謝！你太棒了！真是個迷人又有才華的人！

scripts.text: I hope to see you again in Midgard! We should team up and begin a great adventure together!
scripts.translation: 希望能在米德加爾特再見！到時我們組隊，一起展開偉大冒險！

scripts.text: I'll make sure to give my friends all the souvenirs you collected for me, and I'll tell them about you, too!
scripts.translation: 我會把你收集的紀念品送給朋友，也會告訴他們你的事！

scripts.text: I don't need that many. Maybe one for each of them?
scripts.translation: 我不用拿那麼多，每人一份就夠了吧？

scripts.text: Oh, come to think of it, I lost the bookmarks you collected for me...I mean the ones made of fallen leaves...I should collect them again...
scripts.translation: 對了，我把你收集的落葉書籤弄丟了...得重新收集才行...

scripts.text: Would you mind helping me with that? What are friends for! Hahaha! Thanks!!
scripts.translation: 願意幫我嗎？朋友就是互相幫忙的嘛！哈哈，謝謝！

scripts.text: When I came to myself, I realized that everything you brought me was gone! I thought I put it right here!
scripts.translation: 回過神來才發現你帶來的東西全不見了！我明明放在這裡的！

scripts.text: I'm really really sorry, but could you help me again? Just the thought of seeing my friends makes me cry like this. Please~?
scripts.translation: 真不好意思，又要麻煩你了。一想到要見朋友，我就忍不住哭成這樣。拜託啦~？

scripts.text: What a poor guy! I'll help him.
Bookmarks made of fallen leaves...Ah, they bring so many memories back and make my eyes teary. I'm sure my friends will love it!
scripts.translation: 落葉做的書籤...啊，勾起好多回憶，我都快掉眼淚了。朋友們一定會喜歡！

scripts.text: I see...It's my fault. I'll probably end my life here, collecting souvenirs...but it's none of your business...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...是我的錯。看來我只能在這裡收集紀念品，直到死去...不過與你無關...

scripts.text: You're done collecting the bookmarks!? Full of reminiscences as expected. Everyone would love it!
scripts.translation: 書籤都收集齊了嗎！？果然滿載著回憶，大家一定會喜歡！

scripts.text: I just finished writing a song. Do you want to listen?
scripts.translation: 我剛寫完一首歌，想聽聽嗎？

scripts.text: ^D96E26On that path again~I was wandering for a while~^000000
scripts.translation: 又走上那條路~我徘徊了好久~ ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: ^D96E26Familiar dungeon~full of monsters~and hunger in a maze~^000000
scripts.translation: 熟悉的迷宮~滿是魔物~還有揮之不去的飢餓~ ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: ^D96E26when I was trying to run away~thankfully no monster was there~^000000
scripts.translation: 我正想逃走~幸好那裡沒有魔物~ ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: ^D96E26but I couldn't make it~that far~I was faint with hunger.^000000
scripts.translation: 可我沒能走遠~餓得快要暈倒了。 ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: So far so good, right? If you think it's similar to another song, it's just your imagination!
scripts.translation: 目前聽起來還不錯吧？你要覺得像別的歌，那一定是錯覺！

scripts.text: I think I've heard this before.
Thanks! If I have a chance, I'll make a song about how you helped me, too!
scripts.translation: 謝謝！有機會我也會寫首歌，講講你怎麼幫我的！

scripts.text: Ahaha...really? You might be right...? Oh well, I'll make another one, don't worry...
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈...真的嗎？也許你說得對...算了，我會再寫一首，別擔心...

scripts.text: I should really get going now. I've been to most parts of the tower and I'm pretty full, too.
scripts.translation: 我真該走了。塔裡大部分地方都逛過了，也吃飽了。

scripts.text: Thanks again, my friend! I hope to see you again somewhere. I can find a way out on my own.
scripts.translation: 再謝你一次，朋友！希望以後還能再見。我能自己找到出口。

scripts.text: Don't worry. I'm pretty much done writing a song. I'm almost done with the lyrics as well as the melody.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我的歌快寫完了，歌詞和旋律都差不多了。

scripts.text: ^FF0000By the time you're done collecting souvenirs,^000000 I'll probably be done. Thanks again, my friend.
scripts.translation: 等你收集完紀念品，我應該也差不多好了。謝啦，朋友。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I've been thinking about it...and I think they would love ^FF0000bookmarks made of fallen leaves!^000000 It's full of reminiscences of the past! I'm sure!
scripts.translation: 我想了想...大家一定會喜歡用落葉做的書籤！那滿載著過去的回憶！我敢肯定！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: If you look at the books scattered all over the tower, there are bookmarks inside. I think it'll be a great gift for my friends even though it has someone else's memories.
scripts.translation: 塔裡散落的書中夾著書籤。雖然上面留著別人的回憶，但我覺得送給朋友會是很棒的禮物。

scripts.text: ^FF0000A good melody^000000 just came across my mind, and I think I should start writing a song now. You should collect souvenirs for me in the meantime.
scripts.translation: 我剛想到一段好旋律，得馬上寫首歌。你先幫我收集紀念品吧。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Good job! Now, let's enjoy the rest of...No! I mean, let's find a way out!
scripts.translation: 幹得好！現在來享受剩下的...不！我是說，快找條出路！

scripts.text: ...but then, I feel like something's missing. I should bring some souvenirs since I'll probably never come here again, right?
scripts.translation: ...不過總覺得還缺點什麼。既然可能再也不來這裡，不如帶點紀念品回去？

scripts.text: Actually...I feel like my friends would just get mad at me if I go back empty-handed.
scripts.translation: 其實...要是空手回去，朋友們肯定會生我的氣。

scripts.text: I should bring some souvenirs to make them feel better. Is there anything I could use?
scripts.translation: 我該帶點紀念品讓他們開心。有什麼合適的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Jellopies are good collectables...but I think it's a little too common. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation: 傑勒比結晶確實適合收藏...不過太常見了。還有別的嗎？

scripts.text: Hey... but it's not something we can get around here.
Hmm? What's that for? I guess new items came out while I was travelling.
scripts.translation: 嗯？那是什麼？我旅行期間出新道具了嗎？

scripts.text: I can't get them unless I know what they are. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation: 我都不知道那是什麼，怎麼收集？還有別的嗎？

scripts.text: Card Album... I can't give my friends something that might be come up with nothing! Anything else?
scripts.translation: 卡冊啊...萬一什麼都開不出來，我可沒法送給朋友。還有別的嗎？

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters...hmm, that sounds interesting!
scripts.translation: 當地魔物的戰利品...嗯，聽起來不錯！

scripts.text: I'm sure they haven't made it here yet. So it's something new for them, too! Right?
scripts.translation: 他們肯定還沒見過這些，對他們來說也是新鮮玩意！對吧？

scripts.text: And it tells them where I've been to so far.
scripts.translation: 而且還能讓他們知道我去過哪些地方。

scripts.text: That's a good idea. Let's think about what to collect then.
scripts.translation: 好主意。那我們想想收集什麼吧。

scripts.text: Are you done yet? Well, I'm still working on the lyrics, too...but you have to hurry up. It's time to get out of here.
scripts.translation: 你弄好了嗎？我還在寫歌詞...不過你得快點，我們該離開了。

scripts.text: Of course I'm lost because I have a poor sense of direction...but there's another reason to it, too!
scripts.translation: 我迷路是因為方向感差...不過還有另一個原因！

scripts.text: You see those guys over there? I think they're stopping me from finding a way out for some reason.
scripts.translation: 看到那邊那些傢伙了嗎？我覺得它們在故意攔著我，不讓我找出口。

scripts.text: No, you have to see them carefully. Those Dustballs over there are covering my eyes, and when I can't see clearly, I get sleepy and hungry...
scripts.translation: 不，你仔細看。那些塵埃球擋住了我的視線，看不清就會犯困、肚子餓...

scripts.text: I think it's just your imagination!
No, no. I'm sure they're stopping me. Get rid of them, please. Maybe just a couple of them? I have some lyrics coming into my mind just now...so I should write them down...
scripts.translation: 不，我確定它們在搗亂。拜託把它們趕走，幾隻就好。我剛想到幾句歌詞，得趕緊記下來...

scripts.text: Yey it's meat! I loooove meat!
scripts.translation: 耶，是肉！我最最最愛肉了！

scripts.text: Yum yum. Munch munch. Yum yum!
scripts.translation: 好吃好吃，嚼嚼嚼，好吃好吃！

scripts.text: Munch munch. Yum yum yum. Munch munch
scripts.translation: 嚼嚼嚼，好吃好吃，嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: Man, it's so good! This is it! Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 哇，真好吃！就是這個味道！好吃好吃。

scripts.text: If I find a way out, I should make a song for that muscular Laphine. Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 找到出口後，我要給那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族寫首歌。好吃好吃。

scripts.text: I'm not...sure when that would be though...munch munch.
scripts.translation: 不過...不知道要等到什麼時候...嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: Oh, it's nothing. Don't worry. I came into this tower by accident and I got lost. Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，別擔心。我是不小心進了這座塔，結果迷路了。好吃好吃。

scripts.text: To tell you the truth, I got lost somewhere about 2 years ago and I traveled around to wherever. Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 說實話，我大概兩年前就迷路了，只能到處流浪。好吃好吃。

scripts.text: and then I found this tower and came inside because I thought it'd be fun. But I haven't found a way out since then.
scripts.translation: 後來發現這座塔，覺得有趣就進來了，可從那以後一直沒找到出口。

scripts.text: I feel so much better now. Thanks, my friend! This must be a destiny! Would you help me?
scripts.translation: 我感覺好多了，謝謝你，朋友！這一定是命運！你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Ah...I guess this is the fear of death...memories of the past are going through my mind like a flash...like happy moments we had at the south gate of Prontera...
scripts.translation: 啊...這就是死亡的恐懼嗎...過去的回憶像走馬燈一樣閃過...比如我們在普隆德拉南門度過的快樂時光...

scripts.text: I guess this is it for me...I had such a good life...
scripts.translation: 看來我就要死在這裡了...這一生過得真不錯...

scripts.text: It's kind of sad that I'm actually starving to death...but I had a good time, my beloved guild members...
scripts.translation: 我快餓死了，真有點難過...不過我過得很開心，我親愛的公會成員們...

scripts.text: I brought some meat from Fili!
scripts.translation: 我從菲利那裡帶了些肉！

scripts.text: Oh, I loooove meat! But...is there any vegetable?
scripts.translation: 哦，我超愛肉！不過...有蔬菜嗎？

scripts.text: Like...garnishes for meat, you know. I could get tired of eating just meat...Could you get me some?
scripts.translation: 就是肉的配菜嘛。我怕光吃肉會膩...能幫我找點嗎？

scripts.text: I mean something like acorns! I saw a pile of acorns just outside the tower.
scripts.translation: 像橡果那樣的東西！我在塔外看到一堆橡果。

scripts.text: I'm here to see if you're doing okay.
I don't know if I should say I'm okay...or not...
scripts.translation: 我也不知道自己算不算好...

scripts.text: I haven't eaten anything for days...I feel like I'm going to pass out any minute.
scripts.translation: 我好幾天沒吃東西了...感覺隨時都會暈倒。

scripts.text: But for now, I'm ^FF0000still^000000 alive...but no one knows until when...ah, I'm getting sleepy again...
scripts.translation: 不過我還活著...誰知道還能撐多久...啊，我又困了... ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: You know that Laphine outside...yes, that muscular Laphine...tell him to bring me some food before I die.
scripts.translation: 你知道外面那個肌肉發達的拉菲尼族吧？讓他在我死前給我帶點吃的。

scripts.text: It doesn't have to be delicious...just give me any food...I feel so weak that I can't even walk.
scripts.translation: 不用好吃的...隨便給我點吃的就行...我虛弱得走不動了。

scripts.text: Ah, I felt so dizzy that my head was spinning before, and now I can't see anything at all! Is it night or day? I'm so hungry...
scripts.translation: 剛才我頭暈得天旋地轉，現在什麼也看不見了！這是白天還是晚上？我好餓...

scripts.text: A glass of red potion for breakfast~another glass of red potion for lunch~you're already addicted~ Ah, I'm too hungry to sing...
scripts.translation: 早餐一杯紅色藥水~午餐再來一杯紅色藥水~你已經上癮啦~啊，我餓得唱不動了...

scripts.text: You are not wearing the correct equipment
scripts.translation: 你沒有穿戴正確的裝備
蘑菇的當前狀態為-，九的當 {0}
新奧茲要設定哪個物品？
新奧茲你是來確認影像的嗎？

scripts.text: What you see right now is a regular expression.
You want a little more smile?
scripts.translation: 茲想笑得更開心一點嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me all that you want!
- You have too many items to proceed with the conversation
scripts.translation: - 您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續對話

scripts.text: How did you get up here?
Are you a monster that I created?
scripts.translation: 難道你是我創造的魔物？

scripts.text: I have a job for you, so strengthen yourself to the level of an incubus and then return to me!
scripts.translation: 我有事交給你。先把自己練到魅魔的程度再回來！

scripts.text: Busy, busy, busy! Monsters, I have to create more monsters!
scripts.translation: 忙死了！我得創造更多魔物！危險！不知

scripts.text: Danger! I don't know when attack will come!
scripts.translation: 道敵人什麼時候會來！它來了

scripts.text: How did you get up here? I kept many monsters around the tower!
scripts.translation: ！你怎麼上來的？我在塔周圍放了那麼多

scripts.text: There's no way anyone could have invaded it! That means, you... you are!
scripts.translation: 魔物！沒人能闖進來才對！難道你...你是！

scripts.text: Are you a monster that I created?
I want to know about the tower.

scripts.translation: 這是一隻會說話的蟲子！

scripts.text: Why am I in a tower?
It's been so long that I forgot everything!
scripts.translation: 塔裡？過了太久，什麼都忘了！

scripts.text: Just because I made you without much effort are your eyes just that much deficient?!
scripts.translation: 你這魔物！就因為我隨手把你造出來，你就覺得我的眼光這麼差嗎？！

scripts.text: Professor Worm probes his own face and becomes shocked. He sees his own face through the silver plate and is really shocked.
scripts.translation: 沃姆教授摸摸自己的臉，驚訝不已。他從銀盤裡看到自己的倒影，更是大吃一驚。

scripts.text: When did my handsome face become like this? My name is...
scripts.translation: 我英俊的臉怎麼變成這樣了？我叫...

scripts.text: My goodness, I even forgot the name!
Don't just stand there please go and find my portrait!
scripts.translation: 了！別愣著，快去找我的畫像！

scripts.text: You came all the way up here in your free time and you are telling me you're busy?!
scripts.translation: 你利用空閒時間特意跑到這裡來，卻告訴我你很忙？！

scripts.text: Well, you have to be curious.
While my memory got worse my intuition improved so much!
scripts.translation: 的記憶雖然越來越差，直覺倒是敏

scripts.text: If you want to hear what you want to hear help me get my memory back!
scripts.translation: 銳多了！想知道答案就幫我恢復記憶！

scripts.text: Among the many books on the shelves in this room my portrait is bookmarked inside somewhere. Please find it!
scripts.translation: 在這個房間書架上的許多書中，我的

scripts.text: I definitely knew it even until a few hundred years back but I forgot it clearly now.
scripts.translation: 題。直到幾百年前我還記得，但現在我完全想不起來了。

scripts.text: I can't do anything but what I do best now.
scripts.translation: 我現在只能做我最擅長的事。

scripts.text: Creating monsters and letting them loose.
scripts.translation: 製造魔物，然後放它們出去。

scripts.text: I might also be sleeping a lot later..
It's going to be my turn next!
No, no! I can't just be the one to take it.
scripts.translation: 了！不行，我不能坐以待斃。

scripts.text: Monsters, I have to let more monsters loose!
scripts.translation: 魔物！我得再放出更多魔物！

scripts.text: Among the many books on the shelves in this room my portrait is bookmarked inside somewhere. Please find it!
scripts.translation: 畫像被夾在某處作為書籤。請找到它！

scripts.text: This is how I used to look?
But how did I become like this?
The weather, the landscape at the time...
scripts.translation: 當時的天氣、那裡的景色...

scripts.text: I... yeah, it was a land with many blooming flowers where I was collecting something... That's right!
scripts.translation: 我...對了，那是個繁花盛開的地方，我在那裡採集東西...沒錯！我在採

scripts.text: I was collecting some ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000!
Hey monster, if you go to the land of many blooming flowers and bring me some ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000,
scripts.translation: 那個...嘿，魔物，去繁花盛開的地方幫我找些星星香菇 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I might remember everything you see!
Please just try to remember things now.
scripts.translation: 現在就試著回想一下吧

scripts.text: I'll bring them back for you.
Well, I even forgot my name and I can't remember anything right now!
scripts.translation: 我連自己的名字都忘了，現在怎麼可能想起來！

scripts.text: From the land of blooming flowers bring me 20 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation: 去繁花盛開的地方給我帶20個星星香菇 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I think monster 'Petal' would usually roam with them in their mouths.
scripts.translation: 。花瓣怪蟲嘴裡通常叼著這種蘑

scripts.text: You couldn't expect me to remember things with just a few mushrooms!
scripts.translation: 菇。就帶幾個回來，你還指望我想起多少事？

scripts.text: I was trying to do something at the time with 20 mushrooms. If you don't bring me enough,
scripts.translation: 00不夠！我當時正用20個蘑菇做實驗。你要是不帶

scripts.text: I may not be able to remember enough either!
scripts.translation: 夠，我也沒法回憶起多少！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 should be easily found through finding Petals roaming the land of blooming flowers.
scripts.translation: 去繁花盛開的地方找花瓣怪蟲，應該很容易弄到星星香菇。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Yes, yes, it feels like my memory is about to burst back!
scripts.translation: 00000。對，對，我的記憶好像快回來了！

scripts.text: I was using these as ingredients for... some potions!
scripts.translation: 我把這些當作製作...某些藥劑的原料！

scripts.text: It wasn't for anything good though...
scripts.translation: 不過並不是為了什麼好事...

scripts.text: Before I forget, I should make note of these things on the wall. Wait...
scripts.translation: 在我忘記之前，我應該把這些事情記在牆上。等等...誰在

scripts.text: Who doodled so much on this wall?!
scripts.translation: 這面牆上畫了這麼多塗鴉？！

scripts.text: The writing is just like mine!
Every wall is filled with Professor Worm's notes.
scripts.translation: 每面牆上都寫滿了沃姆教授的筆記。

scripts.text: If I study the walls carefully I might be able to gain some information on the tower or Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 如果我仔細研究這些牆壁，也許能獲取一些關於中央塔或彩虹橋的資訊。

scripts.text: Every wall has so much doodling.
It looks like my writing. I must have done it.
Please take a look at five different walls, analyze what I doodled, and let me know what you find.
scripts.translation: 是我畫的。請檢視五面不同的牆，看看我都畫了什麼，再來

scripts.text: I'm so curious, so curious that all my memories might float away.
scripts.translation: 告訴我。我好奇得快忘掉所有記憶了！

scripts.text: You studied all of the doodles?

scripts.translation: 市長必須代表全體拉菲尼族。

scripts.text: What do you want to know?

scripts.translation: 以他的性格，或許只是出於興趣，並非有什麼特定目的。

scripts.translation: 其實我希望他真的只是好奇。

scripts.translation: 你雖是外國人，但既然知道內情，就有責任保護寶珠。

scripts.translation: 希望不會出事，不過真有狀況的話，還請你幫忙。

scripts.translation: ？君市長不知為何覺得不安，所以才下令加強警戒？

scripts.translation: 令，我就照辦。我應該相信市長是經過理性考量才下令的。

scripts.text: I thought you were the one who Mayor Jun trusts the most in Eclage.
scripts.translation: 。我還以為你是君市長在埃克拉珠最信任的人。

scripts.text: Whatever the reason is, I should believe that Mayor gave us the order after considering it normally and logically.
scripts.translation: 不管原因是什麼，我都該相信市長是經過理性考量才下達命令。

scripts.translation: ：即使我們心存不安，你似乎依舊信任並追隨君市長。

scripts.text: We pray that the modern Mayor will be like the wind that just passes by.
scripts.translation: 我們祈願現任市長如風般平靜地過去。

scripts.text: Once is enough of that kind of a strong wind.
scripts.translation: 那種狂風，有一次就夠了。

scripts.text: I don't know why Mayor is so obsessed with the Orb but since he made that decision after talking to you, I'm sure you had great influence on him as well.
scripts.translation: 我不知道市長為何如此執著於寶珠。不過他是在和你談過後才下令的，你肯定也對他產生了很大影響。

scripts.text: what happens to the Orb, the pride and origin of us Laphines.

scripts.translation: 。所以我們只能保持警惕，同時盼著他做出正確決定。

scripts.translation: 你嗎？天花板上裝有照明裝置，讓寶珠顯得更加明亮。

scripts.text: The Orb is always exposed in the plaza and since all Laphines have their eyes on it the guards who protect the Orb look down from the ceiling where the light fixtures are installed.

scripts.translation: 不管你怎麼看我，我都承載著拉菲尼族的歷史與精神，也是世界樹的守護者。

scripts.translation: 你覺得繼承了世界樹意志的我會什麼都不知道嗎？我

scripts.translation: 約頓海姆的戰爭很快就會

scripts.translation: 替國王效力的人，你在埃克拉珠可以享有一切權利。

scripts.text: Now, you who work for the king!

I truly want you to become an important figure in Eclage.
scripts.translation: 笑的。我真心希望你能成為埃克拉珠的重

scripts.translation: 要人物。即使做不到，也希望大家認定你無害，而且對埃克拉珠有益。

scripts.translation: 障吧。總有一天，認識你的人會幫上大忙。

scripts.text: It looks like you've been doing well.
All I wanted was for you to gain recognition in Eclage, and I didn't intend anything bad by what I did.
